+1 Weapon Potency Crystal.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.
+1 Weapon Potency Crystal.name: +1 Weapon Potency Crystal

+2 Weapon Potency Crystal.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +2 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from two orbital crystals.
+2 Weapon Potency Crystal.name: +2 Weapon Potency Crystal

+3 Weapon Potency Crystal.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +3 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from three orbital crystals.
+3 Weapon Potency Crystal.name: +3 Weapon Potency Crystal

Abadarcorp Travel Suit.description:
Upgrades: 2

AbadarCorp executives popularized these armored business suits for boardrooms and battle. Contingent force fields and concealed plating protect the wearer in hostile situations. Higher grades of travel suits offer more protection—along with a designer label.
Abadarcorp Travel Suit.name: Abadarcorp Travel Suit

Accelerator Ammunition.description: These rounds include onboard gyrojets that increase velocity the farther they travel. Attacks against targets further than 60 feet away gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice (or twice the number of dice using a sniper weapon). Attacks against targets further than 120 feet away instead gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice (or three times the number of dice using a sniper weapon).
Accelerator Ammunition.name: Accelerator Ammunition

Acid Dart Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle uses compressed air to shoot tiny, chambered darts loaded with components for a highly corrosive compound that remains separated until launched, allowing for nearly unlimited shelf life with minimal risk of accidental exposure.
Acid Dart Rifle.name: Acid Dart Rifle

Acid Module (Commercial).description: This module adds destructive nanobots to the weapon. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target also takes a –1 status penalty to its AC until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.
Acid Module (Commercial).name: Acid Module (Commercial)

Acid Module (Tactical).description: This module adds destructive nanobots to the weapon. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target also takes a –1 status penalty to its AC until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save. Acid damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target’s acid resistance.
Acid Module (Tactical).name: Acid Module (Tactical)

Active Camouflage (Advanced).description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +3 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.
Active Camouflage (Advanced).name: Active Camouflage (Advanced)

Active Camouflage (Commercial).description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.
Active Camouflage (Commercial).name: Active Camouflage (Commercial)

Active Camouflage (Tactical).description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.
Active Camouflage (Tactical).name: Active Camouflage (Tactical)

Adaptive Energy Shielding.description:
This device changes the chemical composition of the insulation installed on your armor, reacting to different types of energy.

Activate—Adapt r

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You take acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

Effect Your energy shielding upgrade changes to the triggering damage type. This lasts until you Adapt again or uninstall any adaptive energy shielding or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{Energy Shielding} upgrade from the same armor. If you have multiple energy shielding upgrades on this armor, choose one to change when you Adapt.
Adaptive Energy Shielding.name: Adaptive Energy Shielding

Additional Appendage (Commercial).description:
You gain an additional arm, tentacle, or similar appendage, usually with the same anatomy as your existing arms, though alternatives are available, such as tails engineered to carry items. Regardless of its appearance, the additional appendage functions identically to your existing arms and hands, or the equivalent for your ancestry. You can hold an additional hand's worth of weapons and equipment but must @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} to wield items with the additional appendage, as normal for characters with more than two hands.

Special If you have a second additional appendage augmentation, you can treat them both as a single pair of hands for the purposes of Switching Hands. If you have a third, it's treated as its own set of hands, though you can treat it as a pair with a fourth additional appendage, and so on. Each additional appendage still applies to your body's implant limit, even if they're paired together.
Additional Appendage (Commercial).name: Additional Appendage (Commercial)

Additional Appendage (Tactical).description:
You gain an additional arm, tentacle, or similar appendage, usually with the same anatomy as your existing arms, though alternatives are available, such as tails engineered to carry items. Regardless of its appearance, the additional appendage functions identically to your existing arms and hands, or the equivalent for your ancestry. You can hold an additional hand's worth of weapons and equipment but must @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} to wield items with the additional appendage, as normal for characters with more than two hands.

The additional appendage has an advanced coprocessor that can briefly take control. You gain the following activation.

Activate—Animated Limb 1 Until the beginning of your next turn, you count one additional hand or pair of hands as your active hands. At the beginning of your next turn, choose which set of active hands remains your active hands.

Special If you have a second additional appendage augmentation, you can treat them both as a single pair of hands for the purposes of Switching Hands. If you have a third, it's treated as its own set of hands, though you can treat it as a pair with a fourth additional appendage, and so on. Each additional appendage still applies to your body's implant limit, even if they're paired together.
Additional Appendage (Tactical).name: Additional Appendage (Tactical)

Adhesive Dispenser.description:
Upgrades: 0

You shoot adhesives that solidify midair into nonlethal globs. When you use Area Fire with this weapon, instead of dealing damage, you create difficult terrain in the affected area that lasts for 2 rounds. If you're trained with this weapon, creatures that end their turns in the difficult terrain become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. Creatures can attempt to Escape against your class DC to remove the immobilized condition. If you have the primary target class feature, you can attempt to [[/act trip]] your primary target instead of Strike (with a –2 circumstance penalty, as normal for the ranged trip trait).
Adhesive Dispenser.name: Adhesive Dispenser

Adrenal Autoinjectors (Advanced).description:
This set of adrenaline capsules are mounted above key veins. The onboard computer manages the injectors, ensuring the capsules are deployed when they're needed most.

You can also Inject Adrenaline as a free action with no trigger.

Activate—Inject Adrenaline r (healing, vitality)

Frequency three times per day

Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points as a result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a saving throw

Effect You gain 1 Hit Point and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.
Adrenal Autoinjectors (Advanced).name: Adrenal Autoinjectors (Advanced)

Adrenal Autoinjectors (Commercial).description:
This set of adrenaline capsules are mounted above key veins. The onboard computer manages the injectors, ensuring the capsules are deployed when they're needed most.

Activate—Inject Adrenaline r (healing, vitality)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points as a result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a saving throw

Effect You gain 1 Hit Point and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.
Adrenal Autoinjectors (Commercial).name: Adrenal Autoinjectors (Commercial)

Adrenal Autoinjectors (Tactical).description:
This set of adrenaline capsules are mounted above key veins. The onboard computer manages the injectors, ensuring the capsules are deployed when they're needed most.

You can also Inject Adrenaline as a free action with no trigger.

Activate—Inject Adrenaline r (healing, vitality)

Frequency twice per day

Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points as a result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a saving throw

Effect You gain 1 Hit Point and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.
Adrenal Autoinjectors (Tactical).name: Adrenal Autoinjectors (Tactical)

Adrenosuppressant Serum (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This bright pink serum is coveted by new recruits in militaries and mercenary companies alike. For the next hour after using this serum, you gain a +3 item bonus to Will saving throws or +4 to Will saving throws against fear effects.
Adrenosuppressant Serum (Advanced).name: Adrenosuppressant Serum (Advanced)

Adrenosuppressant Serum (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This bright pink serum is coveted by new recruits in militaries and mercenary companies alike. For the next hour after using this serum, you gain a +1 item bonus to Will saving throws or +2 to Will saving throws against fear effects.
Adrenosuppressant Serum (Commercial).name: Adrenosuppressant Serum (Commercial)

Adrenosuppressant Serum (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This bright pink serum is coveted by new recruits in militaries and mercenary companies alike. For the next hour after using this serum, you gain a +2 item bonus to Will saving throws or +3 to Will saving throws against fear effects.
Adrenosuppressant Serum (Tactical).name: Adrenosuppressant Serum (Tactical)

Aegis Series.description:
Upgrades: 0

Aegis armor suits are starmetal-infused shells that encase the wearer entirely, including an attached visorless helmet that's often sculpted into a custom style. Sensors built into the suit feed sensory information to the wearer, and powered limbs aid maneuvers. Movement in an aegis suit is clumsy, but powerful.
Aegis Series.name: Aegis Series

Aeon Guard Battle Dress.description:
Upgrades: 0

The mainstay of the Aeon Guard is solid armor that provides a fair amount of mobility for the wearer. The Aeon Guard believes in being armed and armored at all times and stresses a certain amount of flexibility in how their gear operates so soldiers can adapt to any situation.
Aeon Guard Battle Dress.name: Aeon Guard Battle Dress

Aeon Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 0

A mainstay of the Azlanti Star Empire, this sleek laser rifle includes a slot for aeon stones to enhance and focus the intensity of its beams.
Aeon Rifle.name: Aeon Rifle

Aeon Stone (Containing).description:
This irregular gray torus is pitted and scarred, and it glows green in an environment with at least low levels of radiation, with higher levels causing a more intense glow. In addition to serving as a simple radiation detector, the stone absorbs radiation around the wearer. You gain resistance 8 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

The resonant power allows you to cast protection as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once per day.

Activate—Radiation Pulse 2 (concentrate, magical, manipulate, radiation)

Frequency once per day

Effect You unleash a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on you that irradiates the area for 1 hour. Creatures that enter the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save against severe radiation sickness. This magical radiation has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round.
Aeon Stone (Containing).name: Aeon Stone (Containing)

Aeon Stone (Guiding).description:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This gold star glitters with joyful energy. Its resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} as an occult innate cantrip.

Activate—Cosmic Luck 1 (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check

Effect You change the critical failure into a failure.
Aeon Stone (Guiding).name: Aeon Stone (Guiding)

A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE]{Life Seal} as a divine innate spell once per day.
Aeon Stone (Life-Giving).name: Aeon Stone (Life-Giving)

This deep purple helicoid prism guides your innate sense of direction in even the emptiest reaches of space. You gain a +2 item bonus to Piloting checks to Navigate. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.3VucgRc8FRPGy9NI]{Seek the Stars} as a divine innate cantrip.

Activate—Navigate 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You concentrate on a Drift beacon you've visited before and mentally chart a course for that location. You immediately know which direction to travel to reach your destination, and your journey takes 1 day less if you're piloting the ship.
Aeon Stone (Navigating).name: Aeon Stone (Navigating)

This opalescent sapphire cone grants you a limited form of projected empathy with a range of 100 feet that can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language and includes a type and intensity of emotion, such as "mild anger," "intense joy," or "deep sadness." When you Sense the Motive of a creature within 30 feet, you detect the presence or absence of thoughts from the creature as though you cast the 1-action version of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qOLMHvkAGsVYLhtn]{Detect Thoughts}. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.uBo6g5aW087cLSJR]{Mind Skewer} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once per day.

This deep-blue prism with cloudy inclusions is light as a feather. Its resonant power gives you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate—Fly Free 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a fly Speed for 1 minute equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.xZ5XMY55S42aGyjg]{Effect: Aeon Stone (Uplifting)}
Aeon Stone (Uplifting).name: Aeon Stone (Uplifting)

Aeon Storm.description:
Upgrades: 1

This submachine gun is a favored weapon of the Azlanti Star Empire's elite strike forces.
Aeon Storm.name: Aeon Storm

Aeon Transmitter (Commercial).description:
This magical comms array transmits the benefits of an aeon stone. Your armor gains the aeon trait. If it already has the aeon trait, it can fit a second aeon stone or spell gem.

Activate—Transmit f

Requirements Your armor has an aeon stone attached, and it has an activation that isn't a reaction

Effect If the next action you use is to Activate the attached aeon stone, the effects apply to another willing creature within 30 feet instead as if they'd activated it.
Aeon Transmitter (Commercial).name: Aeon Transmitter (Commercial)

Aeon Transmitter (Tactical).description:

Effect If the next action you use is to Activate the attached aeon stone, the effects apply to another willing creature within 30 feet instead as if they'd activated it.

Activate—Broadcast 1 (manipulate, concentrate)

Requirements Your armor has an aeon stone attached, and the aeon stone provides one or more item bonuses

Effect All item bonuses conferred by the attached aeon stone apply to you and all allies within 30 feet for 1 hour. After the effect ends, the aeon stone and the aeon transmitter are both exhausted, providing no benefits until your next daily preparations.
Aeon Transmitter (Tactical).name: Aeon Transmitter (Tactical)

Aerosol Spray Nozzle.description: This atomizing nozzle uses gas compressors to spray chem in a fine mist. An aerosol spray requires a commercial chem tank that must be purchased separately. You can expend one chem to spray into an adjacent square as an Interact action. If there's an invisible creature, object, or light in that square, it becomes temporarily observed until the end of your turn, though the subject still has concealment due to invisibility.
Aerosol Spray Nozzle.name: Aerosol Spray Nozzle

Akashic Lens (Advanced).description:
Worn as a contact lens, spectacles, or other eyewear, these magically treated lenses project a special data display that uses virtual intelligence and rapid eye tracking to quickly cycle through information until you find what you seek. It grants you a +2 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks with the skill chosen when you use Database Scan.

Activate—Database Scan 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The lens casts a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.VynaowCerc7B4yvI]{Akashic Download} that uses the lens instead of a comm unit.
Akashic Lens (Advanced).name: Akashic Lens (Advanced)

Amphitheatarge.description: This curved shield is terraced to mimic the tiered seating of a classical amphitheater, ensuring acoustic affronts are lifted up and away from the shield's wielder.
Amphitheatarge.name: Amphitheatarge

Animated Intelligence (Advanced).description:
Magical circuitry generates a virtual animated intelligence with a customizable personality and no free will. Rarely, a virtual intelligence might eventually evolve into a true artificial intelligence with self-awareness and free will, usually with the help of powerful magic or a miracle.

Activate—Autoattack 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect You Release the weapon and it glides through the air, fighting on its own against the last enemy you attacked, or the nearest enemy to it if your target has been defeated. At the end of your turn each round, the weapon can Fly up to its fly Speed of 60 feet, and then can either Fly again or Strike one creature within its range or reach.

The weapon has a space of 5 feet, but it doesn't block or impede enemies attempting to move though that space. It provides but does not benefit from flanking. The animated intelligence is considered a technological creature for the purpose of effects that can target it. The weapon can't move through an enemy's space. The weapon can't use reactions, and its Fly actions don't trigger reactions.

While it's activated, the animated intelligence Strikes with an attack modifier of +32 plus its item bonus to attack rolls. It uses the weapon's normal damage but has a +0 Strength and Dexterity modifier. The weapon's abilities that automatically trigger on a hit or critical hit still function, but the weapon can't be activated or benefit from any of your abilities while animated.

Each round, when the weapon finishes using its actions, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:4]. On a failure, the activation ends. The weapon falls to the ground and can't Autoattack again for 10 minutes.
Animated Intelligence (Advanced).name: Animated Intelligence (Advanced)

Anti-Life Crossbow.description:
Upgrades: 1

This crossbow's bolts can be charged with void energy that disincorporate the cells of living creatures on impact.
Anti-Life Crossbow.name: Anti-Life Crossbow

Antibiotic (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Antibiotics are formulated to assist the body in fighting off diseases. You gain a +3 item bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases for 24 hours; this applies to your daily save against a disease's progression.
Antibiotic (Advanced).name: Antibiotic (Advanced)

Antibiotic (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Antibiotic (Commercial).name: Antibiotic (Commercial)

Antibiotic (Elite).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Antibiotics are formulated to assist the body in fighting off diseases. You gain a +4 item bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases for 24 hours; this applies to your daily save against a disease's progression.

A condition whose value is reduced to 0 isn't removed; after 8 hours, the condition returns to its original value, unless its duration expired or it was removed by another means.

This convoluted web of synthweave straps is worn as a fashion statement in some subcultures but has a useful application in extreme environments. Activate—Gravity Alteration 1 (manipulate)

Effect You treat gravity as being two steps higher or lower (for example, zero-g becomes standard gravity, low gravity becomes high gravity, standard gravity becomes extreme gravity, or vice versa). This only affects you, your gear, and your movement and lasts 1 minute.
Antigrav Harness (Advanced).name: Antigrav Harness (Advanced)

Antitoxin (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This specially crafted medicine is designed to absorb and neutralize poisons in your bloodstream. You gain a +3 item bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons for 6 hours.
Antitoxin (Advanced).name: Antitoxin (Advanced)

Antitoxin (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This specially crafted medicine is designed to absorb and neutralize poisons in your bloodstream. You gain a +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons for 6 hours.
Antitoxin (Commercial).name: Antitoxin (Commercial)

Antitoxin (Elite).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This specially crafted medicine is designed to absorb and neutralize poisons in your bloodstream. You gain a +4 item bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons for 6 hours.

Aqua Jets (Commercial).description:
Propellers, underwater jets, and other hydrodynamic propulsion systems enhance your aquatic mobility.

Activate—Propel 1

Effect You activate the propulsion system to gain a swim Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.
Aqua Jets (Commercial).name: Aqua Jets (Commercial)

Aqua Jets (Tactical).description:
Propellers, underwater jets, and other hydrodynamic propulsion systems enhance your aquatic mobility.

You don't take a penalty to bludgeoning or slashing attack Strikes underwater.

Activate—Propel 1

Effect You activate the propulsion system to gain a swim Speed of 40 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.
Aqua Jets (Tactical).name: Aqua Jets (Tactical)

Aquavarius Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

Equipped with a sturdy dorsal fin and webbed extremities, this armor facilitates underwater exploration and mobility. Aquavarius armor is beloved by marine biologists, xenowardens, and ocean enthusiasts alike. AbadarCorp markets it as the definitive beachwear for adventurers seeking sunken treasures. Aquavarius armor always has @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.CYNZnduBJCF6XCFs]{commercial aqua jets} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
Aquavarius Armor.name: Aquavarius Armor

Arc Emitter.description:
Upgrades: 1

Composed of two 4-foot-long protracting rails, this weapon shoots arcs of electricity at targets, emitted safely away from its wielder.
Arc Emitter.name: Arc Emitter

Arc Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.
Arc Pistol.name: Arc Pistol

Arc Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle's oversized body contains a larger version of an arc pistol capacitor, with a short barrel and polycarbon stock designed to insulate the wielder from high voltage. The arc rifle's larger capacitor allows it to produce a charge with enough power to subdue a rampaging renkroda.
Arc Rifle.name: Arc Rifle

Arcane Adapter (Commercial).description:
This barrel shroud is covered in complex magical symbols. It transmutes rounds as they leave the chamber.

Activate—Transmute Ammo 1 (magical)

Frequency once per day

Effect Select cold iron or silver. For the next minute, ammunition fired from this weapon is treated as the chosen material for the purposes of determining immunities, resistances, weakness, and other effects.
Arcane Adapter (Commercial).name: Arcane Adapter (Commercial)

Arcane Adapter (Tactical).description:
This barrel shroud is covered in complex magical symbols. It transmutes rounds as they leave the chamber.

Activate—Transmute Ammo 1 (magical)

Frequency once per day

Effect Select cold iron, silver, or adamantine. For the next minute, ammunition fired from this weapon is treated as the chosen material for the purposes of determining immunities, resistances, weakness, and other effects.
Arcane Adapter (Tactical).name: Arcane Adapter (Tactical)

Archaic Text.description: This book could be a religious text, a collection of ancient recipes, a romance novel, or vintage mechanical schematics.
Archaic Text.name: Archaic Text

Archon Armor.description:
Upgrades: 0

Archon armor was designed by those who aspire to reach the heavens. Taking inspiration from angels, archon armor offers lightweight and flexible composite protection while using small jet nozzles in a wing pattern to propel the wearer forward at high speeds.
Archon Armor.name: Archon Armor

Armored Coat.description:
Upgrades: 1

This overcoat is made of real or synthetic leather and reinforced with armored plates. Armored coats are often tailor-made to match the wearer's personal style. Standard versions are issued to military officers as part of their uniforms.
Armored Coat.name: Armored Coat

Armored Copi Exoskeleton.description: Your armored copi exoskeleton grants a +3 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and has the comfort and exposed traits. You're trained in your exoskeleton. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can't install armor upgrades or etch armor runes onto your exoskeleton.
Armored Copi Exoskeleton.name: Armored Copi Exoskeleton

Armplates.description: You've undergone the extensive process to develop scaled armplates like your ancestors. Your armplates function like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.j66fZJrm1nECG3UM]{commercial dermal plating} augmentation, except they are a permanent part of your body, don't have the tech trait, and don't take an augmentation slot. You can spend credits to upgrade your armplates as if they were dermal plating.
Armplates.name: Armplates

Artificial Immortalizer.description:
This extra organ assimilates with and enhances your circulatory and immune systems. When you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you recover completely, regardless of its current stage. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Life Buffer 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain 50 temporary Hit Points, which last for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.68zoB7dwKUcmEO1R]{Effect: Artificial Immortalizer}
Artificial Immortalizer.name: Artificial Immortalizer

Artillery Laser.description:
Upgrades: 1

The fast-firing and continuous beams of this laser cannon converge on the target to create enough heat to melt a steel door into slag.
Artillery Laser.name: Artillery Laser

Assassin Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sniper rifle breaks down into small parts, allowing its wielder to smuggle the weapon without attracting attention. Most assassin rifles are equipped with powerful scopes and digital sights.
Assassin Rifle.name: Assassin Rifle

Assassin's Garrote.description:
Upgrades: 1

This thin conductive wire can be spooled out of a bracelet to assassinate via asphyxiation. If you're Grabbing a creature with an assassin's garrote you're trained with, it begins suffocating as long as it remains @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, and it loses 1 round worth of air each time you damage the creature with the assassin's garrote (in addition to the air it also loses if you score a critical hit).
Assassin's Garrote.name: Assassin's Garrote

Assault Briefcase (Advanced).description:
This hard-shelled briefcase can hold up to 1 Bulk of documents and equipment. You can install shields and weapons into your assault briefcase, but they must be the same grade or lower than the briefcase.

You can Install a one-handed ranged weapon of 1 Bulk or less into the assault briefcase. You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} a Weapon installed in the assault briefcase (+4 if the weapon has the concealable trait). You can deploy the installed weapon with an Interact action, allowing you to wield it in one hand while holding the briefcase.

You can Install a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.ZIIEmh2nAnST6vGk]{Deflecting Field} into the assault briefcase and use it as though it were armor. If you use a weapon integrated into the briefcase for any purpose while the shield is raised, the shield is no longer raised, and you no longer receive a bonus to your AC.
Assault Briefcase (Advanced).name: Assault Briefcase (Advanced)

Atomic Spear.description:
Upgrades: 1

These spears can switch between a simple sharp point to an entropically charged degradation blade.
Atomic Spear.name: Atomic Spear

Atraxid Jewelry.description: You have an eye for the ideal jewelry needed for any occasion. In 10 minutes, you can craft the perfect accessories for one creature for one social event. The accessories confer a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] at that event. A creature can only have one set of accessories per day, and they go out of style after 24 hours and can no longer be used. The accessories have negligible monetary value.
Atraxid Jewelry.name: Atraxid Jewelry

Aucturnite Chakram.description:
Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of aucturnite and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has mysteriously appeared light-years from Aucturn's original orbit.
Aucturnite Chakram.name: Aucturnite Chakram

Aural Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 3d8.
Aural Grenade (Advanced).name: Aural Grenade (Advanced)

Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1[bleed]]

Auto-CPR Unit.description: This device monitors your vital signs and automatically administers aid. When you have the dying condition while wearing this armor, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 8 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).
Auto-CPR Unit.name: Auto-CPR Unit

Autodreamer.description: A microchip embedded into your nervous system activates whenever you sleep, immersing you in constant lucid dreams unless you choose to sleep normally. Once per day when you awaken after getting a full 8 hours of sleep, you count as having spent a day of downtime retraining. Your dreams draw from your own experiences, so you can't use them for retraining that requires an instructor or specialized knowledge.
Autodreamer.name: Autodreamer

Autograppler (Commercial).description: You can attach this anchoring device to a cable line with an Interact action. Clamps automatically slide from the base of the autograppler along the attached cable, allowing it to be climbed like a knotted rope. You can throw the autograppler to attach it to a solid surface, attempting a ranged attack roll using your simple weapon proficiency against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. This attack has the secret trait. On a success, your autograppler has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the grappler seems like it will hold but detaches when you're partway up.
Autograppler (Commercial).name: Autograppler (Commercial)

Autograppler (Tactical).description:
You can attach this anchoring device to a cable line with an Interact action. Clamps automatically slide from the base of the autograppler along the attached cable, allowing it to be climbed like a knotted rope. You can throw the autograppler to attach it to a solid surface, attempting a ranged attack roll using your simple weapon proficiency against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. This attack has the secret trait. On a success, your autograppler has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the grappler seems like it will hold but detaches when you're partway up.

A tactical autograppler has a sensor to detect whether it has a firm hold, causing it to automatically retract if you critically fail your ranged attack to attach it.
Autograppler (Tactical).name: Autograppler (Tactical)

Autopilot (Advanced).description:
Autopilots are ubiquitous throughout the Pact Worlds on all manner of vehicles. It takes 10 minutes to install an autopilot into a vehicle, during which time the vehicle can't be occupied as it calibrates itself and runs extensive diagnostics. Once installed, you can control the vehicle remotely using your comm unit with a range of 20 miles. A commercial autopilot has a +9 modifier to Piloting and can forego rolling a skill check for Piloting to instead receive a result of 10 + its modifier.

Activate—Autopilot 1

Requirements The autopilot is attached to a vehicle

Effect The autopilot Drives, Speeds Up, or Stops its attached vehicle.
Autopilot (Advanced).name: Autopilot (Advanced)

Autorecognition Lens.description: An artificial eye lens microscopically wired into your brain automatically tracks a database of associated names and faces as you meet or interact with individuals. After you've learned someone's name and appearance, a tiny HUD displays their name to you whenever you're looking at them as long as you're aware of their presence and their appearance hasn't dramatically changed (at the GM's discretion). This doesn't help you see or identify people who are trying to hide or disguise their appearance. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Autorecognition Lens.name: Autorecognition Lens

Autotarget Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This short, bulky assault rifle incorporates a piston system that allows the user to switch to auto-fire and unload a magazine with one trigger squeeze.
Autotarget Rifle.name: Autotarget Rifle

Ball Lightning Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This triple-coiled, artillery, ionized, atmospheric amplifier, or ball lightning cannon, creates slow moving orbs of electricity that detonate in arcs of lightning when they finally hit their targets. If you're trained with this weapon, the Area Fire arcs from each creature in the burst that fails (or critically fails) its Reflex save to the closest creature within 10 feet that doesn't take any damage from the Area Fire, dealing electricity damage to that creature equal to 1 per weapon damage die.
Ball Lightning Cannon.name: Ball Lightning Cannon

Barathu Shell.description: This shell counts as medium armor in the composite armor group. It grants a +2 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and has the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +3 at 5th level. You're trained in your shell. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your shell, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Barathu Shell.name: Barathu Shell

Basic Environmental Protection.description: This upgrade protects the user against the effects of space as well as thick and thin atmospheres. This armor loses the exposed trait for as long as the upgrade is installed.
Basic Environmental Protection.name: Basic Environmental Protection

Baton.description:
Upgrades: 1

This reinforced rod is commonly made from metal alloys and designed to strike and parry incoming blows.
Baton.name: Baton

Battle Ribbon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sheer nanocarbon ribbon is sharp enough to cut through flesh without interrupting the traditional battle dances that make the weapon famous.
Battle Ribbon.name: Battle Ribbon

Battleglove.description:
Upgrades: 1

These durable gloves fit over a wielder's hands (or other appendages) and feature weighted plates or spikes over the knuckles.
Battleglove.name: Battleglove

Beauty Barrier.description: A beauty barrier consists of several angled mirrors on a lightweight armguard to get the best look at oneself or one's foes. Originally developed as a fashionable accessory for infosphere influencers, the shield's ability to deflect laser attacks resulted in its rebranding for mercenaries.
Beauty Barrier.name: Beauty Barrier

Binary Blaster.description:
Upgrades: 1

This shotgun rotates between two barrels: a flat vent for lasers or a vertical muzzle for ballistic shells. The laser uses a battery with a capacity of 40 and an expend of 4.
Binary Blaster.name: Binary Blaster

Biometric Lock (Dna Matching).description:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires six successful @Check[computers|dc:35] or @Check[thievery|dc:42] checks; DNA sample reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 4.
Biometric Lock (Dna Matching).name: Biometric Lock (Dna Matching)

Biometric Lock (Facial Recognition).description:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires five successful @Check[computers|dc:30] or @Check[thievery|dc:35] checks; facial scan recreation reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 3.
Biometric Lock (Facial Recognition).name: Biometric Lock (Facial Recognition)

Biometric Lock (Fingerprint Scanner).description:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires two successful @Check[computers|dc:22] or @Check[thievery|dc:25] checks; fingerprint sample reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 1.
Biometric Lock (Fingerprint Scanner).name: Biometric Lock (Fingerprint Scanner)

Biometric Lock (Retina Scanner).description:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires three successful @Check[computers|dc:24] or @Check[thievery|dc:27] checks; retina recreation reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 2.
Biometric Lock (Retina Scanner).name: Biometric Lock (Retina Scanner)

Biometric Lock (Voice Recognition).description:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires four successful @Check[computers|dc:26] or @Check[thievery|dc:30] checks; voice sample reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 2.
Biometric Lock (Voice Recognition).name: Biometric Lock (Voice Recognition)

Biometric Thief (Commercial).description:
This strange-looking glove, covered in wires and runes, uses a combination of magic and science to steal identities.

Activate—Steal DNA 1 (manipulate) You touch an organic creature within reach, attempting to absorb some of its DNA. Attempt a Thievery check to Steal the target's DNA, storing it in the glove on a success. Your biometric thief can only store one creature's DNA at a time.

Activate—Biometric Shift 2 (magical, morph)

Frequency once per day

Requirements A creature's DNA is stored in the biometric thief

Effect You replicate minor biometric traits of the required creature, such as fingerprints, eye irises, and blood type, and your DNA appears to be theirs if analyzed. Otherwise, you still look like yourself. The effects last for 10 minutes and are temporary even for organic detritus you leave behind; for example, hair or blood left behind would read as the target's DNA if analyzed during the duration, but as yours if collected and analyzed later.
Biometric Thief (Commercial).name: Biometric Thief (Commercial)

Biometric Thief (Tactical).description:
This strange-looking glove, covered in wires and runes, uses a combination of magic and science to steal identities.

Activate—Steal DNA 1 (manipulate) You touch an organic creature within reach, attempting to absorb some of its DNA. Attempt a Thievery check to Steal the target's DNA, storing it in the glove on a success. Your biometric thief can only store one creature's DNA at a time.

Activate—Biometric Shift 2 (magical, polymorph)

Frequency once per day

Requirements A creature's DNA is stored in the biometric thief

Effect You replicate minor biometric traits of the required creature, such as fingerprints, eye irises, and blood type, and your DNA appears to be theirs if analyzed. You also take on the required creature's appearance, as a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} spell. The appearance of your clothing and items doesn't change. The effects last for 10 minutes and are temporary even for organic detritus you leave behind; for example, hair or blood left behind would read as the target's DNA if analyzed during the duration, but as yours if collected and analyzed later.
Biometric Thief (Tactical).name: Biometric Thief (Tactical)

Biotic Equalizer.description:
Upgrades: 1

This heavyweight biotech cannon has a chitinous exterior adorned with pumps, combining acids and peroxides to lob chemical payloads. If you're trained with this weapon, the expend is 1 when you make a ranged Strike against a single creature, such as when attacking your primary target, if you have that soldier class feature.
Biotic Equalizer.name: Biotic Equalizer

Bipod (Advanced).description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

You can Interact as a free action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.

Once per round, you can either deploy or retrieve this automatic bipod as a free action instead of an Interact action.
Bipod (Advanced).name: Bipod (Advanced)

Bipod (Commercial).description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

However, you must spend a single Interact action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.
Bipod (Commercial).name: Bipod (Commercial)

Bipod (Tactical).description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

You can Interact as a free action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.
Bipod (Tactical).name: Bipod (Tactical)

Bizarre Keyring.description:
A handmade figurine of an unknown alien creature dangles from a clunky brass keyring. While holding or carrying the keyring, you gain a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, and you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand} cantrip as an occult innate spell once per day.

Note: The item's Bulk, price and usage are listed according to SFS Rulings and Clarifications.
Bizarre Keyring.name: Bizarre Keyring

Blacklight Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This serum comes in a discreet, opaque black bottle. For 1 hour, your body sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius (and dim light for the next 15 feet) in the neon color or colors designated when the serum was created.
Blacklight Serum.name: Blacklight Serum

Blast Knife.description:
Upgrades: 1

This adamantine knife has a sheet of combustible material folded into its base that can be detonated remotely using a remote in its sheath. When you successfully Strike a creature with a blast knife, you can spend your reaction to release the knife and embed it into your target. A creature must spend an Interact action to remove an embedded blast knife.

Activate—Remote Detonation 1 (fire, manipulate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Your blast knife explodes, dealing @Damage[1d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] or @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage per weapon damage die if the knife was embedded in a target, with a basic Reflex save equal to your class DC. The knife maneuvers back into its sheath, safely avoiding creatures and obstacles to reach its destination.
Blast Knife.name: Blast Knife

Bledstick.description: Bledsticks are illegal modifications to credsticks that impale anyone who attempts to use the credstick other than its authorized owner. A bledstick is matched to a single authorized user's biometric profile when Installed into the credstick. If any other creature uses the credstick, needles immediately erupt from the sides and surface of the bledstick, dealing @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] damage and drawing a sample of blood from the unauthorized user that can be used to identify or track the creature later. An authorized creature can disable the bledstick for any amount of time for up to 24 hours.
Bledstick.name: Bledstick

Blockthrower.description: Salvaged from the set of Sabotage Soufflé (a popular cooking competition), these frosty weapons draw liquid from a tank through hypercooling coils to quickly generate gigantic blocks of ice that can be slung at high velocity toward their targets.
Blockthrower.name: Blockthrower

Bone Blade (Commercial).description:
Skeletal bone shards are implanted in your elbow, wrist, or knuckles on one arm, able to spontaneously regenerate into a wicked blade made from bone that extends through your skin. You gain a bone blade unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. You can retract or extend the blade as a single Interact action, and it's undetectable without a detailed medical scan while retracted.

Special If you have more than one bone blade, they gain the twin trait. In addition, you can extend or retract all your bone blades with a single Interact action, or with any other ability that allows you to draw or stow a weapon (such as the Tactical Swap feat).
Bone Blade (Commercial).name: Bone Blade (Commercial)

Bone Blade (Tactical).description:
Skeletal bone shards are implanted in your elbow, wrist, or knuckles on one arm, able to spontaneously regenerate into a wicked blade made from bone that extends through your skin. You gain a bone blade unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. You can retract or extend the blade as a single Interact action, and it's undetectable without a detailed medical scan while retracted.

Whenever you get a critical hit with your bone blade unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special If you have more than one bone blade, they gain the twin trait. In addition, you can extend or retract all your bone blades with a single Interact action, or with any other ability that allows you to draw or stow a weapon (such as the Tactical Swap feat).
Bone Blade (Tactical).name: Bone Blade (Tactical)

Bone Scepter.description:
Upgrades: 1

This engraved club of solid bone is tempered using material from the void that can drain life energy.
Bone Scepter.name: Bone Scepter

Bone Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This black sludge is distilled from elebrian bone matter and tastes like mint. Upon drinking it, you gain void healing for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Crg77XKCHxittH5a]{Effect: Bone Serum}
Bone Serum.name: Bone Serum

Bone Speaker Bobblehead.description: Marketed toward living tourists in Pact Port, these festive dolls are fashioned in the likenesses of prominent bone sages, most popularly the media mogul Zo!. Any living creature carrying a bone speaker bobblehead in one hand can speak and understand the Necril language. This does not let them understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like unless you can bypass the limitations of a computer-assisted translation app, such as with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Bi0wdUuHsLxvSqrJ]{Digital Ambassador} skill feat.
Bone Speaker Bobblehead.name: Bone Speaker Bobblehead

Bonecowl Armor.description:
Upgrades: 0

This menacing skeletal armor is adorned with a drapery of hanging wires and biotech mesh, and usually features a stylish cape. For generations, Eoxian heads of state and bone sages have worn bonecowl armor to inject some drama and theater to political gatherings while protecting themselves from assassins.
Bonecowl Armor.name: Bonecowl Armor

Boom Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

A boom pistol resembles a megaphone with a trigger, emitting sudden bursts of sound capable of shattering bulletproof glass or rupturing organs.
Boom Pistol.name: Boom Pistol

Boom Ripple (Commercial).description: This upgrade charges a weapon to create shock waves. When you critically hit with this weapon, you create a shock wave in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] at a corner of your choice on the space of the Strike's target or, if you critically hit using the primary target class feature, the shock wave uses the area of your Area Fire instead. Creatures in the area take @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save), and creatures that critically fail their save are knocked back 10 feet from the center of the area. This is forced movement.
Boom Ripple (Commercial).name: Boom Ripple (Commercial)

Boom Ripple (Tactical).description: This upgrade charges a weapon to create shock waves. When you critically hit with this weapon, you create a shock wave in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] at a corner of your choice on the space of the Strike's target or, if you critically hit using the primary target class feature, the shock wave uses the area of your Area Fire instead. Creatures in the area take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save), and creatures that critically fail their save are knocked back 10 feet from the center of the area. This is forced movement.
Boom Ripple (Tactical).name: Boom Ripple (Tactical)

Boom Shot.description:
Upgrades: 0

This shotgun uses compressed air to create a loud boom. A boom shot doesn't use a battery but instead uses centrifugal force and regains 1 charge when you Interact to boost the weapon (maximum of 3 charges).
Boom Shot.name: Boom Shot

Boundary Spray Paint.description: When this paint is sprayed onto a wall, the paint remains even if the wall is drastically changed by supernatural effects, such as the layout of the Ghost Levels changing. You gain a +2 item bonus to rolls to navigate the Ghost Floors and similar liminal areas.
Boundary Spray Paint.name: Boundary Spray Paint

Breaching Gun.description:
Upgrades: 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.
Breaching Gun.name: Breaching Gun

Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial).description: This industrial cable is typically made of high-durability plastic coated in metal. A commercial cable line is coated in titanium alloy.
Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial).name: Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial)

Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical).description: This industrial cable is typically made of high-durability plastic coated in metal. A tactical cable line is coated in adamantine alloy.
Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical).name: Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical)

Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Type commercial cairn form spell amp; Level 7; Price 720 credits

Effect 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HAaRcHfN4g83eSEC]{Cairn Form} spell
Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial).name: Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial)

Cairn Form Spell Amp (Tactical).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HAaRcHfN4g83eSEC]{Cairn Form} spell
Cairn Form Spell Amp (Tactical).name: Cairn Form Spell Amp (Tactical)

Camping Kit.description: A camping kit contains a weatherproof tent for four Medium or two Large creatures, bedrolls, a fire igniter, 1 week of rations, and a survival knife.
Camping Kit.name: Camping Kit

Caramel Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 0

The caramel cannon shoots globs of sticky caramel. When you Area Fire this weapon, instead of dealing damage, you create difficult terrain in the affected area that lasts for 2 rounds. If you're trained with this weapon, creatures in the area that fail their Reflex saves treat the area as greater difficult terrain (and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} on a critical failure). Creatures can attempt to Escape against your class DC to remove the immobilized condition. If you have the primary target class feature, you can attempt to [[/act grapple]] your primary target instead of Strike (with a –2 circumstance penalty, as normal for the ranged grapple trait).
Caramel Cannon.name: Caramel Cannon

Carapace Armor.description:
Upgrades: 0

Originating from the distant world of Shimrinsara, carapace armor is grown, not built, and remains alive while attached to an owner. After a short period of acclimation, during which it grows to cover the body, the armor perfectly matches the wearer's movements and provides environmental protection. The living carapace is self-sustaining, surviving on dead skin cells and body fluids without harming the wearer.
Carapace Armor.name: Carapace Armor

Carbon Shield.description: This durable yet lightweight defensive plate comes in a variety of shapes and sizes, and it's often customized with LED displays that broadcast personal insignia or an organization's colors and symbols.
Carbon Shield.name: Carbon Shield

Carbon Skin.description:
Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Most are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.
Carbon Skin.name: Carbon Skin

Card Slinger.description:
Upgrade: 1

This ceramic weapon sharpens and fires playing cards, such as those from an infinity deck. Their folding design and innocuous ammunition make it ideal for infiltrating secure locations, especially casinos. While the weapon often relies on lucky hits, in the hands of a gambler familiar with card trajectory, it can become deadly.
Card Slinger.name: Card Slinger

Cardiac Accelerator.description:
This implant integrates directly into your heart. You can trigger the accelerator to briefly overclock your body's cardiovascular system.

Activate—Accelerate f

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You Climb, Stride, or Swim

Effect You increase your Speed by 20 feet for the triggering action.
Cardiac Accelerator.name: Cardiac Accelerator

Carvesong.description:
Upgrades: 1

Chiseled from sacred bark gathered from Vesk-3's remaining jungles, this armor surrounds the wearer with a magical magnetic field that ensures their survival in extreme environments. Rumors suggest that pahtra sorcerers who wear this armor can enhance their spells by channeling their planet's magnetic melodies through the runic carvings along the wooden plates.
Carvesong.name: Carvesong

Celebrity Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This fizzy pink concoction is mildly intoxicating and grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.dCDZQr7EBfCALmT2]{Effect: Celebrity Serum}
Celebrity Serum.name: Celebrity Serum

Cellular Stimulant Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QiW8VNdBf0SFUq69]{Cellular Stimulant} spell (DC 15)
Cellular Stimulant Spell Amp.name: Cellular Stimulant Spell Amp

Charmed Smile.description:
Used by entertainers and companions throughout the Pact Worlds, these cerebral implants emit subtle psychic impulses that make you more desirable to those around you, allowing you to manipulate them more easily. Lashuntas often eschew this particular augmentation, seeing it as a corruption of their natural abilities. Some platforms, especially those hosting contests, claim to ban this augmentation.

Activate—Turn On the Charm 1 (emotion, magical) You attempt to [[/act make-an-impression]] on a creature within 15 feet. They then become immune to Turn On the Charm for 24 hours.
Charmed Smile.name: Charmed Smile

Charmed Smile (Advanced).description:
Used by entertainers and companions throughout the Pact Worlds, these cerebral implants emit subtle psychic impulses that make you more desirable to those around you, allowing you to manipulate them more easily. Lashuntas often eschew this particular augmentation, seeing it as a corruption of their natural abilities. Some platforms, especially those hosting contests, claim to ban this augmentation.

Activate—Turn On the Charm 1 (emotion, magical) You attempt to [[/act make-an-impression]] on a creature within 15 feet. They then become immune to Turn On the Charm for 24 hours.

Twice per day, when you Turn On the Charm, the target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:34] save against the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} spell in addition to the normal effects.
Charmed Smile (Advanced).name: Charmed Smile (Advanced)

Chemalyzer.description: This handheld sampling unit grants a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to identify an unknown drug, medicinal, poison, or other chemical substance.
Chemalyzer.name: Chemalyzer

Chitinous Plates.description: Your chitinous plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, with a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the analog, comfort, and exposed traits. You're trained in your chitinous plates. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit} over your exoskeleton, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your chitinous plates, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Chitinous Plates.name: Chitinous Plates

Chitinous Shield.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.yWUKpu1ImB0vfXvB]{Chitinous Shield}

You have a growth of particularly durable chitin on your arm that you can use as a shield. This shield doesn't need to be held in your hand, and it can't be disarmed. Your shield has an AC bonus of +2, Hardness 4, 12 Hit Points, and a Broken Threshold of 6. If your shield becomes broken, it can't be repaired until you are restored to full health and spend 10 minutes readjusting your chitin. You can spend 1 day of downtime and expend raw materials (such as UPBs) to improve the grade of your shield, but only to a grade up to your level (such as advanced if you're level 8 or higher). Use the level, price, Hardness, HP, and BT adjustments in the Shield Improvements table.
Chitinous Shield.name: Chitinous Shield

Chordpocalypse.description:
Upgrades: 1

This showstopping techno-electric guitar emits a wave of sonic energy when played and is usually boosted by strumming a power chord. If you're trained with this weapon, you can expend 11 charges to increase its range when you Area Fire to 20 feet. If you aren't trained with this weapon, decrease its range when you Area Fire to 10 feet.
Chordpocalypse.name: Chordpocalypse

Chronoculus Eye.description:
A chronoculus eye is an ocular implant that allows you to see in a wide spectrum of wavelengths as well as partially predict the future. You gain darkvision, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative.

Activate—Wide-Spectrum Scan 1

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Until the start of your next turn, you gain the effects of a 7th-rank truesight spell and can see infrared and ultraviolet light as well as all other wavelengths of light and radiation.

Activate—Future Sight r (fortune)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail or critically fail an attack roll or saving throw

Effect You roll the triggering attack roll or saving throw again, taking the second result.
Chronoculus Eye.name: Chronoculus Eye

Chronowatch.description:
This sleek smartwatch functions as a datapad, but it also features unique firmware and magical components that allow the user control over their own personal chronology.

Activate—

Access Chrono-App 1 (time)

Frequency once per day

Effect You open the chronowatch's specialized software, altering the flow of time for yourself. Select one of the following options.

Accelerate You speed up time, making yourself a minute older. One condition affecting you that would end within the next minute ends immediately instead.

Freeze You briefly halt time, giving you precious seconds to strategize. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} or [[/act seek]] up to three times, in any combination, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your Perception or skill checks to do so.

Rewind You rewind time, making yourself a minute younger. Choose one ongoing effect affecting you that started within the last minute and that you failed a saving throw
Chronowatch.name: Chronowatch

Clandestine Suit.description:
Upgrades: 0

This all-black bodysuit features two coattail-like cables hanging from the shoulders. When the suit's cloaking device is activated, the cables come alive and their tips project a gravitational field that bends light around the wearer. Clandestine suits always have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.PwEKIutKVOwGmk4o]{tactical active camouflage} and a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.efmRJxyFS6KUTeMr]{tactical cloaking device} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slots.
Clandestine Suit.name: Clandestine Suit

Claws (Commercial).description: Claws are grafted to the ends of your hands, feet, or other appropriate appendages. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
Claws (Commercial).name: Claws (Commercial)

Claws (Tactical).description:
Claws are grafted to the ends of your hands, feet, or other appropriate appendages. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

Whenever you critically hit with your claw unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.
Claws (Tactical).name: Claws (Tactical)

Climbing Kit (Commercial).description:
A commercial climbing kit includes 50 feet of cable line, a grappling hook, harnesses, pulleys, pitons, a hammer, and crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall.

A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.
Climbing Kit (Commercial).name: Climbing Kit (Commercial)

Climbing Kit (Tactical).description:
A commercial climbing kit includes 50 feet of cable line, a grappling hook, harnesses, pulleys, pitons, a hammer, and crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb while using a tactical climbing kit.

A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.
Climbing Kit (Tactical).name: Climbing Kit (Tactical)

Cloaking Device (Commercial).description:
This projector bends light around your body.

Activate—Bend Light 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell.
Cloaking Device (Commercial).name: Cloaking Device (Commercial)

Cloaking Device (Tactical).description:
This projector bends light around your body.

Activate—Bend Light 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Cloaking Device (Tactical).name: Cloaking Device (Tactical)

Cloaking Skin (Advanced).description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Activate—Cloak 1 (concentrate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect You gain the effects of 4nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} for 1 minute or until you spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to deactivate it.
Cloaking Skin (Advanced).name: Cloaking Skin (Advanced)

Activate 1 (manipulate)

A coagulant thickens the blood. For 10 minutes, you gain resistance 10 to persistent bleed and persistent poison damage and reduce the DC of the flat check to end persistent bleed and poison damage as if you received particularly appropriate aid.
Coagulant (Advanced).name: Coagulant (Advanced)

Coagulant (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A coagulant thickens the blood. For 10 minutes, you gain resistance 3 to persistent bleed and persistent poison damage and reduce the DC of the flat check to end persistent bleed and poison damage as if you received particularly appropriate aid.
Coagulant (Commercial).name: Coagulant (Commercial)

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Coagulant (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Coagulant (Tactical).name: Coagulant (Tactical)

Coalescing Ammunition.description: These rounds are coated in a dull gray, gritty substance that reacts with airborne particulates, condensing them harmlessly to the ground. When you hit a target that's within an airborne effect, such as a mist or toxic cloud spell, with this ammunition, the effect is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around the target until the end of your next turn.
Coalescing Ammunition.name: Coalescing Ammunition

Coat of the Crawl.description: This coat's slick oilcloth outer shell provides a strangely useful lubrication while moving through tight spaces or while prone. You can move up to half your normal move Speed when you [[/act crawl]]. Additionally, you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} 5 feet per round.
Coat of the Crawl.name: Coat of the Crawl

Cognition Accelerator.description:
A miniature supercomputer augments your brain's ability to process information. You gain a +3 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with any skill. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence modifier. You must select skills and languages when the augmentation is first installed, and they can't be changed.

Activate—Access Database 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect Immediately attempt three checks to Recall Knowledge about related topics, selecting each topic after learning the results of the prior checks. If you would fail one of these checks, you succeed instead.
Cognition Accelerator.name: Cognition Accelerator

Coil Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

The barrel of this rifle is surrounded by a coil that accelerates ammunition with power and accuracy using carefully aligned magnetic fields.
Coil Rifle.name: Coil Rifle

Comm Unit.description:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
Comm Unit.name: Comm Unit

Commando Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This tangy crimson elixir grants you 1d10+5 temporary Hit Points, as well as a +5-foot item bonus to any Speed you have for 1 minute. When you drink this serum, your veins protrude, and your eyes take on a reddish tinge.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.uf3Fb7Fm7dSzc7Os]{Effect: Commando Serum}
Commando Serum.name: Commando Serum

Compact Shield.description: This sleek shield is a favorite of operatives and other mobile combatants. It's most common design is a polycarbon panel contoured to fit snugly over a forearm or other limb.
Compact Shield.name: Compact Shield

Congealer Incense (Advanced).description:
This delicate strand of incense is packaged in a hand-blown glass vial and crafted from petrified wood of centuries-old Eoxian trees, peppered with a tincture of elebrian ashes and enchanted sand from the Deminas Ocean. When exposed to air by breaking the container, the incense bursts into cloying, lavender-scented smoke that sticks to incorporeal creatures and stabilizes their form.

Activate—Break Open 1 (manipulate)

Duration 1 minute

Effect Purple smoke billows out from the incense in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. At the start of each round, this emanation increases by 5 feet (to a maximum of 30 feet). The creature who activated the congealer incense can drop it in a space as a free action, or can continue to carry it with them in 1 hand, thus moving the center of the emanation on that creature's turn. Any incorporeal creature who enters this area or begins their turn inside of it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Treat the incorporeal creature's resistances as 4 lower.

Failure As success, but the creature loses all immunity to precision damage and treats its resistances as 8 lower.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
Congealer Incense (Advanced).name: Congealer Incense (Advanced)

These strange keycaps were left as a gift at the memorial of the deceased anacite, Tier-99-Professor.

Activate—Idle Typing 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZBeKxBcUOsXrfMRo]{Implant Data} spell.
Consecrated Keycaps.name: Consecrated Keycaps

Container (Designer).description:
Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.

You gain a +1 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on high society individuals while carrying a designer container, such as a designer handbag.
Container (Designer).name: Container (Designer)

Corona Serum (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

You gain resistance 15 to fire and weakness 8 to cold, and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were two steps less severe.
Corona Serum (Advanced).name: Corona Serum (Advanced)

Corona Serum (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

You gain resistance 5 to fire and weakness 2 to cold, and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less severe for 1 hour.

Corona Serum (Superior).description:

Corpseskin (Advanced).description: You graft the skin of one or more types of undead over your own, becoming cold to the touch. You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate corporeal undead and resistance 8 to void damage. A creature that would identify you as living, such as with lifesense, must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:10] or perceive you as undead instead.

Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d4[persistent,acid]]

When this grenade explodes, its @Template[burst|distance:10] is coated with a spray of corrosive acid, dealing acid damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

When this grenade explodes, its @Template[burst|distance:5] is coated with a spray of corrosive acid, dealing acid damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
