Cosmetic Cybernetics.description: While most creatures get cybernetic implants to enhance their bodies and minds or to restore lost abilities, many choose to make their enhancements as flashy as possible, matching their personal aesthetics or making a bold statement. Some, however, prefer to have just the flash, hold the enhancement. Cosmetic cybernetics have no mechanical benefit but alter your appearance in an obvious, dramatic way. They might represent cables and wires extending from your head or limbs, additional limbs that can't hold items, wings that can't fly, glowing patterns in your skin that offer no real illumination, a fiber-optic mohawk, or any of hundreds of other options, including those that resemble other types of augmentations. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Cosmetic Cybernetics.name: Cosmetic Cybernetics

Cosmic Connector.description:
This augmentation opens your mind to the underlying cosmic truths of the universe. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Reground in Reality r (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a saving throw against a magical effect

Effect You can reroll the save and use the better result.
Cosmic Connector.name: Cosmic Connector

Cosmic Defender Core.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate, polymorph)

This small silvery box is covered in fine circuitry. When you Activate the box by opening it, it reveals a bright blue light and engulfs you in crackling energy that expands to form an enormous hardlight robot, with you in a central cockpit. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the effect or are reduced to 0 Hit Points. The robot is a battle form that grants you the following statistics and abilities.

  • AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

  • 25 temporary Hit Points

  • Speed 40 feet, fly Speed 70 feet

  • Darkvision

  • The following unarmed attacks, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them, your attack modifier is +31, and you use the listed damage. Both attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead;

  • Melee 1 stellar blade (reach 15 feet), Damage 3d12+15 slashing;

  • Ranged 1 galactic beam (range increment 120 feet), Damage 6d6+6 force.

  • Athletics modifier of +33, unless your own is higher.
Cosmic Defender Core.name: Cosmic Defender Core

Creator Capsule (Advanced).description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jiNuKNa9NcU27Bh2]{Fabricator} skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 1 hour of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

Crimson Claw.description:
Upgrades: 1

This clawed glove's tips end in sharp steel points that glow bright red with superheated veins of trace starmetal alloys.
Crimson Claw.name: Crimson Claw

Crossbolter.description:
Upgrades: 1

This high-tech crossbow uses a series of pistons to propel bolts along its barrel. These quiet-firing semiautomatic weapons are popular in high-density settlements where gunfire might cause a panic.
Crossbolter.name: Crossbolter

Cryo-Carbine.description:
Upgrades: 1

These low-density carbon fiber rifles use a more compact model to allow for longer range cryo damage than their pistol counterparts.
Cryo-Carbine.name: Cryo-Carbine

Cryolizer.description:
This hyperthermic reducing module can be used to tactfully incapacitate enemies using cryogenics.

Activate—Cryolize r (cold)

Trigger You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with damage from the installed weapon

Effect The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be frozen solid, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until it's thawed (using a medkit and substantial hot water for an hour), instead of dying. The target can choose to fail its save.
Cryolizer.name: Cryolizer

Cryopike.description:
Upgrades: 1

This polearm's shaft houses rapidly circulating supercooled gas that condenses and channels endothermic energy into a cryogenic blade.
Cryopike.name: Cryopike

Cryoplate.description:
Internal magical components, often crafted from cold siccatite or a similar material, keep the surface of this thin, 1 foot– diameter disc just below the local freezing point of water. Used as the centerpiece of upscale catering set-ups to keep chilly treats or ice sculptures from melting, the cryoplate can also be put to tactical purposes in a pinch.

Activate—Flash Freezer Trap 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You prime the cryoplate and throw it up to 30 feet, creating a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-foot radius burst} of sudden freezing temperature that makes the area difficult terrain for 1 minute. Any creatures occupying or attempting to move through the affected terrain must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:23|showDC:all|options:inflicts:prone,inflicts:suppressed] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until it leaves the difficult terrain, and for 1 round thereafter.

Failure As success, except the target is suppressed for 2 rounds thereafter.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Cryoplate.name: Cryoplate

This electric-blue crystal crackles with energy. When you activate the shockshard, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute. If the target has the tech trait, it instead becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.

Cycling Crystal.description:
A cycling crystal gives you greater control over the cycle of energies flowing through your solar manifestations.

Activate—Halt Cycle f (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You critically hit with your solar weapon or solar flare as part of an action with the cycle trait

Effect You can choose whether to change your attunement state or remain in your current attunement state.
Cycling Crystal.name: Cycling Crystal

Danger Sensor (Advanced).description: This advanced sensor and microprocessor suite, installed directly into your central nervous system, automatically detects incoming danger and signals your brain in nanoseconds, improving your reaction time when you need it most. You gain a +3 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative or against hostile creatures and hazards.
Danger Sensor (Advanced).name: Danger Sensor (Advanced)

Danger Sensor (Commercial).description: This advanced sensor and microprocessor suite, installed directly into your central nervous system, automatically detects incoming danger and signals your brain in nanoseconds, improving your reaction time when you need it most. You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative or against hostile creatures and hazards within 60 feet.
Danger Sensor (Commercial).name: Danger Sensor (Commercial)

Danger Sensor (Tactical).description: This advanced sensor and microprocessor suite, installed directly into your central nervous system, automatically detects incoming danger and signals your brain in nanoseconds, improving your reaction time when you need it most. Danger Sensor (Tactical).name: Danger Sensor (Tactical)

Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial).description: These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.
Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial).name: Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial)

Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical).description:
These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.

These upgraded capacitors include a wide-spectrum ocular implant that allows you to see infrared and ultraviolet light, including the lasers from other darkvision capacitors. You gain darkvision and a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} if they involve sight.
Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical).name: Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical)

Darkvision Visor.description: This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.
Darkvision Visor.name: Darkvision Visor

Data Chip.description: A data chip contains enough memory for a religious text, photo album, personal journal, or the like. You can view the information on a data chip with a computer, such as the one in your comm unit.
Data Chip.name: Data Chip

Datajack (Advanced).description:
This cybernetic is a programmable data port installed into your body, allowing you to access computers and digital storage devices. Any handheld computer can connect to the port, while larger systems typically require an adapter cable. You don't need an interface to access the system, as it connects directly to your nervous system via the datajack. You must still attempt any skill checks associated with operating the device, such as Computers to access a system. Some closed systems don't allow direct data access at all.

You gain a +2 item bonus to Computers checks when accessing a system with an advanced datajack.
Datajack (Advanced).name: Datajack (Advanced)

Datapad.description: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
Datapad.name: Datapad

Defiance Series.description:
Upgrades: 1

This squad armor is a molded shell of reinforced polycarbon with a helmet and retractable visor.
Defiance Series.name: Defiance Series

Deflecting Field.description: This shield isn't held—instead, it's installed as an armor or weapon upgrade. A deflecting field appears as a translucent panel integrated into the upgraded item and creates a temporary protective hardlight barrier when activated.
Deflecting Field.name: Deflecting Field

Defrex Hide.description:
Upgrades: 1

Made from the hide of a ferocious mammal native to Vesk-2, this medium armor is especially popular among vesk. Tanned slabs of the creature's thick hide are stitched together with metal wires, and the joints are reinforced with metal studs or scales.
Defrex Hide.name: Defrex Hide

Degeneration Derringer.description:
Upgrades: 1

This close-range pistol fires small cannisters that burst into a corrosive gas, often used to destroy dangerous objects.
Degeneration Derringer.name: Degeneration Derringer

Degradation Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[persistent,acid]] damage

Degradation grenades create violent blasts of magic that rip matter into different realities, leaving behind blackened hunks of matter that dissipate into nothingness. When the grenade explodes, it deals 3d8 acid damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
Degradation Grenade (Advanced).name: Degradation Grenade (Advanced)

Dermal Plating (Advanced).description: Hardened plates protect your skin and help you deflect physical blows. A limb with dermal plating functions as a shield. You can Raise a Shield with your limb, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use. You can use the Shield Block reaction with your limb. Dermal plating has Hardness 15. After you use Shield Block, your dermal plating becomes damaged and can't be used for 24 hours as the nanites repair the durable plates.

Despair Crystal.description:
Created from the concentrated psychic echoes of anguish and pain, a despair crystal is a fist-sized, red gem.

Activate—Crack Crystal 1 (manipulate)

Effect You crack the despair crystal open, causing it to release its pent-up pain at a single target within 60 feet. The target is dealt @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19|basic|options:inflicts:stupefied] save. On a failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (for 1 minute on a critical failure).
Despair Crystal.name: Despair Crystal

Despoiler Maw (Advanced).description:
Developed by a team of scientists who experienced a Swarm attack firsthand, this augmentation is inspired by how they appropriated resources from the worlds they despoiled. The despoiler maw is implanted in the back of your throat and allows you to expel thick, noxious acid, then harvest the smoke left behind by its victims into raw materials.

Activate—Spew Acid 2 (acid, magical)

Frequency twice per day

Effect You exhale a torrent of acid in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Creatures and objects in the area take @Damage[6d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save). For each living creature you damage this way, you generate one tube of a bland nutritional paste that contains enough nutrition to function as sustenance for a day. If you damage at least one object or nonliving creature, you can spend 1 minute to gather a number of UPBs equal to the damage dealt.
Despoiler Maw (Advanced).name: Despoiler Maw (Advanced)

Effect You exhale a torrent of acid in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Creatures and objects in the area take @Damage[10d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic] save). For each living creature you damage this way, you generate one tube of a bland nutritional paste that contains enough nutrition to function as sustenance for a day. If you damage at least one object or nonliving creature, you can spend 1 minute to gather a number of UPBs equal to the damage dealt.
Despoiler Maw (Superior).name: Despoiler Maw (Superior)

Despoiler Maw (Tactical).description:
Developed by a team of scientists who experienced a Swarm attack firsthand, this augmentation is inspired by how they appropriated resources from the worlds they despoiled. The despoiler maw is implanted in the back of your throat and allows you to expel thick, noxious acid, then harvest the smoke left behind by its victims into raw materials.

Activate—Spew Acid 2 (acid, magical)

Frequency once per day

Effect You exhale a torrent of acid in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Creatures and objects in the area take @Damage[4d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save). For each living creature you damage this way, you generate one tube of a bland nutritional paste that contains enough nutrition to function as sustenance for a day. If you damage at least one object or nonliving creature, you can spend 1 minute to gather a number of UPBs equal to the damage dealt.
Despoiler Maw (Tactical).name: Despoiler Maw (Tactical)

Dirge Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This small pistol is often used to disorient the enemy with bursts of sound described by many as a cacophony of screams.
Dirge Pistol.name: Dirge Pistol

Disc Thrower.description: Little more than a narrow curved channel installed along a weapon's haft or blade, a disc thrower uses the momentum of the wielder's swing to fling a razor-edged circular blade. The disc returns to the weapon at the end of its flight, where it's recaptured by magnetic fields in the launcher.
Disc Thrower.name: Disc Thrower

Disintegration Lash.description:
Upgrades: 1

Appearing as an undulating black snake when powered, this whip crackles with red-tinged energy that sunders whatever it strikes at the atomic level.
Disintegration Lash.name: Disintegration Lash

Disintegration Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

Despite using shells, shots fired from disintegration rifles contain ionized condensed chemical gas rather than physical projectiles, and as such, specific ammunition, including magic ammunition and ammunition made using special materials, don't affect Strikes with a disintegration rifle. Living creatures brought to 0 Hit Points by a disintegration rifle leave behind no corpse, but their gear is unaffected.
Disintegration Rifle.name: Disintegration Rifle

Disintegrator Module.description:
These frequency modulators enhance disintegrating weapons.

Activate—Disintegrate r (death, incapacitation)

Trigger You roll a natural 20 on a Strike with the installed weapon and deal acid or fire damage

Effect The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:38] save or be reduced to ashes. This instantly kills a corporeal creature and generally destroys any non-magical items on its body.
Disintegrator Module.name: Disintegrator Module

Distributed Blast Unit.description:
This altered energy projection unit extends the lifetime of the exotic particles used by the weapon in lingering energy pools.

Activate—Reigning Fire 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Area Fire the installed weapon, the affected area becomes hazardous terrain for 1 minute. The hazardous terrain deals @Damage[1[untyped]] damage per weapon damage die of the same damage type as the installed weapon.
Distributed Blast Unit.name: Distributed Blast Unit

Diva's Microphone (Advanced).description:
This ostentatious crystal microphone is embellished with glimmering jewels and delicate lights that pulse in time to music. It functions as both a microphone and speaker, amplifying your voice loud enough for you to be heard clearly by all listeners up to 500 feet away, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. This doesn't increase the range or area of other auditory or linguistic effects, and physical barriers such as walls still block or muffle your voice as normal.

The diva's microphone grants a +3 item bonus to Performance checks attempted with it.

Activate—Grand Finale 2 (auditory)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Your song reaches an eardrum-bursting climax as you cast a 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QpP30fcEl4NGjHwo]{Sonic Scream} originating from your space (DC 38).
Diva's Microphone (Advanced).name: Diva's Microphone (Advanced)

Divinity Jammer.description: This magitech weapon upgrade is designed to muddle the mind and strain a target's connection to the divine. On a critical hit with the weapon, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn. If the target is a celestial, fiend, monitor, or creature with divine spells or abilities, it becomes stupefied 1 for 3 rounds instead.
Divinity Jammer.name: Divinity Jammer

Dizzying Anesthetic.description:
Activate 2 (manipulate)

Pulled from the internal reserves of a nodocite experimenter and concentrated into a more potent form, this poison causes intense dizziness in those infected, which in turn induces clumsiness and fatigue.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:15]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, clumsy 1, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 round)
Dizzying Anesthetic.name: Dizzying Anesthetic

Dogslicer.description:
Upgrades: 1

Goblins cherish ancestral melee weapons called dogslicers and horsechoppers, but most people don't understand why. Goblin weapons are easy to make but prone to breakage.
Dogslicer.name: Dogslicer

Doorkicker Datamine (Advanced).description:
When the autohack program is active, the UI on this datamine features an 8-bit lockpicking minigame that can be played while the program Hacks particularly complex locks. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to open, close, lock, or unlock a door.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine quickly attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hack} a door's computer to open, close, lock, or unlock the door. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the door with a +16 modifier and expert skill proficiency.
Doorkicker Datamine (Advanced).name: Doorkicker Datamine (Advanced)

Doshkalani.description: A doshkalani is a vesk shield that mixes defense and offense, featuring a ridge of spikes like those on a doshko.
Doshkalani.name: Doshkalani

Doshko.description:
Upgrades: 1

The traditional weapon of the Veskarium, this powered poleaxe features one to three triangular blades forged for both wide overhead swings and tactical parrying.
Doshko.name: Doshko

Dragon Gland (Advanced).description:
With cutting edge surgery, you're implanted with an magical gland modified to function for a creature of your ancestry at the back of your throat. Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

Activate—Exhale 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] takes @Damage[(4d6)[untyped]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.
Dragon Gland (Advanced).name: Dragon Gland (Advanced)

Dragonsight Flashlight.description:
The latest innovation from Frozen Trove Labs is a tactical flashlight with special filters which can be activated to locate hidden objects.

Activate—Enhancement Filter 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect All creatures gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to locate hidden things in the area of the dragonsight flashlight's light, such as hidden traps and secret doors, for 30 minutes.
Dragonsight Flashlight.name: Dragonsight Flashlight

Dreamlink Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A glossy purple syrup swirled with streaks of black and green. After drinking this serum, your mind drifts and latches onto psychic impressions from the Newborn, granting you esoteric knowledge and alien wisdom at the expense of your current awareness. You gain a +2 item bonus to Occultism and Religion checks for 10 minutes. Once during the duration, you can roll a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} twice and use the better result (this is a fortune effect); if you roll a 1 or a 20 twice using this fortune effect, you glimpse the silhouette of a mysterious figure in the corner of your eye and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
Dreamlink Serum.name: Dreamlink Serum

Drift Drive Relay (Advanced).description:
This advanced containment unit stores and channels entangled Drift particles, allowing you to briefly flicker into the Drift as you move. When you successfully [[/act tumble-through]] a creature's space, you don't treat its squares as difficult terrain.

As a 10-minute activity, you can attune this armor upgrade to a Drift engine you can physically access to further enhance the relay's abilities.

Activate—Warp 2

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

Effect You warp through space, gaining the effects of a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} spell.

Activate—Drift Homeward 3 (concentrate, manipulate, teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

Effect You fall fully into the Drift, teleporting to a space adjacent to the Drift engine your armor is attuned to.
Drift Drive Relay (Advanced).name: Drift Drive Relay (Advanced)

Drift Pulse Ammunition.description:
These rounds are transparent canisters filled with swirling green gas. Once fired, the projectile phases in and out of the Universe, allowing it to pass through barriers between you and your target. Strikes made with this ammunition treat the target's cover as one stage lower (none instead of lesser, lesser instead of standard, or standard instead of greater).

Activate—Controlled Pulse 1 (manipulate)

Requirements You're wielding a weapon loaded with drift pulse ammunition

Effect You adjust the parameters of your pulse shot to account for physical barriers between you and your target. If your next action is to Strike with the required weapon, the target doesn't benefit from cover. In addition, the Strike can target a creature you don't have line of effect to as long as there's no more than 5 feet of material between you and it; you treat such a creature as invisible.
Drift Pulse Ammunition.name: Drift Pulse Ammunition

Drift Valve (Commercial).description:
Your heart is linked to a miniature Drift portal on an automatic switch, instantly transporting you through the Drift in response to a high heart rate to take you away from danger. This augmentation was inspired by prismenis and their close connection to the Drift, though its effects are far more limited.

Activate—Drift Charge r (magical, teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You take damage

Effect You teleport up to 30 feet. The destination must be within your line of sight and line of effect.
Drift Valve (Commercial).name: Drift Valve (Commercial)

Drift Valve (Tactical).description:
Your heart is linked to a miniature Drift portal on an automatic switch, instantly transporting you through the Drift in response to a high heart rate to take you away from danger. This augmentation was inspired by prismenis and their close connection to the Drift, though its effects are far more limited.

Activate—Drift Charge r (magical, teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You take damage

Effect You teleport up to 30 feet. The destination must be within your line of sight and line of effect.

When you Drift Charge, you can attempt to swap places with another creature within 30 feet instead of teleporting to a free space. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] saving throw.

Success The target remains where it is, and you teleport to a free space adjacent to it.

Failure You switch places with the target, and the target takes the triggering damage along with you.

Critical Failure You switch places with the target, and the target takes the triggering damage instead of you.
Drift Valve (Tactical).name: Drift Valve (Tactical)

Drifter's Jacket.description:
Upgrades: 1

This stylish jacket comes equipped with integrated environmental protections and air thrusters to aid zero-g mobility. It also features two bulky shoulder pads that conceal a localized Drift transportation device. Drifter's jackets always have a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.svVf0omcrf3rv63C]{commercial Drift drive relay} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
Drifter's Jacket.name: Drifter's Jacket

Duality Circuit (Advanced).description:
This bleeding-edge runic mesh absorbs and redirects the fundamental energies of life and death.

Activate—Absorb r (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take damage from or be healed by a vitality or void effect

Effect You gain resistance to the triggering damage equal to four times your level or reduce the number of Hit Points you regain by the same amount.

Activate—Redirect 1 to 3 (manipulate)

Requirements You've used the Absorb reaction since the end of your last turn

Effect You invert and redirect the absorbed energy. You cast a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell with the same number of actions you spent on the activation. If you absorbed a void effect, you cast heal, and if you absorbed a vitality effect, you cast harm.
Duality Circuit (Advanced).name: Duality Circuit (Advanced)

Dueling Sword.description:
Upgrades: 1

Coming in a variety of styles, these traditional and time-tested weapons have been honed with advanced smithing techniques and modern materials.
Dueling Sword.name: Dueling Sword

Duo-Enhancers.description:
This magitech interface is a sophisticated pair of linked bracers, wristbands, gloves, or other garments suitable to the part of a creature's anatomy it uses to wield weapons. One of the paired enhancers includes a screen that displays data about the weapons the wearer is wielding, and the other enhancer contains magical crystals. When you wield a weapon in the hand wearing the display, the weapon's grade (such as tactical) is replicated onto the weapon you're wielding in the hand with the crystal enhancer, but only for purposes of determining the weapon's extra damage dice and tracking trait (which adds an item bonus to attack rolls). Any other properties of the weapon, such as its damage type, ammo, or upgrades, aren't replicated.

The replication functions only if you wear both enhancers, and it ends as soon as you cease wielding a weapon in one of your hands. Consequently, the benefit doesn't apply to thrown attacks or if you're holding a weapon but not wielding it (such as holding in one hand a weapon that requires two hands to wield, or holding a weapon in non-active hands).
Duo-Enhancers.name: Duo-Enhancers

Dupestick (Advanced).description:
Dupesticks are illegally modified credsticks whose value can be changed by Hacking them as a 1-minute activity. Recognizing this dupestick is fake requires a successful @Check[computers|dc:30] check or @Check[perception|dc:38] check.

This dupestick can store real credits on it, but attempting to withdraw more credits than are stored on it results in an error that automatically exposes the true nature of the dupestick.

In addition to storing real credits on it, you can switch the amount displayed on this dupestick to the actual number of credits on it as an Interact action.
Dupestick (Advanced).name: Dupestick (Advanced)

Dupestick (Commercial).description: Dupesticks are illegally modified credsticks whose value can be changed by Hacking them as a 1-minute activity. Recognizing that they are fake requires a successful @Check[computers|dc:15] check or @Check[perception|dc:18] check. Depositing or withdrawing credits from a dupestick to any other credstick results in an error that automatically exposes the true nature of the dupestick.
Dupestick (Commercial).name: Dupestick (Commercial)

Dupestick (Superior).description:
Dupesticks are illegally modified credsticks whose value can be changed by Hacking them as a 1-minute activity. Recognizing this dupestick is fake requires a successful @Check[computers|dc:40] check or @Check[perception|dc:48] check.

This dupestick can store real credits on it, but attempting to withdraw more credits than are stored on it results in an error that automatically exposes the true nature of the dupestick.

In addition to storing real credits on it, you can switch the amount displayed on this dupestick to the actual number of credits on it as an Interact action.

It takes 1 minute for an error message to appear when transferring credits, as if the transfer was being delayed due to a technical glitch. No error will display if the dupestick is physically removed before the error message is displayed.
Dupestick (Superior).name: Dupestick (Superior)

Easypatcher (Advanced).description:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to four medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

Activate—Patch Up 1 (manipulate)

Requirements A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

Effect The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.

You can replicate the consumed medpatch's effect on a creature up to 10 feet away instead of yourself
Easypatcher (Advanced).name: Easypatcher (Advanced)

Easypatcher (Commercial).description:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to two medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

Activate—Patch Up 1 (manipulate)

Requirements A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

Effect The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.

Elastic Skin (Advanced).description: Your skin appears normal for your species but stretches dramatically when pulled, giving you more freedom of movement in tight spaces. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics or Athletics checks to Escape or Squeeze.
Elastic Skin (Advanced).name: Elastic Skin (Advanced)

Elastic Skin (Commercial).description: Your skin appears normal for your species but stretches dramatically when pulled, giving you more freedom of movement in tight spaces. You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics or Athletics checks to Escape or Squeeze.

Electroencephalon.description:
This magical matrix records the consciousness, thoughts, and soul of a necrovite and also grants a limited form of telepathy. Such augmented psychic awareness is key to the process of preserving a necrovite's memories when their body is destroyed, including memories of whatever caused their destruction.

When a necrovite is destroyed, electroencephalon begins rebuilding their their physical form over the next 1d10 days. Not even disintegrating a necrovite's corpse can fully destroy the creature. The necrovite's new body manifests next to the electroencephalon, fully healed but without any equipment from their old body.

A standard electroencephalon is a piece of complex magitech about the size of a comm unit that has been constructed via occult means. This device typically has Hardness 10 and 40 HP.
Electroencephalon.name: Electroencephalon

Electroflail.description:
Upgrades: 1

A favored weapon of Hellknights of the Order of the Eclipse, the spiked head of this menacing flail is attached to a 2-foot-long chain that ominously suspends itself for a few seconds after each deadly blow, crackling with electricity capable of frying foes and circuits alike. If you're trained with an electroflail, on a critical hit with a Strike or [[/act trip]] attempt, you confer the glitching condition with a value equal to twice your weapon dice to one tech item wielded by your target (or the target themself, if they have the tech trait).
Electroflail.name: Electroflail

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}

These grenades discharge a shocking field that deals 3d8 electricity damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, tech creatures and unattended tech items that critically fail their saving throw against electromag grenades become glitching.
Electromag Grenade (Advanced).name: Electromag Grenade (Advanced)

Electronic Guard Dog (Commercial).description:
This electronic "guard dog" resembles a squat black box the size of a toaster with a screen. Upgraded versions use holograms to resemble guard dogs, although many are customized to resemble more exotic pets, ranging from hell hounds to baby wyverns.

These speakers are tied to motion sensors that, when activated, emit the realistic sounds of an agitated barking canine. Like a real dog, the barking grows louder and more frequent the closer the subject approaches. It has the following statistics: +12 Intimidation; +15 Perception.

Assigning authorized users and establishing an electronic guard dog's territory takes 10 minutes.

Activate—Dogged Deterrence r (auditory)

Trigger The guard dog detects an unauthorized creature within its designated territory

Effect The electronic guard dog attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] one unauthorized creature within 30 feet, using 5 charges of the electronic guard dog's battery.
Electronic Guard Dog (Commercial).name: Electronic Guard Dog (Commercial)

Electronic Guard Dog (Tactical).description:

Upgraded versions use holograms to resemble guard dogs, although many are customized to resemble more exotic pets, ranging from hell hounds to baby wyverns. Assigning authorized users and establishing an electronic guard dog's territory takes 10 minutes.

This projects a holographic depiction of a Medium-sized creature to scare intruders. The item's sensors are just responsive enough for it to calculate how to lunge at intruders without getting close enough to make contact. It has the following statistics: +21 Intimidation (on a critical success to [[/act demoralize]], the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round); +18 Perception.

Activate—Dogged Deterrence r (auditory)

Trigger The guard dog detects an unauthorized creature within its designated territory

Effect The electronic guard dog attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] one unauthorized creature within 30 feet, using 5 charges of the electronic guard dog's battery.
Electronic Guard Dog (Tactical).name: Electronic Guard Dog (Tactical)

Emergency Beacon.description: This item requires a battery to be installed for it to operate. When activated, this small, pod-shaped device transmits its location and emits a flash of bright red light once per round, consuming 1 charge per day. Any device capable of receiving signals can pick up a signal from an emergency beacon, which can then be traced with a successful @Check[computers|dc:15] or @Check[survival|dc:15] check. An emergency beacon's transmissions have a range of 100 miles over flat terrain, 50 miles in forests or hills, and 25 miles in mountainous terrain or underwater. Alternatively, an emergency beacon can be installed in a starship's or vehicle's communications system. In this case, its range is equal to that of the communications array, and it consumes 1 charge per hour.
Emergency Beacon.name: Emergency Beacon

Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Advanced).description:
This pliable bladder placed in your abdominal cavity produces specially designed enzymes. On command, the bladder's contents rapidly catalyze, inflating the bladder and dramatically reducing your body's density. The bladder can only keep you afloat, so you must still Swim to move horizontally.

Activate—Bloat 1

Frequency once per day

Effect The bladder inflates. You rise to the surface of a body of any liquid (or gas denser than air) at a rate of 60 feet per round. Once you reach the surface, you float for up to 8 hours or until you deflate the bladder with a single Interact action.
Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Advanced).name: Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Advanced)

Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Commercial).description:

Activate—Bloat 1

Frequency once per day

Effect The bladder inflates. You rise to the surface of a body of water (or any liquid denser than water) at a rate of 20 feet per round. Once you reach the surface, you float for 30 minutes or until you deflate the bladder with a single Interact action.
Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Commercial).name: Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Commercial)

Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Tactical).description:

Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Tactical).name: Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Tactical)

Energized Spikes (Advanced).description:
These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

Activate—Impale f

Frequency once per round

Trigger Your turn begins

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

Effect You deal @Damage[8d4[untyped]] damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.
Energized Spikes (Advanced).name: Energized Spikes (Advanced)

Energy Shielding (Advanced).description: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 15 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.
Energy Shielding (Advanced).name: Energy Shielding (Advanced)

The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

Energy Shielding (Tactical).name: Energy Shielding (Tactical)

Enervating Hand (Advanced).description:
Your hand is infused with void energies, causing it to drain the vitality of creatures you touch.

Activate—Draining Touch 2 (void)

Frequency once per day

Effect You empower your hand to drain the energy of a living creature within reach. The target attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} until the start of your next turn. For 1 minute, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the Hit Points the target lost due to the drained condition.

Failure The target becomes drained 1 for 1 minute. For 1 minute, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points the target lost due to the drained condition.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial).description: Tendrils of dark energy soar from the unit affixed to this weapon, coating it and its ammunition in a disturbing purple hue. When you hit with the weapon, add 1d4 void damage to the damage dealt. In addition, on a critical hit, the target takes 2d4 persistent void damage; if the target has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of persistent damage (its wielder rolls the flat check to see if the persistent damage ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.
Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial).name: Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial)

Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical).description:
Tendrils of dark energy soar from the unit affixed to this weapon, coating it and its ammunition in a disturbing purple hue. When you hit with the weapon, add 1d4 void damage to the damage dealt. In addition, on a critical hit, the target takes 4d4 persistent void damage; if the target has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of persistent damage (its wielder rolls the flat check to see if the persistent damage ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.

The void damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's void resistance or immunity.
Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical).name: Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical)

Environmental Inverter (Commercial).description:
This small medallion depicts half a snowflake on one side and half a sun on the other. It can be worn anywhere on your person, usually attached to an article of clothing or jewelry.

Activate—Invert Temperature 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You invert the weather in your space. Creatures in the affected area treat the current temperature as the opposite—mild cold becomes mild heat, severe heat becomes severe cold, and so on. You can deactivate the effect as a single Interact action. This effect lasts 8 hours or until you Dismiss it.
Environmental Inverter (Commercial).name: Environmental Inverter (Commercial)

Environmental Inverter (Tactical).description:
This small medallion depicts half a snowflake on one side and half a sun on the other. It can be worn anywhere on your person, usually attached to an article of clothing or jewelry.

Activate—Invert Temperature 1 (aura, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Area 10-foot emanation

Effect You invert the weather in your space. Creatures in the affected area treat the current temperature as the opposite—mild cold becomes mild heat, severe heat becomes severe cold, and so on. You can deactivate the effect as a single Interact action. This effect lasts 8 hours or until you Dismiss it.
Environmental Inverter (Tactical).name: Environmental Inverter (Tactical)

Ephemeral Exoskeleton.description:
This set of small bands encircle your wrists, elbows, chest, hips, knees and ankles, each embedded with a small glowing crystal. When worn together, ghostly machinery connects these bands, forming an exoskeleton that supplements your strength and endurance and gives you one foot in the Ethereal Plane. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks, and you can carry an additional 3 Bulk without becoming encumbered.

Activate—Slip Between 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You slip partially into the Ethereal Plane until the end of your next turn. Creatures on the Universe can't see you, and you can move through objects and walls in the Universe. You can still see onto the Universe, though anything there is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you. You can't affect the Universe and can't be affected by the Universe, except by ghost killer upgrades and similar effects, which treat you as an incorporeal creature. You move at half your normal Speeds but can move in any direction (including up and down).

When the effect ends, you return fully to the Universe. If you're in the air, you fall (unless you can fly), and if you're inside an object, you're pushed to the nearest open space and take @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage per 5 feet you were pushed. You can extend the effect by 1 round when you Sustain it, to a maximum duration of 1 minute.
Ephemeral Exoskeleton.name: Ephemeral Exoskeleton

Estex Suit.description:
Upgrades: 1

This bulky flight suit is reinforced with thin polycarbon panels sewn between layers of tactical fabric.
Estex Suit.name: Estex Suit

Evolutionary Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

These jellyfish-like symbiotes are commonplace on Bretheda. For much of the planet's history, their properties weren't well-understood since native barathus have little need for the symbiote's benefits. When offworlders first arrived on exploratory missions, however, they found the living spacesuits immensely useful.
Evolutionary Armor.name: Evolutionary Armor

Exhaust Disperal Unit (Advanced).description:
This upgrade vents the weapon's exhaust into propulsion.

Activate—Exhaust Vents f (manipulate)

Frequency once per round

Trigger You Area Fire or Strike with the installed weapon

Effect You can Push Off in a direction of your choice without needing a free appendage. You float up to your Speed when you Push Off or, if you aren’t untethered, you can Leap.
Exhaust Disperal Unit (Advanced).name: Exhaust Disperal Unit (Advanced)

This upgrade vents the weapon's exhaust into propulsion.

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You Area Fire or Strike with the installed weapon

Explorer's Canteen.description:
This thermos has two compartments. The upper compartment contains nanomachines and filters that target common contaminants, making most food and water safe to consume and granting a +1 item bonus to saves against any poisons or diseases present in the food or water. The lower compartment converts inserted UPBs into edible nutri-paste at a rate of 2 UPBs per 1 day of nourishment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.52tyG1y50LmTqCA9]{Effect: Explorer's Canteen}
Explorer's Canteen.name: Explorer's Canteen

Explosive Defense Unit.description:
Reinforced custom armor plates automatically generate a containment field to protect you from nearby explosions, granting you resistance 2 to area damage (acid, cold, electricity, and fire damage only). You can also store a grenade in the explosive defense unit and detonate it without harming yourself.

Activate—Store Grenade 2 (manipulate)

Effect You place a grenade inside a reinforced compartment in the explosive defense unit. You can Interact to retrieve the grenade normally. You can store only one grenade in the armor upgrade at a time.

Activate—Defensive Detonation 1 (manipulate)

Requirements You have a stored grenade

Filament Mesh (Advanced).description:
A network of filaments drawn from tashtari fur is implanted under your skin, allowing you to absorb and release solar radiation. The mesh is faintly visible as a reflective tracery under your skin when exposed to bright light. Your filament mesh is charged if you've spent at least 4 of the past 24 hours in bright light or direct sunlight. The mesh can't absorb or release light if your skin is completely covered by protective gear, though armor or clothing can be adjusted at no additional cost to accommodate this augmentation.

Activate—Solar Flash 2 (visual)

Requirements Your filament mesh is charged

Effect You discharge the solar energy stored in your filament mesh, creating an intense flash. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 2 rounds.

Flechette Launcher (Tactical).name: Flechette Launcher (Tactical)

Flesh Eater Ammunition.description: The heads of these menacing rounds look like teeth, often etched with strange symbols. This ammunition deals an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,void]] damage on a successful Strike, and on a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for as long as it takes this void damage, as the projectile feeds on its blood.
Flesh Eater Ammunition.name: Flesh Eater Ammunition

Flight Suit.description:
Upgrades: 0

This comfortable coverall is made from lightweight thermal fabric and often adorned with patches displaying personal insignia, military rank, or even favorite bands or sports teams.
Flight Suit.name: Flight Suit

Fly Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} spell
Fly Spell Amp.name: Fly Spell Amp

Force Field (Advanced).description:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 20 Hit Points and replenishes 4 Hit Points on your turn, and @Check[flat|dc:19].

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{Effect: Force Field 20}

Activate—Raise Force Field 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect Your force field becomes active. It remains active for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.

SFS Note: If a PC takes damage with both a force field up and a shield raised, the force field takes damage first. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} only triggers if there is damage remaining afterwards, at which point the shield would potentially be damaged.
Force Field (Advanced).name: Force Field (Advanced)

Force Needle.description:
Upgrades: 1

When a full vial of liquid is inserted into the bottom of this weapon's hilt, it creates an energy needle to hold and inject its payload.
Force Needle.name: Force Needle

Forceful Evolution.description: Through magical manipulation of your genes, you can temporarily access the abilities of other species. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat from a different ancestry than your own, chosen when you install this augmentation. You must meet the other prerequisites for this feat. By spending 1 hour and 500 credits' worth of genetic material, you can change this feat to a different one, which doesn't need to be from the same ancestry. Since the feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like another feat. In addition, you take on traits that are common in the chosen ancestry, such as antennae for shirren or cheek pouches for ysoki. These changes are vestigial and have no mechanical effect other than the feat you gained, but they're always noticeable and memorable.
Forceful Evolution.name: Forceful Evolution

Fractal Hook.description:
Upgrades: 2

These weapons are curved with repeating fractals that grow smaller along its edge, capable of sawing through nearly anything. If you're trained with this weapon and Strike a creature taking persistent damage, the creature doesn't recover from persistent damage unless it rolls a 20 on the flat check (or 15, if it's receiving a particularly appropriate type of help). This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.
Fractal Hook.name: Fractal Hook

Frag Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 3d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
Frag Grenade (Advanced).name: Frag Grenade (Advanced)

Frag Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 1d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

Critical @Damage[1d6[bleed]]

Frag Grenade (Elite).name: Frag Grenade (Elite)

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 8d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:15] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
Frag Grenade (Superior).name: Frag Grenade (Superior)

Critical @Damage[1d4[bleed]]

Freebooter Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.
Freebooter Armor.name: Freebooter Armor

Frost Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 10 foot cirumstance penalty to base Speed for 1 round

A frost grenade explodes into ice shards, dealing cold damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save. If you have the critical weapon specialization of grenades, creatures that critically fail their saving throw against frost grenades gain a circumstance penalty of 10 feet to their base Speed for 1 round.
Frost Grenade (Advanced).name: Frost Grenade (Advanced)

Frost Module (Commercial).description: This module siphons the heat from the weapon's striking edge and ammunition, powering itself with the excess energy as it chills the air around it. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:24] save.
Frost Module (Commercial).name: Frost Module (Commercial)

Frost Module (Tactical).description:
This module siphons the heat from the weapon's striking edge and ammunition, powering itself with the excess energy as it chills the air around it. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34] save.

Cold damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's cold resistance.
Frost Module (Tactical).name: Frost Module (Tactical)

Frostmaw.description:
Upgrades: 1

The study of Triaxan space worms in cryo-anesthesia research led to first frostmaw, an armored, toothy tube that can be wielded as a weapon. A frostmaw can't be reloaded, but the liquid inside regenerates at a rate of 1 projectile every round. These weapons are living creatures that can be directed by telepathic wielders. Unlike most area weapons, a frostmaw can be used to make ranged Strikes, expending a single projectile with a range increment of 15 feet.
Frostmaw.name: Frostmaw

Frytech Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle is capable of disrupting technology. It deploys a telescoping ring containing spools of wire that glow blue with electromagnetic energy. When you Area Fire with a frytech rifle you're trained with, you can expend 10 charges instead of 5 to confer the glitching condition to all creatures and wielded tech items in the area instead of dealing any damage. Creatures that fail their saving throw against the Area Fire become glitching with a value equal to the number of weapon dice (twice the number of weapon dice on a critical failure).
Frytech Rifle.name: Frytech Rifle

Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Advanced).description:
This set of sensors use a helmet-mounted, heads-up display to provide detailed information about your surroundings.

You also gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, and the activation's frequency becomes twice per day.

Your hearing additionally becomes a precise sense with a range of 30 feet.

Activate—Scan 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for 10 minutes.
Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Advanced).name: Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Advanced)

Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Commercial).description:
This set of sensors use a helmet-mounted, heads-up display to provide detailed information about your surroundings.

Activate—Scan 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for 10 minutes.
Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Commercial).name: Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Commercial)

Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Tactical).description:
This set of sensors use a helmet-mounted, heads-up display to provide detailed information about your surroundings.

You also gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, and the activation's frequency becomes twice per day.

Activate—Scan 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for 10 minutes.
Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Tactical).name: Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Tactical)

Functionary's Mask.description:
This angular half-mask is crafted from an unknown metal alloy with a steely gray sheen. From its four glowing eyespots to its pointed horns, the mask's appearance is harsh and synthetic. Despite covering the entire top half of the face, the Functionary's mask doesn't hinder vision or other senses. While wearing the Functionary's mask, you have darkvision and can communicate wirelessly with robots within 60 feet.

Activate—Override 2 (command, concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} (@Check[will|dc:19|traits:auditory,concentrate,linguistic,manipulate,mental|options:item:spell]) on a creature with the tech trait, ignoring any immunity it may have to mental effects.
Functionary's Mask.name: Functionary's Mask

Genetic Backup.description:
This circuit-laced headband creates a backup of your genetic code each morning, providing insight not only into your own physical wellbeing but that of others. You gain a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks.

Activate—Reset Code 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You press a button on the back of the headband, partially resetting your physiology. You immediately regain @Damage[8d8[healing]] Hit Points. You can immediately attempt a flat check to recover from any persistent damage you're taking, as if assisted. You can also immediately attempt a new saving throw against any ongoing effects that have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} you or that have the disease or poison traits, taking the new result. A creature adjacent to you can also Activate the genetic backup, but its effects still apply to you.
Genetic Backup.name: Genetic Backup

Ghost Cloak (Commercial).description: This hooded cloak projects a small obscuring shadow across its wearer's body, using an optical weave that shines and shifts hues when viewed from the right angle. Items of Bulk up to L gain the concealable trait while stowed or worn under the cloak. The wearer can use an Interact action to pull the hood up or down, covering the wearer's head and face to obscure their identity.
Ghost Cloak (Commercial).name: Ghost Cloak (Commercial)

Ghost Cloak (Tactical).description: This hooded cloak projects a small obscuring shadow across its wearer's body, using an optical weave that shines and shifts hues when viewed from the right angle. Items of Bulk up to 1 gain the concealable trait while stowed or worn under the cloak. The wearer can use an Interact action to pull the hood up or down, covering the wearer's head and face to obscure their identity.
Ghost Cloak (Tactical).name: Ghost Cloak (Tactical)

Ghost Killer.description: This upgrade lets you harm creatures without physical form. A ghost killer weapon is particularly effective against incorporeal creatures, which almost always have a specific vulnerability to ghost killer weapons. Incorporeal creatures can touch, hold, and wield ghost killer weapons (unlike most physical objects).
Ghost Killer.name: Ghost Killer

Ghost's Harness (Advanced).description: This harness fits over your armor and is fitted with plenty of null-space pockets that enable you to carry numerous items that otherwise might weigh you down. This magically empowered harness increases the amount of Bulk its wearer can carry before being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and its maximum carried Bulk by 4.
Ghost's Harness (Advanced).name: Ghost's Harness (Advanced)

Ghost's Harness (Commercial).description: This harness fits over your armor and is fitted with plenty of null-space pockets that enable you to carry numerous items that otherwise might weigh you down. This magically empowered harness increases the amount of Bulk its wearer can carry before being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and its maximum carried Bulk by 2.
Ghost's Harness (Commercial).name: Ghost's Harness (Commercial)

Ghost's Harness (Tactical).description: This harness fits over your armor and is fitted with plenty of null-space pockets that enable you to carry numerous items that otherwise might weigh you down. This magically empowered harness increases the amount of Bulk its wearer can carry before being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and its maximum carried Bulk by 3.
Ghost's Harness (Tactical).name: Ghost's Harness (Tactical)

Ghostviz Headset.description:
This clunky, old-fashioned VR headset supposedly plunges the wearer into the realm of the supernatural, displaying a world totally unlike the one you're presently in, though the size and vague shape of walls and obstacles remain the same. This world often resembles places or events important to nearby incorporeal undead, such as a burning building or how a station appeared decades ago.

Activate—Goggles On 1 (manipulate) You pull the headset over your eyes and power it on, plunging you into its simulated supernatural world. All corporeal creatures are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you, but you can clearly see any incorporeal creatures, such as ghosts and the denizens of the Ethereal Plane. You also gain a +1 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the past of any undead creature within 1,000 feet. You can end the effect by raising the headset as a single Interact action.
Ghostviz Headset.name: Ghostviz Headset

Ghoul Stomach (Advanced).description: Your stomach is replaced with that of a ghoul, allowing you to safely ingest a wide range of usually stomach-churning cuisine. Some with this augmentation report having subtle cravings for food they'd usually avoid. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against ingested poisons and to retch while sickened. You become extremely hungry, needing to constantly satiate yourself. If you've eaten within the last hour, you gain a +10-foot item bonus to your Speeds and a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act high-jump]] and [[/act long-jump]]. Otherwise, you take a –5-foot item penalty to your Speeds.
Ghoul Stomach (Advanced).name: Ghoul Stomach (Advanced)

Some with this augmentation report having subtle cravings for food they'd usually avoid. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against ingested poisons and to retch while sickened. You become extremely hungry, needing to constantly satiate yourself. Giantblood Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This thick red serum isn't actually made of giant's blood, but rather a cocktail of proprietary nanites. One minute after you use this serum, you and your equipment grow become Large for 5 minutes. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 10 minutes. This serum has no benefits for a Large or larger creature, but they're still clumsy 1 for 10 minutes.
Giantblood Serum.name: Giantblood Serum

Gill Sheath.description: Oxygen-filtering nodules line the outside of your lungs. If you breathe in water, the gill sheath filters the oxygen into your lungs. This allows you to breathe underwater or in the air. You exhale normally.
Gill Sheath.name: Gill Sheath

Gimmick (Basic).description:
Gimmicks are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This entry-level gimmick only changes the theme of the spell and has no other change to its effects, except the spell is different enough that spellcasters who have the spell prepared or in their repertoire do not automatically know what the spell is.

Activate—Gimmick! 1 (magical, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell, it changes the theme of the spell and has no other change to its effects, except the spell is different enough that spellcasters who have the spell prepared or in their repertoire do not automatically know what the spell is.
Gimmick (Basic).name: Gimmick (Basic)

Gimmick (Devastating).description:
Gimmicks are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This flashy gimmick is especially popular with spellcasters who want their most amazing feats to be even more jaw-dropping. When you purchase this gimmick or when you reprogram it during your daily preparations, choose a critical specialization effect from corrosive, cryo, flame, laser, plasma, poison, shock, and sonic.

Activate—Gimmick! 1 (magical, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, targets of the spell that you critically succeed on your spell attack roll against or that critically fail their saving throws are also affected by the chosen critical specialization effect. If none of the spell's targets are affected by this effect, you can Activate this gimmick again on your next turn, regardless of its frequency.
Gimmick (Devastating).name: Gimmick (Devastating)

Gimmick (Elegant).description:

This subtly beautiful gimmick is equally popular among scheming nobility and spellcasting thieves.

Activate—Gimmick! 1 (magical, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell, it gains the subtle trait. In addition, its effects cause no damage to your surroundings and create only soft sounds like tinkling chimes and string music. Creatures slain by the spell appear relaxed and resting unless investigated closely.
Gimmick (Elegant).name: Gimmick (Elegant)

This colorful gimmick is especially popular with spellcasters who have a preference for a particular element. When you purchase this gimmick or when you reprogram it during your daily preparations, choose an elemental trait: air (electricity or slashing), earth (bludgeoning or piercing), fire (fire), metal (piercing or slashing), radiation (acid or poison), water (bludgeoning or cold), and wood (piercing or vitality).

Activate—Gimmick! 1 (magical, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell with an elemental trait (as listed above), replace it with the chosen trait and replace one of its damage types with one of the damage types associated with your chosen trait.
Gimmick (Elemental).name: Gimmick (Elemental)

Gimmick (Foul).description:

This disgusting gimmick is especially popular with the unsettling undead and mischievous tricksters.

Activate—Gimmick! 1 (magical, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell, one creature adjacent to you when you do so must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
Gimmick (Foul).name: Gimmick (Foul)

Glamer Projector.description:
Adjustable rings project magical holograms onto your armor, changing its appearance to match your personal style and suit any occasion. Glamer projectors come programmed with preset options, including casual, corporate, and fashion. You can customize your glamer projector using a computer, like the one in your comm unit.

Activate—Glamerize! 1 (manipulate)

Effect You instantly change the appearance of your armor to any set of normal clothes or any other type of light or heavy armor. This upgrade is capable of changing only the appearance of your armor, not yourself or the rest of your equipment. You can copy the look of any type of clothing, but you don't gain any item bonuses provided by special types of clothing, such as luxury fashion attire. Only a creature that's benefiting from truesight or a similar effect can attempt to disbelieve this illusion, opposed by your class DC.
Glamer Projector.name: Glamer Projector

Glarecaster.description: Mimicking the glare of sunlight on ice, a glarecaster creates a blinding flash when fired. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
Glarecaster.name: Glarecaster

Glitch Compensator.description: A complex series of redundancies reduces computer glitches. When you roll a critical failure on the flat check to use glitching equipment or when starting your turn while glitching, you get a failure instead. This upgrade is immune to glitching.
Glitch Compensator.name: Glitch Compensator

Glitterbomb (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade explodes into a cloud of glitter. All creatures in the @Template[burst|distance:15] must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class] save. While the glitter is merely an annoyance for most, it interferes with creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} (or that later become invisible). The glitter lasts for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature avoids the glitter entirely.

Success The creature avoids most of the glitter and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of invisible.

Failure The creature is covered in glitter and can be targeted with no flat check due to being invisible.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute as the glitter gets in their eyes, though they can end the dazzled condition with an Interact action.

Your lungs or palms are implanted with an organ that produces reflective, sticky dandruff, popularly known as a glittergland. The muscles surrounding the gland can contract in a spasm, expelling the glitter forward.

Activate—Glitterburst 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect A @Template[type:cone|distance:15] becomes coated in glitter. Invisible creatures in the area become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. Creatures in the area that were already concealed for any other reason are no longer concealed. Affected creatures must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:29] saving throw. Affected creatures are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for the duration.

Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.V1cojmrEOWkJ1yPF]{Glow Up} spell

Gluon Crystal (Advanced).description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d8[persistent,bleed]] damage. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.
Gluon Crystal (Advanced).name: Gluon Crystal (Advanced)

Gluon Crystal (Commercial).description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] damage. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.
Gluon Crystal (Commercial).name: Gluon Crystal (Commercial)
