Gluon Crystal (Tactical).name: Gluon Crystal (Tactical)

Gnarefuroid Carapace.description: Your carapace grants a +3 item bonus to AC and has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and one upgrade slot. You can never wear other armor or remove your carapace. This carapace has the analog and comfort traits, and it can be improved by spending credits as if it were normal armor. Your carapace is medium armor in the ceramic group for abilities and for installing upgrades.
Gnarefuroid Carapace.name: Gnarefuroid Carapace

Grapnel Pick.description:
Upgrades: 1

This multipurpose hiking and climbing tool doubles as a modular weapon. It has a retractable carbon fiber cable that can support up to 14 Bulk. If you're trained with this weapon, and it has the grapple trait, you can use it to [[/act grapple]] a Medium or smaller creature up to 20 feet away. You can continue to Grapple to keep your hold on the target so long as the target remains within 20 feet, and you continue to hold the grapnel pick. The @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape, and Grapple checks attempted with grapnel picks take a –2 penalty unless you're adjacent to the target.
Grapnel Pick.name: Grapnel Pick

Gravitational Generator.description: This generator increases the mass of creatures struck by the weapon, causing gravity to affect them more heavily. When you critically hit a flying creature with a Strike with the installed weapon and deal damage, the target immediately falls up to 20 feet to the nearest surface and reduces its fly Speed by 5 feet for 1 minute. Subsequent successful Strikes against the same creature further reduce its fly Speed each time. This upgrade has no effect in zero gravity.
Gravitational Generator.name: Gravitational Generator

Graviton Ammunition.description: These rounds feel noticeably heavier than mundane ammunition. Their cores contain magical catalysts that cause tiny gravity implosions on impact. On a critical hit with this ammunition, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage as it's repeatedly crushed by aftershocks. As long as it takes this persistent damage, squares in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around the target are difficult terrain.
Graviton Ammunition.name: Graviton Ammunition

Graviton Crystal (Commercial).description: A graviton crystal increases the forces of gravity around your solar manifestations, accelerating its impact and possibly trapping foes within its gravity field. While graviton attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of your solar weapon's or flare's damage type. On a critical hit while you're graviton attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn.
Graviton Crystal (Commercial).name: Graviton Crystal (Commercial)

Graviton Crystal (Tactical).description:
A graviton crystal increases the forces of gravity around your solar manifestations, accelerating its impact and possibly trapping foes within its gravity field. While graviton attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of your solar weapon's or flare's damage type. On a critical hit while you're graviton attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 2 rounds.

Additionally, when you hit an immobilized or suppressed creature with your solar weapon or solar flare, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be knocked prone.
Graviton Crystal (Tactical).name: Graviton Crystal (Tactical)

Great Absalom Relay Medal.description: This medal marks you as the winner of The Great Absalom Relay, and the embedded data drive contains a full recording of the event broadcast. Fans of the event recognize you while wearing it and are more willing to assist you. You gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks made to communicate with residents of Absalom Station.
Great Absalom Relay Medal.name: Great Absalom Relay Medal

Grenade Launcher (Commercial).description:
Activate 2 Area Fire

The rotating barrel of this automatic breechloading launcher holds up to six grenades of any variety with smart loading technology, allowing its wielder to choose a different grenade each time they fire. A grenade launcher is a martial ranged weapon, has a reload of 2, and a range 280 feet.
Grenade Launcher (Commercial).name: Grenade Launcher (Commercial)

Upgrades: 1

The edge of this broad-tipped sword is composed of micro-splitting nanoparticles that slice apart targets with surgical precision.
Grindblade.name: Grindblade

Gyrojet Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

Valued for its stopping power, this pistol sports a large caliber reinforced barrel designed to shoot tiny rockets capable of knocking enemies to the ground.

Hacking Toolkit (Advanced).description: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced).description:
Upgrades 2

These handwraps can be customized to shine in any color in the visible spectrum when used, and some manufacturers offer custom firmware that modifies their appearance to manifest as a claw, oversized fist, or hammerhead. They can even be worn in alternate ways on other parts of the body. These handwraps enhance your unarmed attacks as if they were manufactured weapons, allowing you to add an upgrade to your unarmed attacks. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons in the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes.

Your unarmed attacks gain the tracking +1 trait and increase the damage to two dice.
Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced).name: Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced)

Upgrades: 1

This sleek, wrist-mounted bracer fires hardlight projectiles. The projectile shapes and appearance can be programmed by the wielder, allowing the damage type to easily shift.
Hardlight Launcher.name: Hardlight Launcher

Hardlight Series.description:
Upgrades: 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.
Hardlight Series.name: Hardlight Series

Haste Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} spell
Haste Spell Amp.name: Haste Spell Amp

Hearing Aid.description: This device fits into your ear canal or other suitable auditory organs. Commonly available at UPB printing kiosks, this augmentation restores or enhances hearing. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Hearing Aid.name: Hearing Aid

Hellforged Plates.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.fq0LdrPloPz63YBh]{Hellforged Android}.

Hellforged plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +5 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +0, a check penalty of –3, a Speed penalty of –10 feet, and a Strength value of +3. They have the comfort trait, and you're trained in your Hellforged plates. You can never wear other armor or remove your Hellforged plates. You can etch armor runes onto Hellforged plates.
Hellforged Plates.name: Hellforged Plates

Hellknight Plate.description:
Upgrades: 0

Unbowed, unrelenting, and unforgiving. This iconic black heavy armor bears protruding spikes and an ominous silhouette. Each set features a distinct design matching the stylings of its owner's Hellknight order. Hellknight plates always have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.BSATLOr4qZU6XllN]{commercial energized spikes} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
Hellknight Plate.name: Hellknight Plate

Hellsight.description:
Your eyes conceal a tiny psychic projector that, when focused on a target, allows you to imprint an image of Hell straight into their consciousness.

Activate—Hellsight 2 (concentrate, fear, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet, forcing them to see nightmarish visions of Hell. The target attempts a @Check[will|dc:27] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is frightened 1 and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for as long as it's fatigued.
Hellsight.name: Hellsight

Hidden Soldier Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This suit of heavy armor features a slitted helmet that reveals only the wearer's eyes. This high-tech ceramic suit consists of breastplate, shoulder guards, bracers, and greaves that flex with the body's movements.
Hidden Soldier Armor.name: Hidden Soldier Armor

Hideaway Limb (Commercial).description:
You can conceal items inside a hidden compartment in one of your limbs (such as an arm, leg, or tail) and protect them with a passcode. The compartment holds items of negligible Bulk and items of light Bulk that are small enough to fit in your limb or can otherwise be folded or contracted to fit. A hideaway in a leg (in a human) can typically hold more than one in an arm, and your size also adjusts the capacity at the GM's discretion.

When the compartment is closed, the seam in your limb is difficult to detect. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal an Object in a hideaway limb. Though this compartment can foil a cursory pat down, many security checkpoints include a scan to detect such devices.

Activate—Draw 1 (manipulate)

Effect You Interact to draw an item @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in your hideaway limb.
Hideaway Limb (Commercial).name: Hideaway Limb (Commercial)

Activate—Draw 1 (manipulate)

When you use Draw, if the item can be activated or otherwise used with a single action, you can use the item as part of the same action. For example, you Interact to draw a weapon, then Strike with that weapon.
Hideaway Limb (Tactical).name: Hideaway Limb (Tactical)

Hollowed Eardrums (Advanced).description:
Your eardrums are filled with hollow, necrotic tissue that can open and close to protect you from loud sounds.

Activate—Seal Drums 1 For 1 minute, your eardrums seal, muffling the sounds around you. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to hear. You gain resistance 12 to sonic damage and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against auditory effects. You aren't clumsy while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.

Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round

Stickers adorning this baseball-sized metallic grenade indicate the hologram it generates. When detonated, hundreds of small holograms burst forth, swarming around everyone in a @Template[burst|distance:15] for 1 minute. Creatures in the area that fail a @Check[will|against:class] save are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while they remain in the area, though they can attempt a new save at the beginning of each of their turns to end the effect. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. Homespun Hat.description:
This pink, knit cap with a pom pom on top is hand crafted from fur-spun yarn and a mother's love. It's faded, fraying, and the opposite of stylish. Wearing this hat tells people you're not scared of anything.

Activate—Nevertheless, Persist 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per round

Requirements You have the frightened condition

Effect As part of the activation, you denounce the source of your fear and oppression. You and each ally in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] reduce your frightened values by 1.
Homespun Hat.name: Homespun Hat

Homunculus Limb.description:
Your hand (or equivalent appendage) is a magitech prosthetic that can detach from your body and operate semi-autonomously. You can detach your hand as a single Interact action, and it becomes a Tiny construct with the magical and magitech traits on the ground in your space. It also has the minion trait, meaning it gains 2 actions during your turn if you Command it. Your hand can't make Strikes or wield weapons while detached. While it's detached, you can't use your hand other than by Commanding it. You can reattach your hand as a single Interact action as long as it shares your space. If your hand is destroyed, you can use it normally after reattaching it, though it can't be detached or Commanded until repaired.

Your hand's level, save modifiers, and AC are equal to yours. It uses 3 + your level as its modifier for Acrobatics, Perception, and Stealth checks, and for other skill checks, its modifier is equal to your level or your modifier in that skill, whichever is lower. It doesn't have or use its own attribute modifiers and can never benefit from item bonuses. Your hand has Hit Points equal to 5 times your level.

Your hand has low-light vision, and you can see through its sensors as long as it remains within 100 feet of you. It has a Speed of 25 feet and a climb Speed of 25 feet. It can perform manipulate actions as if it had a single hand, using its whole body, but it can't move while holding an item unless the item is of negligible Bulk.
Homunculus Limb.name: Homunculus Limb

Honor Enforcer.description: Created by the Veskarium to deal with cowards who refuse to stand and fight, this boxy contraption fires whirling, high-density weights connected by woven titanium cable. Properly aimed, these projectiles wrap around the target's limbs and bring them to the ground.
Honor Enforcer.name: Honor Enforcer

Hook Claws (Commercial).description: Sharp synthetic claws extend your limbs, often appearing as extra-long nail tips made of precious metals and gems. You gain an unarmed claw attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits, and is in the brawling weapon group. Additionally, you gain a climb Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a climb Speed of 15 feet or more, you instead gain a +5-foot item bonus to your climb Speed.
Hook Claws (Commercial).name: Hook Claws (Commercial)

Hook Claws (Tactical).description: Sharp synthetic claws extend your limbs, often appearing as extra-long nail tips made of precious metals and gems. You gain an unarmed claw attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits, and is in the brawling weapon group. Additionally, you gain a climb Speed of 20 feet. If you already have a climb Speed of 20 feet or more, your climb Speed is instead equal to your land Speed if it’s higher.

Horsechopper.description:
Upgrades: 1

Goblins cherish ancestral melee weapons called dogslicers and horsechoppers, but most people don't understand why. Goblin weapons are easy to make but prone to breakage.
Horsechopper.name: Horsechopper

Hoverzooms.description:
Hoverzooms miniaturize hoverbike technology and attach to the bottom of any pair of shoes (or similar attire and appendages), providing extra momentum on sudden movements. Frequency once per hour

Effect You push away from the ground and immediately Step. For 1 minute you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed and your land Speed gains the hover trait.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.kUSHgMCK1Uvyhkx0]{Effect: Hoverzooms}

This augmentation enhances your muscles and nervous system to dramatically improve your flexibility and reaction time. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. Ammunition projectile

Harvested from the Diaspora by Ulrikka Clanholdings, these rocks contain charged particles from the Astral Plane. When forged in a process that is part flint-knapping and part occult communion, skilled artificers can turn shards of these rocks into ammunition capable of harming incorporeal beings. Each piece of Iovan ammunition functions as though the weapon firing it had the ghost killer weapon upgrade. The brittle ammunition deals 0 damage against corporeal targets, as it breaks apart upon impact. Iovan ammunition deals half damage (rounded down) to an incorporeal creature possessing a living creature, making it popular with exorcists throughout the galaxy.
Iovan Ammunition.name: Iovan Ammunition

Iridescent Baton.description:
The prepared interstellar performer keeps contingencies close to hand to distract or deter rowdy crowds, aggressive autograph seekers, and stage invaders. The discrete iridescent baton has a flexible nanotech nozzle that creates mundane but entertaining floating soap bubbles of any shape, including not just geometric solids like cubes, pyramids, and dodecahedrons, but also figures like animals and dragons! The iridescent baton grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks made while incorporating it into your routine.

Activate—Ephemeral Creation 2 (manipulate, water)

Effect You create a piece of bubble art in a @Template[cube|distance:5] adjacent to you that lasts for 1 round and provides lesser cover. You can then [[/act create-a-diversion]] as part of this activation. If a creature interacts with the bubble art in any way, it pops, ending the effect.

Activate—Containment Bubble2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You attempt to trap a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet in a sturdy bubble. The creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20|showDC:all] Save. On a failure, they become trapped in a translucent bubble that blocks attacks, effects, and creatures that would pass through it, including the target; line of sight is unaffected. The bubble has AC 17, 30 Hit Points, and weakness 5 to piercing and slashing damage, and lasts until destroyed.
Iridescent Baton.name: Iridescent Baton

Irising Shield.description: An irising shield is made of flexible polycarbon with a retractable design. When retracted, an irising shield looks like a decorative bangle, gauntlet, or glove. When deployed, its panels flare out and form a miniature circular shield.
Irising Shield.name: Irising Shield

Ivory Chompers.description: Tiny pneumatic pistons hidden inside these ornate dental veneers turn them into deadly weapons. Pioneered by the undead media mogul Zo! for celebrities who need to stay armed and fashionable at all times, ivory chompers provide a last-ditch biting attack against attackers. Special designer versions incorporate custom monogrammed imprints, jewels, and metal plating for the ultimate smile.
Ivory Chompers.name: Ivory Chompers

Jetpack (Commercial).description:
Boosters attached to your armor allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.0kP4P73w0PykYkPY]{Effect: Jetpack}
Jetpack (Commercial).name: Jetpack (Commercial)

Jetpack (Tactical).description:
Boosters attached to your armor allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 40 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.0kP4P73w0PykYkPY]{Effect: Jetpack}
Jetpack (Tactical).name: Jetpack (Tactical)

Jump Jets.description:
Boosters attached to your armor supercharge your leap.

Activate—Jump 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per round

Effect You activate the jump jets to get a quick boost. You Fly up to 20 feet with a maximum height of 10 feet, or you Fly up to 20 feet straight up. You must land at the end of this movement or fall. Jump jets can't lift you if you're encumbered.
Jump Jets.name: Jump Jets

Jump Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Q7QQ91vQtyi1Ux36]{Jump} spell
Jump Spell Amp.name: Jump Spell Amp

Junk Hopper.description:
This rugged steel box has a wide mouth on one side and an ammo feed on the other. It uses nanites to convert scrap fed to the bin into battery charges, chemical fuel, or projectiles. Generated chems or projectiles are held in shape by the device's magnetic field, so they disintegrate into useless junk if removed from the installed weapon.

Activate—Recycle Ammo 1 (manipulate)

Effect You pour 1 Bulk of junk into the junk hopper. At the start of your next turn, the hopper finishes converting the junk into 10 chems, 10 battery charges, or 10 rounds of projectile ammo, which are automatically loaded into the installed weapon. Any ammunition produced that exceeds the installed weapon's magazine capacity is wasted.
Junk Hopper.name: Junk Hopper

Keypad Lock (Commercial).description:
Keycard and keypad locks balance security and convenience, trading the keys of commercial locks for chip-based card scanners and numerical codes, respectively. Keycards for keycard locks are level 0 items that cost 1 credit.

Bypass requires two successful @Check[computers|dc:20] checks or one successful @Check[thievery|dc:25] check.
Keypad Lock (Commercial).name: Keypad Lock (Commercial)

Keypad Lock (Tactical).description:
Keycard and keypad locks balance security and convenience, trading the keys of commercial locks for chip-based card scanners and numerical codes, respectively. Keycards for keycard locks are level 0 items that cost 1 credit.

Bypass requires four successful @Check[computers|dc:25] checks or two successful @Check[thievery|dc:30] checks.
Keypad Lock (Tactical).name: Keypad Lock (Tactical)

Kinetic Generator (Advanced).description:
This generator converts your movement into electrical energy, recharging an attached battery. The kinetic generator produces 1 charge per 10 minutes of movement; typical daily activities produce enough movement to charge the generator, but no charges are produced while you sleep or sit still. The kinetic generator can hold one battery at a time, and batteries can be attached or removed with a single Interact action.

Activate—Short Circuit r (electricity)

Trigger You're hit by a creature's melee attack

Requirements A battery with at least 10 charges is attached to the kinetic generator

Effect You consume all the attached battery's charges, dealing @Damage[6d6[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save).
Kinetic Generator (Advanced).name: Kinetic Generator (Advanced)

Knife.description:
Upgrades: 1

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from starmetals to ceramics.
Knife.name: Knife

Knuckle Sheller.description:
Upgrades: 0

The knuckle sheller resembles battlegloves with two large barrels that extend at the wrist. This weapon is often used by formidably trained mercenaries to surprise enemies in close-quarters combat. You can't use this weapon to make ranged attacks if you're wielding a ranged weapon in the same hand. If you fire this weapon and aren't trained with it, you take @Damage[1[bludgeoning]] damage and can't use that hand again until you're restored to full Hit Points.
Knuckle Sheller.name: Knuckle Sheller

Kyokor Plating.description:
Upgrade: 1

This armor incorporates a full-coverage polycarbon suit studded with ports and sockets and layered with plates from Daimalko's infamous colossi. Kyokor plating comes with boots, gloves, and a helmet with a clear visor.
Kyokor Plating.name: Kyokor Plating

Laser Eye.description: A laser eye from an Akashic dragon (or other creature) has been implanted into your body. Whether the eye was vat grown or carved from a kill is your secret. You gain a laser eye unarmed attack that deals 1d4 fire damage with a range increment of 60 feet. Your laser eye is in the laser group and has the agile, concealable, fire, tech, and unarmed traits.
Laser Eye.name: Laser Eye

Laser Grid (Advanced).description:
These grids surround important objects or protects corridors with webs of bright lasers. With 10 minutes of work, one laser grid can be installed to cover an area up to 30 feet wide and up to 30 feet high. Additional laser grids of the same type can be combined to expand their coverage. A laser grid can be set to emit invisible beams, requiring a successful @Check[perception|dc:30] check to detect them if a creature isn't already aware of the lasers. Reduce the Perception DC to [[/act seek]] an invisible laser grid by 5 in the presence of fog, mist, smoke, or other particulates. If there's no external power source, each laser grid takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 5 charges when triggered (or 1 charge if it only sounds an alarm).

Activate—Broken Beam r

Trigger A creature or object crosses the laser beam between two emitters, breaking it

Effect An alarm signal is activated, it deals @Damage[(2d8+3)[slashing],(3d8+3)[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save;

Disable@Check[thievery|dc:32].
Laser Grid (Advanced).name: Laser Grid (Advanced)

Laser Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.
Laser Pistol.name: Laser Pistol

Laser Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.
Laser Rifle.name: Laser Rifle

Laserdisc.description:
Upgrades: 1

This disc has been retrofitted to generate a circular blade of razor-sharp hardlight when thrown. Xenoarchaelogists have found some evidence that some antique laserdiscs might have been used as a rudimentary form of data storage, but finding a device capable of reading that data would be a challenge.
Laserdisc.name: Laserdisc

Lifesuit.description: This whole-body garment provides basic environmental protection. A lifesuit's environmental protections lasts for 10 days and can be equipped with an additional battery, providing 1 day of protection per charge.
Lifesuit.name: Lifesuit

Liminal Laser Rifle.description:
There's a handmade magitech device attached to this @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.0TSUahGsoVnDZ6kv]{Laser Rifle}, consisting of a bracketed glowing gem and wires that connect the gem's carved glyphs to the rifle's firing mechanism.

Activate—Liminal Lock 1 Cost 2 charges

Effect The next time you make a ranged Strike against a target that's benefiting from cover, reduce their circumstance bonus to AC gained from cover by 1.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, you can Aim as part of the Liminal Lock action, and Aim reduces the target's bonus from cover by an additional 1.
Liminal Laser Rifle.name: Liminal Laser Rifle

Limscan Lenses.description: Functioning as a built-in @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.VqqxwnjFeCNmHSe0]{Limscanner}, sensors in your eyes are calibrated to detect fluctuations in planar energies found inside the Ghost Levels, allowing you to scan for certain anomalies during a limdive or while investigating oddities across the galaxy. You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps, to AC against attacks made by magical traps, and to saves against magical traps. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You cannot Disable traps without the otherwise required proficiency.
Limscan Lenses.name: Limscan Lenses

Limscanner.description: This magitech device is calibrated to detect fluctuations in planar energies found inside the Ghost Levels. While carrying this item, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps, to AC against attacks made by magical traps, and to saves against magical traps. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you get a check to find magical traps that normally requires you to be Searching. You cannot disable traps without the otherwise required proficiency.
Limscanner.name: Limscanner

Linguistic Coprocessor (Advanced).description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand and speak, two additional languages, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored languages during your daily preparations, but it must be to languages you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.
Linguistic Coprocessor (Advanced).name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Advanced)

Linguistic Coprocessor (Commercial).description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand, but not speak, one additional language, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored language during your daily preparations, but it must be to a language you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.
Linguistic Coprocessor (Commercial).name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Commercial)

Linguistic Coprocessor (Superior).description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand and speak any language commonly spoken on the current planet as the coprocessor pulls data from local networks.
Linguistic Coprocessor (Superior).name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Superior)

Linguistic Coprocessor (Tactical).description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand, but not speak, two additional languages, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored languages during your daily preparations, but it must be to languages you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.
Linguistic Coprocessor (Tactical).name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Tactical)

Liquidator.description:
Upgrades: 1

Compact and power hungry, the spinning barrels of this merciless weapon spray the battlefield with a corrosive storm of liquifying energy. Known to be a weapon capable of great collateral damage, it's discerningly popular among unscrupulous mercenaries and Devourer cultists.
Liquidator.name: Liquidator

Lissalan Barrier (Superior).description:
This shield (+2 AC, Hardness 5, HP 66, BT 33) prominently features Lissala's religious symbol. When a spell gem attached to the Lissalan barrier's weapon component is activated to Cast a Spell, the shield regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

The included weapon can have both a single aeon stone and a single spell gem attached to it at once.
Lissalan Barrier (Superior).name: Lissalan Barrier (Superior)

Lissalan Barrier (Tactical).description: This shield (+2 AC, Hardness 6, HP 48, BT 24) prominently features Lissala's religious symbol. When a spell gem attached to the Lissalan barrier's weapon component is activated to Cast a Spell, the shield regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.
Lissalan Barrier (Tactical).name: Lissalan Barrier (Tactical)

Lissalan Barrier (Ultimate).description:
This shield (+2 AC, Hardness 9, HP 102, BT 51) prominently features Lissala's religious symbol. When a spell gem attached to the Lissalan barrier's weapon component is activated to Cast a Spell, the shield regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

The included weapon can have both a single aeon stone and up to seven spell gems attached to it at once.
Lissalan Barrier (Ultimate).name: Lissalan Barrier (Ultimate)

Living Ink Tattoo.description:
This elaborate tattoo is inked with ferrofluid that moves about your body of its own accord, seemingly with a minimal level of intelligence. It comes in a multitude of colors and designs, but its magic requires that it sharply contrasts with your skin color, making it highly noticeable. The tattoo reacts in response to damage, deploying magic electro-magnetic defenses to protect its host.

Activate—Magnetic Shielding r

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You would take physical damage from an attack

Effect The tattoo creates an electromagnetic shield until the start of your next turn, as a shield cantrip of a rank equal to half your level, rounded up. You gain the effects of Shield Block with it against the triggering attack. Unlike a normal shield cantrip, the effect doesn't end after you Shield Block in this way.
Living Ink Tattoo.name: Living Ink Tattoo

Load Lifter (Advanced).description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 8 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 13 plus your Strength modifier.
Load Lifter (Advanced).name: Load Lifter (Advanced)

Load Lifter (Commercial).description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 6 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 11 plus your Strength modifier.
Load Lifter (Commercial).name: Load Lifter (Commercial)

Load Lifter (Tactical).description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 7 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 12 plus your Strength modifier.
Load Lifter (Tactical).name: Load Lifter (Tactical)

Lock (Advanced).description: Picking an advanced lock requires four successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=25]]{DC 25 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Advanced).name: Lock (Advanced)

Lock (Commercial).description: Picking a commercial lock requires two successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=15]]{DC 15 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Commercial).name: Lock (Commercial)

Lock (Elite).description: Picking an elite lock requires six successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=40]]{DC 40 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Elite).name: Lock (Elite)

Lock (Superior).description: Picking a superior lock requires five successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=30]]{DC 30 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Superior).name: Lock (Superior)

Lock (Tactical).description: Picking a tactical lock requires two successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{DC 20 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Tactical).name: Lock (Tactical)

Loudener (Commercial).description: This specialized cone is installed over the muzzle or hilt of a weapon to use pneumonic pulses and passive acoustics to increase the volume of its attacks. It deals an extra 1d6 sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).
Loudener (Commercial).name: Loudener (Commercial)

Loudener (Tactical).description:
This specialized cone is installed over the muzzle or hilt of a weapon to use pneumonic pulses and passive acoustics to increase the volume of its attacks. It deals an extra 1d6 sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).

Sonic damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's sonic resistance.
Loudener (Tactical).name: Loudener (Tactical)

Lucidity Shawl.description:
Upgrades: 0

This fetching armor features folding neck plates that protect its wearer's vitals. When an aeon stone or spell gem is socketed into it, this "shawl" comes alive with vibrant particles and flows softly as if in a gentle breeze.
Lucidity Shawl.name: Lucidity Shawl

MED-shell.description:
Upgrades: 0

This bulky armor features massive shoulder pads and plated vambraces that protect its wearer's articulating extremities and digits. Iconically worn by Pact Worlds field medics during the height of the Silent War, MED-shells have since become the de facto choice for athletic healers. MED-Shells always have an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.1kYUux9KdGkPggB4]{Auto-CPR Unit} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
MED-shell.name: MED-shell

Machine Gun.description:
Upgrades: 1

These proven and reliable automatic weapons are capable of firing in short bursts or completely emptying their magazines to clear a battlefield.
Machine Gun.name: Machine Gun

Machine Mind Serum (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 1 hour, you gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 15 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 15 to electricity.
Machine Mind Serum (Advanced).name: Machine Mind Serum (Advanced)

Machine Mind Serum (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 1 minute, you gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 5 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 5 to electricity.
Machine Mind Serum (Commercial).name: Machine Mind Serum (Commercial)

Machine Mind Serum (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 10 minutes, you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 10 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 10 to electricity.
Machine Mind Serum (Tactical).name: Machine Mind Serum (Tactical)

Magboots.description: Magboots can be activated or deactivated with an Interact action. Upgrades: 0

Mageplate.name: Mageplate

Magical Mixtape.description:
These archaic cassette tapes always have the perfect music for your tastes and the situation you find yourself in. While you listen to them on the included music player, you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks using your key attribute modifier.

Activate—Play Rad Music 1 (auditory, tech)

Frequency once per day

Effect With the click of a button, you listen to the perfect music to get you through a situation. For 1 minute, you gain a +10-foot item bonus to your Speed and deal an additional 1d6 precision damage on any successful Strike.
Magical Mixtape.name: Magical Mixtape

Maglock Spine.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rod uses fin-shaped plates to become a greatpick, taking one action to reassemble itself with the breakdown trait.

Activate—Graviton Drag 1 (attack, electricity)

Requirements You are trained with the maglock spine; Cost 5+ charges (maximum 5 for every weapon die)

Effect Attempt a melee Strike against the Reflex DC of a creature within 5 feet for every 5 charges spent to Activate this ability. On a success, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to you for every 5 charges spent to Activate this ability. On a critical success, it's also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} for 1 round. This attack deals no damage.
Maglock Spine.name: Maglock Spine

Magnet-Directed Battleglove.description:
Upgrades: 1

There's a round electromagnet on the back of this battleglove. You can Install a one-handed melee weapon with light Bulk into the battleglove as if the installed weapon was an upgrade.

Activate—Launch Weapon 1 (attack)

Requirements You have a weapon with which you're trained Installed in the battleglove; Cost 5 charges

Effect Attempt a ranged Strike against a target as if the weapon had the thrown (20 feet) weapon trait. The weapon is no longer Installed. The weapon flies back to the hand with the battleglove after the Strike is complete. If that hand is full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.
Magnet-Directed Battleglove.name: Magnet-Directed Battleglove

Magnetar Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle uses powerful electromagnets to accelerate simple slugs into deadly, highly accurate projectiles without the use of any moving parts.
Magnetar Rifle.name: Magnetar Rifle

Magnetic Edge.description: This simple series of magnets is designed to be integrated into another defensive item.
Magnetic Edge.name: Magnetic Edge

Magnetic Jack.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A magnetic jack is a simple machine used to lift and move large or heavy objects. Consisting of two powerful magnets with a ferrous plate between them, the jack can be placed under and Activated to lift an object of up to 200 Bulk and then pushed or pulled at a creature's Speed using two hands. Creatures supported by an activated magnetic jack are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.
Magnetic Jack.name: Magnetic Jack

Maker's App.description: This comm unit app contains formulas for Crafting the common items in this section.

Internal stabilizers and jets synchronize your movements in zero gravity. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or clumsy while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.

Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Advanced).description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

You gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act high-jump]] or [[/act long-jump]] and you don't automatically fail the check if you didn't Stride at least 10 feet.

When you use the [[/act leap]] action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.
Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Advanced).name: Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Advanced)

Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Commercial.description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

When you use the [[/act leap]] action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Superior).description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act high-jump]] or [[/act long-jump]] and you don't automatically fail the check if you didn't Stride at least 10 feet.

You can High Jump or Long Jump as a single action. You can travel up to 10 feet further in a horizontal Leap or Long Jump, or 6 feet higher in a vertical Leap or High Jump.
Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Superior).name: Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Superior)

Meme Cannon.description:
Upgrades 2

This weapon's actual name is the mesmeric-synaptic cannon, but it's been all but officially renamed to meme cannon. It fires bursts of sonic and visual gibberish designed to overload and overwhelm the senses of its targets. The so-called meme cannon weapon can be used to pacify even the toughest enemies of the Pact Worlds.
Meme Cannon.name: Meme Cannon

Memory Expansion (Advanced).description:
A high-capacity storage drive, equipped with an onboard organic-to-digital communication bus, is installed in your cerebral cortex, giving you access to additional information on a narrow topic. While you have the memory expansion installed, you become master in a single Lore skill, chosen when you install or improve the augmentation. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

Activate—Solid State Memory 1 (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per day

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} using the Lore skill granted by this augmentation, rolling the skill check twice and taking the higher result. The question must be relevant to the chosen skill.

Special If you have a datajack augmentation, a single memory expansion you have installed doesn't count toward your implant limit. Further memory expansions still count.
Memory Expansion (Advanced).name: Memory Expansion (Advanced)

Merciful.description:
Merciful weapons are limned in a green glow recognized around the galaxy. A merciful weapon has the nonlethal trait and can't be used to make a lethal attack. Any persistent damage the weapon would deal is negated.

On a critical hit, a merciful weapon causes the target to become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the weapon's wielder for 1 minute, as the target is bombarded with feelings of guilt and remorse. This is a mental effect. If you have access to the weapon's critical specialization effect, you choose whether to use it or the merciful effect.
Merciful.name: Merciful

Mercy Ammunition.description: Preferred by the more benevolent law enforcement agencies and those adventurers who find themselves in danger but are unwilling to kill, these springy polymer rounds pack a punch but little penetration. Weapons loaded with this ammunition gain the nonlethal trait.

Micro-cutters (Commercial).description:
Tiny spinning blades strategically installed at various locations on the armor let you burrow in loose material and bore through harder surfaces.

Activate—Burrow 1 (manipulate)

Effect You enable the cutters and gain a burrow Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.

Activate—Bore (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You enable the cutters and bore a hole 5 feet wide, 5 feet tall, and 1 foot deep in a solid, non-metal surface. This activity takes a number of minutes equal to 5 × the surface's Hardness.
Micro-cutters (Commercial).name: Micro-cutters (Commercial)

Micro-cutters (Tactical).description:
Tiny spinning blades strategically installed at various locations on the armor let you burrow in loose material and bore through harder surfaces.

Activate—Burrow 1 (manipulate)

Effect You enable the cutters and gain a burrow Speed of 40 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.

Activate—Bore (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You enable the cutters and bore a hole 5 feet wide, 5 feet tall, and 1 foot deep in a solid, non-metal surface. This activity takes a number of minutes equal to the surface's Hardness.
Micro-cutters (Tactical).name: Micro-cutters (Tactical)

Microcord Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.
Microcord Armor.name: Microcord Armor

Microgoggles.description: These bulky goggles include adjustable magnifying lenses and lights, granting you a +2 item bonus to any skill check that benefits from exceedingly close vision, such as detecting complicated forgeries, identifying pathogens in blood samples, or crafting drugs or medicinals.
Microgoggles.name: Microgoggles

Microphone.description: This cordless handheld device records and transmits audio, typically to a speaker or computer.
Microphone.name: Microphone

Mindshutter Stone.description:
This gleaming, cylindrical crystal hangs from a silver chain and repels psychic energy, shielding your mind from harm. You gain resistance 3 to mental damage.

Activate—Shutter Mind r (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect

Effect You shunt the harmful psychic energy into the mindshutter stone, gaining a success against the triggering effect instead. The mindshutter stone then goes dormant, losing all abilities until you next invest it.
Mindshutter Stone.name: Mindshutter Stone

Miniaturization Tag.description:
This metallic sticker adheres to any object.

Activate—Shrink 1 (magic, manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements The applied item is its normal size

Effect The item shrinks to fit in your palm. Its Bulk becomes negligible, and it can be easily @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in a pocket.

Activate—Grow 1 (magic, manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements The applied item is miniaturized

Effect The item returns to its normal size, appearing in an adjacent space if it's too big for you to hold. You can't Grow the applied item if there isn't enough space for it to appear.
Miniaturization Tag.name: Miniaturization Tag

Mnemonic Editor (Advanced).description: A mnemonic editor consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a month of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.
Mnemonic Editor (Advanced).name: Mnemonic Editor (Advanced)

Mnemonic Editor (Commercial).description: A mnemonic editor consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a day of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.
Mnemonic Editor (Commercial).name: Mnemonic Editor (Commercial)

Mnemonic Editor (Tactical).description: A mnemonic editor consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a week of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.
Mnemonic Editor (Tactical).name: Mnemonic Editor (Tactical)

Mobile Bulwark.description: This bulky shield is advertised as the ultimate protection in battle for those strong enough to hoist them. Mobile bulwarks create an iconic rectangular silhouette and are popular with heavily armored mercenaries and soldiers, notably among the Veskarium military and some orders of Hellknights. A mobile bulwark is often constructed of carbon steel, with a transparent aluminum view port.
Mobile Bulwark.name: Mobile Bulwark

Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Advance.description: Cybernetic enhancements and synthetic nanomuscle fibers are installed throughout your fins, wings, or digging arms. You gain a +15-foot item bonus to one of your burrow, climb, fly, or swim Speeds, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can't choose a Speed you don't have or a Speed you have from a temporary source, such as a different augmentation.
Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Advance.name: Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Advanced)

Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Commerc.description: Cybernetic enhancements and synthetic nanomuscle fibers are installed throughout your fins, wings, or digging arms. You gain a +5-foot item bonus to one of your burrow, climb, fly, or swim Speeds, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can't choose a Speed you don't have or a Speed you have from a temporary source, such as a different augmentation.
Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Commerc.name: Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Commercial)

Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Tactica.description: Cybernetic enhancements and synthetic nanomuscle fibers are installed throughout your fins, wings, or digging arms. You gain a +10-foot item bonus to one of your burrow, climb, fly, or swim Speeds, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can't choose a Speed you don't have or a Speed you have from a temporary source, such as a different augmentation.
Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Tactica.name: Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Tactical)

Mobility Enhancer (Commercial).description: Automated braces help you to move faster in bulky armor. Reduce your armor's penalty to Speeds by 5 feet.
Mobility Enhancer (Commercial).name: Mobility Enhancer (Commercial)

Mobility Enhancer (Tactical).description: Automated braces help you to move faster in bulky armor. Reduce your armor's penalty to Speeds by 10 feet.
Mobility Enhancer (Tactical).name: Mobility Enhancer (Tactical)

Moisture Harvester.description:
This advanced temperature and moisture regulation technology was developed on Kasath. You're protected from severe heat, and you can survive for four times as long as normal without water before taking damage.

Activate—Vent 2 (manipulate, water)

Frequency once per day

Effect You release a blast of stored heat and vapor in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15], filling the area with mist that lasts for 1 minute. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it.
Moisture Harvester.name: Moisture Harvester

Molten Edge.description:
Upgrades: 0

This utility axe glows bright white when drawn and exposed to air, melting away into superheated slag after a single Strike.
Molten Edge.name: Molten Edge

Molten Vambrace (Advanced).description:
This vambrace is outfitted with a small fabricator that flash-forges temporary weapons.

Activate—Molten Finale 1 (fire, metal)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements You have a free hand, and an adjacent creature was critically hit in the last round

Effect Your bracer fabricates a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.133i2CJObrpd3oHW]{elite molten edge} into your free hand, then you Strike the required creature with it.
Molten Vambrace (Advanced).name: Molten Vambrace (Advanced)

Molten Vambrace (Commercial).description:
This vambrace is outfitted with a small fabricator that flash-forges temporary weapons.

Activate—Molten Finale 1 (fire, metal)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements You have a free hand, and an adjacent creature was critically hit in the last round

Effect Your bracer fabricates a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.133i2CJObrpd3oHW]{commercial molten edge} into your free hand, then you Strike the required creature with it.
Molten Vambrace (Commercial).name: Molten Vambrace (Commercial)

Molten Vambrace (Tactical).description:
This vambrace is outfitted with a small fabricator that flash-forges temporary weapons.

Activate—Molten Finale 1 (fire, metal)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements You have a free hand, and an adjacent creature was critically hit in the last round

Effect Your bracer fabricates a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.133i2CJObrpd3oHW]{advanced molten edge} into your free hand, then you Strike the required creature with it.
Molten Vambrace (Tactical).name: Molten Vambrace (Tactical)

Monowhip.description:
Upgrades: 1

This whip's hilt unspools a long monofilament wire that can slice grievous wounds into its targets with shocking ease.
Monowhip.name: Monowhip

Moodskin.description: Magically infused nanites injected into your skin automatically react to your mood by changing the pigmentation of your skin. The color change is gradual, typically taking at least 30 seconds to fully transition from one color to another. Moodskin can be customized to adjust which colors correspond to each mood during installation. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Moodskin.name: Moodskin

Moonlight Fibers (Commercial).description:
Several different blends of chemicals and magical accelerants have been applied to your brain stem, allowing you to speed up your response time briefly.

Activate—Engage Overdrive f

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to gain actions at the start of your turn

Effect You immediately gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of your turn, but you can use the additional action granted only to Stride or Strike. When you lose this quickened condition, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
Moonlight Fibers (Commercial).name: Moonlight Fibers (Commercial)

Moonlight Fibers (Tactical).description:
Several different blends of chemicals and magical accelerants have been applied to your brain stem, allowing you to speed up your response time briefly.

Activate—Engage Overdrive f

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to gain actions at the start of your turn

Effect You immediately gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of your turn, but you can use the additional action granted only to Stride or Strike.
Moonlight Fibers (Tactical).name: Moonlight Fibers (Tactical)

Motion Sensors (Infrared).description:
Motion sensors have a standard detection range of 30 feet and can be used to sound an alarm, send an alert to a phone, or even trigger another tech hazard or item. Creatures can detect a motion sensor they aren't already aware of as they would any other trap or hazard, using the higher of the Crafting or Survival DC of whoever installed it. If there's no external power source, each motion sensor takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 1 charge per day.

Infrared sensors respond to warm-blooded creatures but can't detect cold-blooded or artificial creatures.

Evade @Check[stealth|dc:20]

Disable @Check[computers|dc:23] or @Check[thievery|dc:23]
Motion Sensors (Infrared).name: Motion Sensors (Infrared)

Motion Sensors (Microwave).description:
Motion sensors have a standard detection range of 30 feet and can be used to sound an alarm, send an alert to a phone, or even trigger another tech hazard or item. Creatures can detect a motion sensor they aren't already aware of as they would any other trap or hazard, using the higher of the Crafting or Survival DC of whoever installed it. If there's no external power source, each motion sensor takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 1 charge per day.

Microwave sensors determine if anything is moving.

Evade @Check[acrobatics|dc:30] or @Check[stealth|dc:28]

Disable @Check[computers|dc:32] or @Check[thievery|dc:32]
Motion Sensors (Microwave).name: Motion Sensors (Microwave)

Motion Sensors (Tomographic).description:
Motion sensors have a standard detection range of 30 feet and can be used to sound an alarm, send an alert to a phone, or even trigger another tech hazard or item. Creatures can detect a motion sensor they aren't already aware of as they would any other trap or hazard, using the higher of the Crafting or Survival DC of whoever installed it. If there's no external power source, each motion sensor takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 1 charge per day.

Tomographic sensors detect disturbances through solid objects.

Evade @Check[stealth|dc:32]

Disable @Check[computers|dc:35] or @Check[thievery|dc:35]
Motion Sensors (Tomographic).name: Motion Sensors (Tomographic)

Motion Sensors (Ultrasonic).description:
Motion sensors have a standard detection range of 30 feet and can be used to sound an alarm, send an alert to a phone, or even trigger another tech hazard or item. Creatures can detect a motion sensor they aren't already aware of as they would any other trap or hazard, using the higher of the Crafting or Survival DC of whoever installed it. If there's no external power source, each motion sensor takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 1 charge per day.

Ultrasonic sensors react to sudden disruptions in local ambiance, such as the sounds of footsteps or breaking glass. Their sensitivity makes them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} to false alarms and ineffective against hovering creatures and effects like the silence spell.

Evade @Check[deception|dc:25] to [[/act create-a-diversion]] or @Check[stealth|dc:26]

Disable @Check[computers|dc:28] or @Check[thievery|dc:28], or any effect that neutralizes the sound in the detector's observed area
Motion Sensors (Ultrasonic).name: Motion Sensors (Ultrasonic)

Multithreaded Carcanet.description:
The large jewels that make up this showy necklace are etched with intricate circuitry that activates when worn against the body. The circuits can take on some of a wearer's cognitive load, increasing the speed of their thoughts. The multithreaded carcanet makes your reasoning more efficient, granting you a +2 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Multitask Recall 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} twice. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.
Multithreaded Carcanet.name: Multithreaded Carcanet

Mummified Wraps.description:
The skin of your forearms is replaced with animated cloth strips, often used to wrap a creature when they die. While not necessary for the augmentation to function, many claim the wraps are only authentic if they were once used to properly mummify a corpse with traditional ritualistic practices. Some undead wrapped in their own burial clothes are highly offended by others using this augmentation. The strips blend into your skin but are easily visible upon close inspection.

Activate—Wrap Treasure 1 (manipulate)

Requirements You have a free hand

Effect You use your wraps to grab an item. Choose an unattended item within 30 feet of no more than light Bulk, and move it up to 10 feet in any direction.

Activate—Wrap Prey 2 (manipulate)

Requirements You have a free hand

Effect The wraps consume a creature. You [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], or [[/act trip]] a creature within 15 feet. If you successfully Grab a creature, it remains @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as long as you stay within 15 feet of it, unless it Escapes.
Mummified Wraps.name: Mummified Wraps

Muscle Invigorator.description:
This augmentation keeps your muscles in peak condition. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Strength of the Colossi 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You temporarily become as destructive and powerful as a colossus. For 1 hour, your melee Strikes ignore the hardness of all objects and structures not made of adamantine or a harder material.
Muscle Invigorator.name: Muscle Invigorator

Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial.description: All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Handheld instruments include autohorns, guitars, psychoactive wave plates, digital synth decks, holoflutes, and more. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument has greater Bulk. Some instruments have the tech trait.
Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial.name: Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial)

Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical).description:
All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Handheld instruments include autohorns, guitars, psychoactive wave plates, digital synth decks, holoflutes, and more. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument has greater Bulk. Some instruments have the tech trait.

A tactical instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.
Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical).name: Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical)

Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial).description: All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Heavy instruments, such as drumdecks and theremins, are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played. Some instruments have the tech trait.
Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial).name: Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial)

Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical).description:
All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Heavy instruments, such as drumdecks and theremins, are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played. Some instruments have the tech trait.

A tactical instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.
Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical).name: Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical)

Myrmidon Siegebreaker.description:
Upgrades: 1

Created as the pinnacle of personal protection, myrmidon siegebreaker plate transforms its wearer into a walking tank. It's designed to walk into extreme punishment and out the other side. This protection comes at the cost of mobility, so soldiers wearing siegebreaker armor are usually hot-dropped on the front lines to minimize this limitation.
Myrmidon Siegebreaker.name: Myrmidon Siegebreaker

Nano-Optics Node.description:
A crystalline nanocarbon node implanted in your occipital lobe connects to optic nerves by microscopic fibers. You can activate the node to overlay your normal vision with X-ray data. You can deactivate the overlay as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Activate—X-Ray Overlay 1 (concentrate)

Effect Your nano-optics node relays collected X-ray data directly to your eyes, overlaying your normal vision. You can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white. Due to the distracting amount of visual information, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks while the overlay is active.
Nano-Optics Node.name: Nano-Optics Node

Nano-edge Rapier.description:
Upgrades: 1

The edge of this precision-crafted foil is sharpened to the thickness of a single atom, using regenerating nanites to maintain itself after countless strikes.
Nano-edge Rapier.name: Nano-edge Rapier

Nanosuit.description:
Upgrades: 0

Nanosuits were developed to hide the fact that the wearer was armored and prepared for trouble. Using a combination of nanotechnology and spellcraft, the armor can appear and disappear at will, protecting the owner when needed and hiding away in a secure pocket or even under the skin when not in use.
Nanosuit.name: Nanosuit

Neck Frill.description: These colorful folding frills can dramatically unfold in an instant. You can flare your neck frill when you [[/act demoralize]] to have the action lose the auditory trait and gain the visual trait. If you do, you don't take a penalty for not speaking a language or sharing the target's language.
Neck Frill.name: Neck Frill

Necrocortex (Advanced).description:
Your brain is augmented with necrotic energies and portions of necrotic tissue, enhancing your ability to communicate with and control your minions, especially the undead. These augmentations are installed with multiple layers of protective magic to prevent its user from being taken control of as if they were undead, but manufacturers are quick to claim that so far there have been no confirmed cases of such a situation. When you Command an undead minion you summoned or permanently control that you can see or whose senses you're sharing, you can do so telepathically, in which case Command loses the auditory trait.

Activate—Project Senses 2 (concentrate) You project your senses to an undead creature with the minion trait within 10,000 miles. The target must be a creature you summoned or permanently control. While projecting your senses, you can see and hear what your undead minion perceives, but you can't hear, see, smell, or taste what your own body experiences, though your senses of touch and pain remain. You can return your senses to your own body as a single action.

In addition, you can bind your necrocortex to a single, willing undead creature (which requires 1 hour of concentration), allowing you to Project Senses to that creature as if it were under your control.
Necrocortex (Advanced).name: Necrocortex (Advanced)

While projecting your senses, you can see and hear what your undead minion perceives, but you can't hear, see, smell, or taste what your own body experiences, though your senses of touch and pain remain. Necrocortex (Tactical).description:
Your brain is augmented with necrotic energies and portions of necrotic tissue, enhancing your ability to communicate with and control your minions, especially the undead. These augmentations are installed with multiple layers of protective magic to prevent its user from being taken control of as if they were undead, but manufacturers are quick to claim that so far there have been no confirmed cases of such a situation. When you Command an undead minion you summoned or permanently control that you can see or whose senses you're sharing, you can do so telepathically, in which case Command loses the auditory trait.

Activate—Project Senses 2 (concentrate) You project your senses to an undead creature with the minion trait within 10 miles. The target must be a creature you summoned or permanently control. While projecting your senses, you can see and hear what your undead minion perceives, but you can't hear, see, smell, or taste what your own body experiences, though your senses of touch and pain remain. You can return your senses to your own body as a single action.
Necrocortex (Tactical).name: Necrocortex (Tactical)

Necrolung (Advanced).description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from a grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when it's exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, this necrolung allows ou can breathe in any toxic atmosphere for up to 24 hours without taking damage, and you gain a +2 status bonus to saves against inhaled diseases and poisons.

Installing or removing a necrolung takes only 1 minute and requires no skill checks as it slithers down your throat and integrates into your respiratory system. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Necrolung (Advanced).name: Necrolung (Advanced)

Necrolung (Commercial).description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from this grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox. You can breathe the specific toxins in Eox's atmosphere for up to 24 hours before you begin taking damage, after which you must flush the lung in a clean atmosphere

Installing or removing a necrolung takes only 1 minute and requires no skill checks as it slithers down your throat and integrates into your respiratory system. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Necrolung (Commercial).name: Necrolung (Commercial)

Necrolung (Superior).description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from a grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when it's exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox, becoming effectively immune to the toxins in its atmosphere for an additional 24 hours per level, and you gain a +3 item bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.

Installing a necrolung takes one minute and requires no skill checks. When installed, a necrolung slithers down your throat (or appropriate alien anatomy) and integrates into your respiratory system. Most users notice a harmless pallor and rotting smell while using the tech.
Necrolung (Superior).name: Necrolung (Superior)

Necrotic Infusion (Commercial).description:
You've received an infusion of necrotized blood and void energy, causing your body to react positively to energies that would normally kill you.

Activate—Necrotize Blood r (void)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take void damage

Effect Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance to void damage and weakness to vitality damage equal to twice your level. If the triggering damage would heal undead, you take no damage and are instead healed as if you were undead.
Necrotic Infusion (Commercial).name: Necrotic Infusion (Commercial)

Necrotic Infusion (Tactical).description:

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You would take void damage

Effect Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance to void damage and weakness to vitality damage equal to twice your level. If the triggering damage would heal undead, you take no damage and are instead healed as if you were undead.
Necrotic Infusion (Tactical).name: Necrotic Infusion (Tactical)

Neural Dampener (Advanced).description:
Runic circuits are wired across the surface of your brain, providing protection against attempts to read your thoughts or otherwise attack your mind. You gain mental resistance 15.

Activate—Raise Mental Defenses 1 (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Psychic energy surges across the dampener's circuitry, you gain +3 circumstance bonus to Will Saves and Will DCs against mental effects for 1 minute.
Neural Dampener (Advanced).name: Neural Dampener (Advanced)

Neural Dampener (Commercial).description:
Runic circuits are wired across the surface of your brain, providing protection against attempts to read your thoughts or otherwise attack your mind. You gain mental resistance 5.

Activate—Raise Mental Defenses 1 (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Psychic energy surges across the dampener's circuitry, you gain +1 circumstance bonus to Will Saves and Will DCs against mental effects for 1 minute.
Neural Dampener (Commercial).name: Neural Dampener (Commercial)

Neural Dampener (Tactical).description:
Runic circuits are wired across the surface of your brain, providing protection against attempts to read your thoughts or otherwise attack your mind. You gain mental resistance 10.

Activate—Raise Mental Defenses 1 (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Psychic energy surges across the dampener's circuitry, you gain +2 circumstance bonus to Will Saves and Will DCs against mental effects for 1 minute.
Neural Dampener (Tactical).name: Neural Dampener (Tactical)

Neural Lash.description:
Upgrades: 1

This whiplike tendril of electricity subtly responds to psychic signals. Telepaths who wield a properly calibrated neural lash treat it as an extension of their body.
Neural Lash.name: Neural Lash

Neurocam.description:
Activate 10 minutes

This strange helmet is covered in flashing lights and adjustable straps with a blinder that covers the eyes. When activated, the device scans your brain and creates a digital copy in a specially designed memory card that can be used with a mnemonic editor to restore your brain to the same state it was in when the recording took place. This retroactively restores any options changed due to retraining, but if you've gained a character level since using the neurocam using options you no longer qualify for, the mnemonic editor adjusts your memories to compensate, and you can immediately select new options.

Some spellcasters have used neurocams as components with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual to return a loved one as a living hologram or SRO, especially when the cause of the target's death involves especially traumatic memories.
Neurocam.name: Neurocam

Nihili Gaze (Commercial).description:
Your eyes are replaced with those of a nihili, decompressing your enemies with your gaze and preventing them from filling their lungs.

Activate—Decompressing Stare 2 (concentrate, occult, visual)

Frequency once per hour

Effect Your eyes glaze over with the hollow void of space, forcing a creature you can see within 30 feet to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is fatigued for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
Nihili Gaze (Commercial).name: Nihili Gaze (Commercial)
