Failure The target is fatigued for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
Nihili Gaze (Tactical).name: Nihili Gaze (Tactical)

Noxious Sweat (Advanced).description:
Enhanced sweat glands secrete a foul, oily substance on command, surrounding you in a noxious stench.

Activate—Skunk It 1 (aura, manipulate, poison)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You create a stench cloud in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. Creatures that enter the cloud or begin their turn inside it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
Noxious Sweat (Advanced).name: Noxious Sweat (Advanced)

Noxious Sweat (Commercial).description:
Enhanced sweat glands secrete a foul, oily substance on command, surrounding you in a noxious stench.

Activate—Skunk It 1 (aura, manipulate, poison)

Frequency once per day

Effect You create a stench cloud in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. Creatures that enter the cloud or begin their turn inside it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
Noxious Sweat (Commercial).name: Noxious Sweat (Commercial)

Noxious Sweat (Tactical).name: Noxious Sweat (Tactical)

Null Space Chamber (Advanced).description:
This sleek black device attaches to a backpack, purse, or key ring. When you press a button on the side of the device, it creates a circular portal to an extradimensional pocket space. The space's capacity depends on the device's type.

You can Interact with the null space chamber to stow items in it or remove them. The null space chamber can be opened and closed only from the outside. When a null space chamber is opened in an atmosphere with air, it fills with 10 minutes' worth of air for every Bulk left in its capacity. An item inside the null space chamber provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. Connecting the null space chamber to a computer causes it to display a readout of all items stored within it.

Capacity 100 Bulk
Null Space Chamber (Advanced).name: Null Space Chamber (Advanced)

Null-Space Holster.description:
These stylish faux-leather holsters store weapons in a specialized extradimensional space and eject them on command. They're a favorite of trick shooters, smugglers, and professional soldiers alike. A null-space holster functions as a commercial null-space chamber, except that it can only hold weapons and has a capacity of only 12 Bulk. It comes with a set of six tags that can be affixed to weapons, allowing them to be recalled remotely.

Activate—Call Weapon f (auditory)

Frequency once per round

Effect With a whistle, snap, or other command, you summon a weapon into your hand. You can drop any number of weapons you're already wielding, then you Interact to draw a single weapon from your null-space holster.

Activate—Recall Weapons 2 (auditory)

Effect You utter a different command sound, and any of your tagged weapons within 100 feet return to the null-space holster.
Null-Space Holster.name: Null-Space Holster

Null-Space Pocket.description: A null-space pocket allows the user to stow a single item of 2 Bulk or less into an extradimensional space. You cannot draw a weapon while it's in a null-space pocket, but you can use an Interact action to retrieve it. Creatures gain a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception checks and Perception DCs to notice if you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Concealed an Object} in a worn null-space pocket.
Null-Space Pocket.name: Null-Space Pocket

Numbing Beam Pistol.description:
Upgrades 1

Originally designed during the Silent War, this technology is still deployed by Stewards in combat situations. The numbing beam pistol fires a single burst of cold energy in an attempt to freeze limbs or appendages.
Numbing Beam Pistol.name: Numbing Beam Pistol

Numbing Beam Rifle.description:
Upgrades 1

The numbing beam rifle was designed with the same technology used for numbing beam pistols but is calibrated to take down tougher foes. Numbing beam rifles are often deployed against burly threats so they can be properly apprehended.
Numbing Beam Rifle.name: Numbing Beam Rifle

Ossifying Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 2 rounds

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 3d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Advanced).name: Ossifying Grenade (Advanced)

Ossifying Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 1d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:5] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.

Overlord Buckle.description: This shield resembles a buckled leather glove until its buckle deploys a sturdy carbon steel plate and uses injected adrenal responses to defend against mental intrusions.
Overlord Buckle.name: Overlord Buckle

Pacifier Ammunition (Commercial).description: Beloved by tyrants, mentalists, and law enforcement officers alike, these multicolored projectiles make targets more susceptible to mental effects. On a critical hit with this ammunition, the target takes a –1 status penalty to its Will saves for 1 minute.
Pacifier Ammunition (Commercial).name: Pacifier Ammunition (Commercial)

Pacifier Ammunition (Tactical).description: Beloved by tyrants, mentalists, and law enforcement officers alike, these multicolored projectiles make targets more susceptible to mental effects. On a critical hit with this ammunition, the target takes a –2 status penalty to its Will saves for 1 minute.
Pacifier Ammunition (Tactical).name: Pacifier Ammunition (Tactical)

Pact Enforcer Armor.description: Carbon steel plate forms a protective cage around the wearer that can stand up to punishing damage.
Pact Enforcer Armor.name: Pact Enforcer Armor

Pact Keeper Armor.description: This standard issue full set of Steward armor has a simple, functional design with space for adornments and medals to be attached once earned.
Pact Keeper Armor.name: Pact Keeper Armor

Pact Observer Armor.description: This lightweight armor is often worn by medics, scouts, and team leaders. This model comes with an upgrade slot to allow for ease of usability and modification in the field as needed, as the Stewards recon squads never know what they're going to face.
Pact Observer Armor.name: Pact Observer Armor

Pain Journal (Commercial).description:
Your raw emotions empower the poems and phrases penned in this synthetic leather journal. After spending 1 day writing in your pain journal, select Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. Once a skill is selected for a pain journal, it can't be changed. Reading directly from the journal harnesses your painful memories, projects your emotions, and gives you a +1 item bonus to checks using the selected skill.

Activate—Painful Memory 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You recite a poem of utter anguish to spread your misery to another creature, casting a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk]{Share Pain} (DC 23).
Pain Journal (Commercial).name: Pain Journal (Commercial)

Pain Journal (Tactical).description:
Your raw emotions empower the poems and phrases penned in this synthetic leather journal. After spending 1 day writing in your pain journal, select Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. Once a skill is selected for a pain journal, it can't be changed. Reading directly from the journal harnesses your painful memories, projects your emotions, and gives you a +2 item bonus to checks using the selected skill.

Activate—Painful Memory 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You recite a poem of utter anguish to spread your misery to another creature, casting a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk]{Share Pain} (DC 34).
Pain Journal (Tactical).name: Pain Journal (Tactical)

Painglaive.description:
Upgrades: 1

This fierce but deceptively elegant polearm rips apart enemies with a motor-powered fangblade. An adjustable pulse trigger allows the wielder to channel extra pain through the weapon.
Painglaive.name: Painglaive

Painter Ammunition.description: The heads of these rounds glow in a variety of neon colors. When you hit with this ammunition, the target is coated in phosphorescent chemicals until the start of your next turn. The target isn't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} due to dim lighting, and if it would be hidden or undetected due to darkness or invisibility, it's concealed instead. If you critically hit the target, it's instead fully visible in dim light or darkness and has any invisibility @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the start of your next turn.
Painter Ammunition.name: Painter Ammunition

Parallel Accord.description:
A parallel accord is a small metallic disk ringed with magical runes that transcend reality, serving as a nexus for a number of your parallel selves. When invested, a parallel accord hovers over your head like a crown.

Activate—Parallel Positioning r (concentration, teleportation)

Trigger You succeed at a saving throw against a spell or a Strike misses you

Frequency once per day

Effect You tap into one of the alternate realities linked to your parallel accord, repositioning yourself into a location you occupy in another reality. You teleport to any unoccupied square you can see within 20 feet. If you critically succeeded at the triggering saving throw or were critically missed by the triggering Strike, you additionally become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the beginning of your next turn, as your body is shrouded in fragmented reflections of other realities.
Parallel Accord.name: Parallel Accord

Patagium (Commercial).description:
A thin, fleshy membrane stretches between your front and hind limbs. You can spread your patagium as a single Interact action as long as you aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor. While your patagium is spread, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet, but you can't gain altitude using this fly Speed and must descend at least 1 foot for every 5 feet you move horizontally.

Activate—Emergency Spread r

Trigger You fall at least 10 feet

Requirements You aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor

Effect You Interact to spread your patagium, arresting your fall. If you hit the ground before the start of your next turn, you take no damage from falling.
Patagium (Commercial).name: Patagium (Commercial)

Patagium (Tactical).description:
A thin, fleshy membrane stretches between your front and hind limbs. You can spread your patagium as a single Interact action as long as you aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor. While your patagium is spread, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet, but you can't gain altitude using this fly Speed and must descend at least 1 foot for every 5 feet you move horizontally.

Activate—Emergency Spread r

Trigger You fall at least 10 feet

Requirements You aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor

Effect You Interact to spread your patagium, arresting your fall. If you hit the ground before the start of your next turn, you take no damage from falling.

Activate—Airbrake r

Trigger You would be moved by a forced movement effect other than falling

Effect You snap your patagium open, arresting your momentum. You're moved only 5 feet by the triggering effect.
Patagium (Tactical).name: Patagium (Tactical)

Petrified Bark.description:
Note Petrified heritage only

Your body is covered in thick, plated bark. Your bark is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of 16, and has the bulwark, comfort, and exposed traits. You can never wear other armor or remove the bark. You can etch armor runes onto the bark.
Petrified Bark.name: Petrified Bark

Petroleum Bravery.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This strange green slime is applied to the chest, where it seeps into the heart and bolsters your courage. For 1 hour after applying petroleum bravery, you have resistance 2 to mental and spirit damage. A tin of petroleum bravery has six uses before it's emptied.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.0mm60d3wjB5pdXiN]{Effect: Petroleum Bravery}

Note: The item's activation, Bulk, price and usage are listed according to SFS Rulings and Clarifications.
Petroleum Bravery.name: Petroleum Bravery

Phase Cutlass.description:
Upgrades: 1

A phase cutlass resembles a traditional curved sword until it's powered. Then its blade morphs into a shimmering void, with a tiny star for each life it ended.
Phase Cutlass.name: Phase Cutlass

Phase Shield.description: A phase shield is an intricate but durable technological device often worn strapped to a limb or belt that projects a protective hardlight barrier when deployed. Phase shields are translucent and tinted, with a wide variety of fully customizable colors and image projectors. Many wielders choose an image of a favorite celebrity, loved one, or pleasant scenery to bolster their fighting spirit in a dire situation.
Phase Shield.name: Phase Shield

Phasic Limb.description: One of your hands is implanted with a runic mesh infused with the essence of the Ethereal Plane, allowing you to reach into that dimension. You can touch incorporeal creatures and objects with the chosen hand and with any items you hold with it. Unarmed attacks made with the chosen hand, and one-handed weapons you wield with it, trigger vulnerabilities and bypass resistances as if they have the ghost killer upgrade.
Phasic Limb.name: Phasic Limb

Pheromone Gland (Commercial).description: Enhanced pheromone glands are implanted in your throat and wrists, constantly releasing faint but effective chemical hormones. These pheromones don't have a smell, and their effects are imperceptible unless you're communicating with a creature that normally communicates primarily through pheromones. You get a +1 item bonus to Nature checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal}. If you have a wildwise graft or other way of communicating directly with animals, you also get a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks on animals.
Pheromone Gland (Commercial).name: Pheromone Gland (Commercial)

Pheromone Gland (Tactical).description: Enhanced pheromone glands are implanted in your throat and wrists, constantly releasing faint but effective chemical hormones. These pheromones don't have a smell, and their effects are imperceptible unless you're communicating with a creature that normally communicates primarily through pheromones. You get a +2 item bonus to Nature checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal}. If you have a wildwise graft or other way of communicating directly with animals, you also get a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.
Pheromone Gland (Tactical).name: Pheromone Gland (Tactical)

Phoboverge.description:
Upgrades: 2

A micro-singularity at the center of this sinister submachine gun siphons negative emotions it projects onto others. A rumor suggests that phoboverges harvest and curate particularly exquisite suffering for some unknown extraplanar entity.
Phoboverge.name: Phoboverge

Photon Crystal (Commercial).description: A photon crystal increases the flow of photon into your solar manifestations, burning and blinding your foes. While photon attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage. On a critical hit while you're photon attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
Photon Crystal (Commercial).name: Photon Crystal (Commercial)

Photon Crystal (Tactical).description:
A photon crystal increases the flow of photon into your solar manifestations, burning and blinding your foes. While photon attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage. On a critical hit while you're photon attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 2 rounds.

Damage dealt by your solar weapon or flare while photon attuned ignores the target's resistance to fire.
Photon Crystal (Tactical).name: Photon Crystal (Tactical)

Photosynthetic Skin.description: Specialized nanites enhance your natural surface cells, allowing them to convert solar radiation into nourishment for your body. You don't need to eat, and you're never @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} as a result of hunger or starvation as long as you spend at least 1 hour per day basking in direct sunlight. You can bask as part of a normal 8-hour rest period.
Photosynthetic Skin.name: Photosynthetic Skin

Piloting Instruments (Commercial).description: This set of advanced piloting instruments is integrated directly into your armor and includes a set of spinal ports that directly connect to vehicles you pilot. You gain a +1 item bonus to Piloting checks, and you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.yh9O9BQjwWrAIiuf]{Take Control} as a free action once per turn unless it would normally be a multi-action activity.
Piloting Instruments (Commercial).name: Piloting Instruments (Commercial)

Piloting Instruments (Tactical).description:
This set of advanced piloting instruments is integrated directly into your armor and includes a set of spinal ports that directly connect to vehicles you pilot. You gain a +2 item bonus to Piloting checks, and you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.yh9O9BQjwWrAIiuf]{Take Control} as a free action once per turn unless it would normally be a multi-action activity.

You don't take the usual penalty to Piloting checks to perform a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7KMyRISNqp7JTzMn]{Stunt} or use the 3-action version of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.uS3qDAgOkZ7b8ERL]{Drive}.
Piloting Instruments (Tactical).name: Piloting Instruments (Tactical)

Plasma Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This long-barreled weapon shoots charges of ionized gas that explode in a blast of superheated plasma.
Plasma Cannon.name: Plasma Cannon

Plasma Caster.description:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol shoots balls of condensed plasma. Holding down the trigger and safety clip at the same time before firing results in the barrel building up more plasma.
Plasma Caster.name: Plasma Caster

Plasma Doshko.description:
Upgrades: 1

Unlike a traditional doshko, this poleaxe uses blades of magnetically stabilized plasma that spin to cleave through multiple enemies with ease.
Plasma Doshko.name: Plasma Doshko

Plasma Pike.description:
Upgrades: 1

Derived from spectra technology, this high-tech spear can release a gout of plasma to reach any foe.

Activate—Fulminating Pike 1 to 2 (manipulate)

Requirements You're trained with this weapon; Cost 10 battery charges

Effect Your plasma spike briefly lengthens, expands, and pulses, gaining the arc trait and increasing its reach to 15 feet for the duration of this effect. Strike for each action spent to use this ability, but each Strike must have a different target.
Plasma Pike.name: Plasma Pike

Plasma Sword.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sword generates a focused beam of plasma around a localized force field powered by a generator in the sword's hilt. The beam only blazes to life when the sword is powered.
Plasma Sword.name: Plasma Sword

Pneumatic Basher.description:
Upgrades: 1

Automated pistons and side exhausts discharge compressed air when this pneumatic cylinder collides with flesh or surface.

Activate—Pneumatic Shove f

Trigger You successfully Strike a creature with this weapon; Cost 10 battery charges

Effect The pneumatic basher discharges compressed air, allowing you to Shove the target using the same multiple attack penalty as the triggering Strike, if any.
Pneumatic Basher.name: Pneumatic Basher

Polyglove.description:
Upgrades: 1

This glove features dozens of delicate tools for building or repairing computers and other technological items, requiring an entire hand (or suitable appendage) to manipulate. Overclocking the polyglove's components generates voltage between a wielder's fingertips.
Polyglove.name: Polyglove

Portable Amp.description: This small device is typically synced up to an instrument, microphone, or the audio playback on a datapad. It amplifies the audio volume, reducing the DC of Perception checks to hear the audio by 5.
Portable Amp.name: Portable Amp

Pow! Ammunition.description:
Ammunition projectile

Invented by Zo! Media prop designers, this special ammunition is designed to explode in a dramatic fanfare fit for a media production without sacrificing any lethality. A weapon loaded with POW! ammunition automatically attempts to [[/act feint]] targets within its first range increment. Targets of your Feint are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against ranged attacks in your first range increment rather than melee attacks, depending on the result of the save.
Pow! Ammunition.name: Pow! Ammunition

Predator Teeth (Commercial).description: Your incisors are replaced with viciously pointed versions based on a predator of your choice. Models that instead replace all your teeth with fangs are also available. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits.
Predator Teeth (Commercial).name: Predator Teeth (Commercial)

Predator Teeth (Tactical).description:
Your incisors are replaced with viciously pointed versions based on a predator of your choice. Models that instead replace all your teeth with fangs are also available. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits.

Whenever you get a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.
Predator Teeth (Tactical).name: Predator Teeth (Tactical)

Predictive Eyes (Commercial).description:
Using predictive algorithms and minor divinations, runic lenses transmit information at a rapid pace to the parietal lobe of your brain, helping you avoid danger.

Activate—Track Movement 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Choose one creature within 60 feet that you can see. Your predictive eyes track that creature to give you split-second predictions of its actions. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws against attacks and effects from that creature. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RDwKC2xVJVhCjGlE]{Anticipate Danger} class feat, this bonus applies to your Perception DC when you Anticipate Danger.
Predictive Eyes (Commercial).name: Predictive Eyes (Commercial)

Predictive Eyes (Tactical).description:
Using predictive algorithms and minor divinations, runic lenses transmit information at a rapid pace to the parietal lobe of your brain, helping you avoid danger.

Activate—Track Movement 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Choose up to 2 creatures within 60 feet that you can see. Your predictive eyes track those creatures to give you split-second predictions of their actions. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws against attacks and effects from those creatures. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RDwKC2xVJVhCjGlE]{Anticipate Danger} class feat, this bonus applies to your Perception DC when you Anticipate Danger.
Predictive Eyes (Tactical).name: Predictive Eyes (Tactical)

Presence Intensifier.description:
This augmentation strengthens your personality, intensifying the parts of you that form the core of your identity. You gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Charisma modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Irresistible Idea 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You manipulate your cosmetics to influence a creature as a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} (DC 38).
Presence Intensifier.name: Presence Intensifier

Programmer's Plushie (Advanced).description:
These miniatures come in many shapes, often resembling a programmer's personal avatar or popular media character, such as Captain Concierge or Zo!. The plush helps organize your thoughts; you gain a +3 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Secret Password 2 (auditory)

Effect You whisper a secret passcode known only to yourself and your programmer's plushie, securing a computer, container, door, or lock from intrusion as a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock} with a DC of 35. Any creature can bypass this lock using the passcode while touching the target with the programmer's plushie.
Programmer's Plushie (Advanced).name: Programmer's Plushie (Advanced)

Programmer's Plushie (Commercial).description:
These miniatures come in many shapes, often resembling a programmer's personal avatar or popular media character, such as Captain Concierge or Zo!. The plush helps organize your thoughts; you gain a +1 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Secret Password 2 (auditory)

Effect You whisper a secret passcode known only to yourself and your programmer's plushie, securing a computer, container, door, or lock from intrusion as a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock} with a DC of 18. Any creature can bypass this lock using the passcode while touching the target with the programmer's plushie.
Programmer's Plushie (Commercial).name: Programmer's Plushie (Commercial)

Programmer's Plushie (Tactical).description:
These miniatures come in many shapes, often resembling a programmer's personal avatar or popular media character, such as Captain Concierge or Zo!. The plush helps organize your thoughts; you gain a +2 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Secret Password 2 (auditory)

Effect You whisper a secret passcode known only to yourself and your programmer's plushie, securing a computer, container, door, or lock from intrusion as a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock} with a DC of 25. Any creature can bypass this lock using the passcode while touching the target with the programmer's plushie.
Programmer's Plushie (Tactical).name: Programmer's Plushie (Tactical)

Prosthetic Limb.description: This prosthesis replaces a missing or damaged limb. Prosthetic limbs are common augmentations available at UPB printing kiosks on many worlds and come in many different materials and sizes. The augmentation restores functionality, including the ability to install other augmentations in the limb, but it's no more durable than and doesn't otherwise function differently from the replaced limb. A prosthetic limb can replace one you've lost, or you can have a limb removed to replace it with a prosthetic. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Prosthetic Limb.name: Prosthetic Limb

Protection Grid (Commercial).description: This upgrade embeds an energy shield generator into the weapon. The weapon gains the parry trait.
Protection Grid (Commercial).name: Protection Grid (Commercial)

Protection Grid (Tactical).description: This upgrade embeds an energy shield generator into the weapon. The weapon gains the parry trait. The circumstance bonus to AC from positioning the weapon defensively increases to +2.
Protection Grid (Tactical).name: Protection Grid (Tactical)

Protosol.description:
This strange, glowing pod is warm to the touch and composed of stellar energy.

Activate—Absorb Stellar Energy 1 (manipulate) You rub the protosol's surface, absorbing the stellar energy from the pod into your own body. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds for 1 minute. At any time during this duration, you can end the effect as a single action to expel the stellar energy around you, dealing @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage to all adjacent creatures (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save).
Protosol.name: Protosol

Psyche Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol uses quickly dissolving neurotoxic compounds that wrack a target's nervous system to incapacitate them.
Psyche Pistol.name: Psyche Pistol

Psychic Fedora (Advanced).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[6d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Advanced).name: Psychic Fedora (Advanced)

Psychic Fedora (Commercial).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[2d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:18|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Commercial).name: Psychic Fedora (Commercial)

Psychic Fedora (Elite).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[10d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:39|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Elite).name: Psychic Fedora (Elite)

Psychic Fedora (Superior).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[8d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:34|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Superior).name: Psychic Fedora (Superior)

Psychic Fedora (Tactical).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, Psychic Interrogation, Read Mental Dossier, and the Psychic Tap ability of intercepting ears.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[4d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:23|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Tactical).name: Psychic Fedora (Tactical)

Psychic Shielding (Advanced).description:
This armor has a carefully enchanted lining that prevents psychic intrusions and mental harm. You gain resistance 15 to mental damage.

Activate—Cleanse Mind r (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition

Effect You reduce the value of the triggering stupefied condition by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you aren't stupefied.
Psychic Shielding (Advanced).name: Psychic Shielding (Advanced)

Psychic Shielding (Commercial).description:
This armor has a carefully enchanted lining that prevents psychic intrusions and mental harm. You gain resistance 5 to mental damage.

Activate—Cleanse Mind r (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition

Effect You reduce the value of the triggering stupefied condition by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you aren't stupefied.
Psychic Shielding (Commercial).name: Psychic Shielding (Commercial)

Psychic Shielding (Tactical).description:
This armor has a carefully enchanted lining that prevents psychic intrusions and mental harm. You gain resistance 10 to mental damage.

Activate—Cleanse Mind r (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency twice per day

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition

Effect You reduce the value of the triggering stupefied condition by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you aren't stupefied.
Psychic Shielding (Tactical).name: Psychic Shielding (Tactical)

Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial).description:
Your irises are injected with psychoactive dyes that cause a signature kaleidoscopic effect, or your eyes have been completely replaced with delicate magitech devices. You can activate these dyes to enthrall those you look upon with varying effects depending on the item's type.

Activate—Gaze 2 (concentrate, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:17] saving throw with the following results.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated for as long as it can see you. Taking a hostile action against the creature ends the effect.
Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial).name: Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial)

Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical).description:
Your irises are injected with psychoactive dyes that cause a signature kaleidoscopic effect, or your eyes have been completely replaced with delicate magitech devices. You can activate these dyes to enthrall those you look upon with varying effects depending on the item's type.

Activate—Gaze 2 (concentrate, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:20] saving throw with the following results.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated and becomes helpful for as long as it can see you. Taking a hostile action against the creature ends the effect.
Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical).name: Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical)

Pulse Gauntlet.description:
Upgrades: 1

Popularized in underground fighting circles, this heavy-duty nanocarbon glove amplifies and weaponizes sounds made by its wielder, generating a sonic boom strong enough to knock an enemy off their feet.
Pulse Gauntlet.name: Pulse Gauntlet

Pulsecaster Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.
Pulsecaster Pistol.name: Pulsecaster Pistol

Puzzleblade.description:
Upgrades: 1

This kasathan sword breaks down into interlocking pieces for storage and transport. Traditionalists practice the art of ritually assembling puzzleblades, with different pieces symbolizing the kasathan virtues of conviction, dedication, moderation, and tradition. Criminals and smugglers value the puzzleblade for its discreet design.
Puzzleblade.name: Puzzleblade

Quantum Multitool Appendage (Commercial).description:
Cleverly designed nanoparticles replace your hands or similar appendages. In their inactive state, they resemble normal hands, but they can transform with a single Interact action into a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.ao5MC3I1b4Gx9LNC]{tactical infiltrator's toolkit}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.pMvFn7PTtcpIANTe]{tactical maker's toolkit}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.aDsdYMPpVc8hOnM5]{tactical repair toolkit}.

Activate—Self-correct r (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail a Crafting or Thievery check while your quantum multitool appendage is transformed

Effect The onboard AI partly corrects your error, turning the triggering critical failure into a failure.
Quantum Multitool Appendage (Commercial).name: Quantum Multitool Appendage (Commercial)

Quantum Multitool Appendage (Tactical).description:
Cleverly designed nanoparticles replace your hands or similar appendages. In their inactive state, they resemble normal hands, but they can transform with a single Interact action into a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.ao5MC3I1b4Gx9LNC]{tactical infiltrator's toolkit}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.pMvFn7PTtcpIANTe]{tactical maker's toolkit}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.aDsdYMPpVc8hOnM5]{tactical repair toolkit}. The item bonus granted by the tactical toolkits produced by the augmentation increases to +2.

Activate—Self-correct r (manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You critically fail a Crafting or Thievery check while your quantum multitool appendage is transformed

Effect The onboard AI partly corrects your error, turning the triggering critical failure into a failure.
Quantum Multitool Appendage (Tactical).name: Quantum Multitool Appendage (Tactical)

Quantum Reaver.description:
The edge of this glowing, several-foot-long blade wavers and blurs, and reality seems to fracture when it's swung, offering fleeting glimpses of other worlds along its path. The quantum reaver is an advanced-grade weapon, and can be improved as normal.

Activate—Spatial Slice 2

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Effect You phase the quantum reaver through space-time, making a melee Strike against any creature within 30 feet as if you were adjacent to it. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 3 rounds.
Quantum Reaver.name: Quantum Reaver

Quasar Crystal.description: Quasar crystals condense your solar energy into a single point ready to release on impact. Attacks with this weapon are a critical hit on a 19 on the die as long as that result is a success. This property has no effect on a 19 if the result would be a failure.
Quasar Crystal.name: Quasar Crystal

Quick-Charge Hand (Advanced).description:
Capacitive pads are woven into the surface of your fingers, building and storing a charge of electricity throughout the day that you can use to quickly and wirelessly charge other batteries and devices.

Activate—Rapid EMF Charge f

Frequency twice per day

Requirements You're touching, holding, or wielding a advanced or lower grade battery or an item that contains such a battery

Effect You fully recharge the required battery.
Quick-Charge Hand (Advanced).name: Quick-Charge Hand (Advanced)

Quick-Charge Hand (Commercial).description:
Capacitive pads are woven into the surface of your fingers, building and storing a charge of electricity throughout the day that you can use to quickly and wirelessly charge other batteries and devices.

Activate—Rapid EMF Charge f

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're touching, holding, or wielding a commercial-grade battery or an item that contains such a battery

Effect You fully recharge the required battery.
Quick-Charge Hand (Commercial).name: Quick-Charge Hand (Commercial)

Quick-Charge Hand (Elite).description:
Capacitive pads are woven into the surface of your fingers, building and storing a charge of electricity throughout the day that you can use to quickly and wirelessly charge other batteries and devices.

Activate—Rapid EMF Charge f

Frequency thrice per day

Requirements You're touching, holding, or wielding a elite or lower grade battery or an item that contains such a battery

Effect You fully recharge the required battery.
Quick-Charge Hand (Elite).name: Quick-Charge Hand (Elite)

Quick-Charge Hand (Superior).description:
Capacitive pads are woven into the surface of your fingers, building and storing a charge of electricity throughout the day that you can use to quickly and wirelessly charge other batteries and devices.

Activate—Rapid EMF Charge f

Frequency twice per day

Requirements You're touching, holding, or wielding a superior or lower grade battery or an item that contains such a battery

Effect You fully recharge the required battery.
Quick-Charge Hand (Superior).name: Quick-Charge Hand (Superior)

Quick-Charge Hand (Tactical).description:
Capacitive pads are woven into the surface of your fingers, building and storing a charge of electricity throughout the day that you can use to quickly and wirelessly charge other batteries and devices.

Activate—Rapid EMF Charge f

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're touching, holding, or wielding a commercial or tactical-grade battery or an item that contains such a battery

Effect You fully recharge the required battery.
Quick-Charge Hand (Tactical).name: Quick-Charge Hand (Tactical)

Quicklock.description: A quicklock weapon has multiple tracking devices and additional computer processors to increase the rapidity of its built-in targeting systems, allowing its wielder to strike rapidly. While wielding a quicklock weapon, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition, but you can use the additional action granted only to make a Strike with the weapon.
Quicklock.name: Quicklock

Quills (Advanced).description:
Your skin is enhanced with retractable quills or bone spines that hide in puckered pores when not in use. You can extend or retract the quills with an Interact action but can't use or deploy them while wearing heavy armor.

Activate—Prickly Defense r

Trigger A creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack or successfully Grapples you

Requirements Your quills are extended

Effect You deal @Damage[6d6[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, the attacker also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
Quills (Advanced).name: Quills (Advanced)

Quills (Commercial).description:
Your skin is enhanced with retractable quills or bone spines that hide in puckered pores when not in use. You can extend or retract the quills with an Interact action but can't use or deploy them while wearing heavy armor.

Activate—Prickly Defense r

Trigger A creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack or successfully Grapples you

Requirements Your quills are extended

Effect You deal @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, the attacker also takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
Quills (Commercial).name: Quills (Commercial)

Quills (Superior).description:
Your skin is enhanced with retractable quills or bone spines that hide in puckered pores when not in use. You can extend or retract the quills with an Interact action but can't use or deploy them while wearing heavy armor.

Activate—Prickly Defense r

Trigger A creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack or successfully Grapples you

Requirements Your quills are extended

Effect You deal @Damage[8d6[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, the attacker also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
Quills (Superior).name: Quills (Superior)

Quills (Tactical).description:
Your skin is enhanced with retractable quills or bone spines that hide in puckered pores when not in use. You can extend or retract the quills with an Interact action but can't use or deploy them while wearing heavy armor.

Activate—Prickly Defense r

Trigger A creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack or successfully Grapples you

Requirements Your quills are extended

Effect You deal @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, the attacker also takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
Quills (Tactical).name: Quills (Tactical)

Quilted Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This armor is made of layered fabrics stitched together and is popular with scavengers. On Akiton, some suits of quilted armor are actually constructed of heirloom blankets and garments repurposed for protection.
Quilted Armor.name: Quilted Armor

Radiant Star Mote.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A single mote of light shines in this glass vial, emitting bright light in a 20-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 20 feet. When you open the vial, the mote collides with a creature within 60 feet of your choice. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as their equilibrium is wildly thrown off, and begins to glow like a star (bright light for 20 feet, then dim light for 20 more). During the duration, if the creature was or becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed or becomes concealed for any other reason, they are no longer concealed. They must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19] save; a willing creature can choose to fail or critically fail.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is affected for 1 round.

Failure The creature is affected for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is affected for 10 minutes.
Radiant Star Mote.name: Radiant Star Mote

Radiation Buffer (Advanced).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 8 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Advanced).name: Radiation Buffer (Advanced)

Radiation Buffer (Commercial).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 2 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Commercial).name: Radiation Buffer (Commercial)

Radiation Buffer (Superior).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 12 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +4 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Superior).name: Radiation Buffer (Superior)

Radiation Buffer (Tactical).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 4 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Tactical).name: Radiation Buffer (Tactical)

Radiation Module (Commercial).description: This radioactive core irradiates the weapon. The weapon deals an extra 1d6 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save against severe radiation sickness.
Radiation Module (Commercial).name: Radiation Module (Commercial)

Radiation Module (Tactical).description:
This radioactive core irradiates the weapon. The weapon deals an extra 1d6 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save against severe radiation sickness.

Poison damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target’s poison resistance.
Radiation Module (Tactical).name: Radiation Module (Tactical)

Radiation Sweeper.description: This handheld device is capable of detecting radiation within 120 feet. When you Interact with the device, it emits pings in different tones to indicate the presence of low, medium, high, or severe radiation. It also displays the areas of radiation on a simple screen. It automatically updates the data as you move until the beginning of your next turn. After that, you must Interact with the device again to conduct another sweep. A radiation sweeper can't detect radiation through 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force field. A radiation sweeper is immune to the effects of radiation.
Radiation Sweeper.name: Radiation Sweeper

Raptorial Edge.description:
Upgrades: 1

This macabre weapon integrates still-living biological material from a Krethiskar Swarm component, kept vital by necromancy and power from the weapon's battery. When this superior phase cutlass is powered, it deals mental damage rather than void damage as the szandite crystals within it project a sickly glow that surrounds the blade.

One of the raptorial edge's upgrade slots has a unique 8th-level upgrade permanently installed with the acid, magical, and tech traits. This upgrade causes the weapon to deal an additional 1d6 acid damage, plus 1d10 persistent acid damage on a critical hit. The upgrade cannot be removed, but it can be improved for 60,000 credits to a 15th-level upgrade. This improvement increases the persistent acid damage on a critical hit to 2d10 and causes all acid damage dealt by the raptorial edge to ignore a target's acid resistance.

Activate—Mind Slice f (mental)

Trigger You critically hit with a Strike with the raptorial edge

Effect You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target and find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours, unless the target succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:28|showDC:all] save.
Raptorial Edge.name: Raptorial Edge

Reaction Breacher.description:
Upgrades: 1

This portable reaction cannon launches flak from miniature cluster missiles that rip through a fortified structure and anyone unfortunate enough to be inside.
Reaction Breacher.name: Reaction Breacher

Reality Distorter.description:
This device emits ripples of energy creating small distortions within reality around your foes.

Activate—Distort! r

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature moves adjacent to you

Effect Your armor unleashes a bubble of distorted reality keyed to the quantum signature of the triggering creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on you that lasts 1 minute. The triggering creature treats the area as difficult terrain.
Reality Distorter.name: Reality Distorter

Reality Ripper.description:
This sleek rifle converts energy into projectiles of concentrated magic that tears apart matter by destroying its bindings to the reality. A reality ripper is modular and has two modes: destructive and reaping. While in destructive mode, the reality ripper deals acid damage and gains the razing trait. While in reaping mode, a reality ripper deals void damage and gains the concussive trait.

A realty ripper's minimum weapon improvement is tactical, meaning its tracking +1 cannot be removed, though further improvements can be still applied.
Reality Ripper.name: Reality Ripper

Reality-Splicing Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Radius @Template[burst|distance:20]

This grenade is constantly changing, appearing as different colors, materials, and sizes. When detonated, it taps into another plane or reality. Roll a d20 to determine the effect, and use your class DC if the effect calls for a saving throw.

REALITY SPLICING GRENADE EFFECTS

Result

Effect

1

Each creature in the blast radius switches positions with another randomly determined creature in the blast radius (no save).

2

The area is cloaked in magical darkness that darkvision doesn't penetrate for 1 minute.

3

The blast radius becomes an area of zero gravity for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

4

Each creature in the blast radius is affected by a 1st-rank wisp ally spell for 1 round.

5

Each creature in the blast radius is affected by a 2nd-rank invisibility spell.

6

Creatures in the blast radius are affected as if by a 3rd-rank fireball spell.

8

About 5,000 harmless, beautiful flying insects appear within the blast radius, granting everyone in the area concealment for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

9

Radiation fills the area. Creatures in the area are exposed to severe radiation sickness with a Fortitude DC equal to your class DC.

10

The blast radius becomes an area of high gravity for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

11

The blast radius fills with a windstorm dealing @Damage[8d8[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save).

12

A laser light show begins. Each creature in the blast radius must succeed at a @Check[reflex|against:class] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

13

Relaxing music fills the area. Each creature in the blast radius gains 10 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

14

Loud screeching noises burst forth, dealing @Damage[8d8[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save).

15

The blast radius becomes the area of a 6th-rank pocket vacuum spell for 1 round.

16

Each creature in the blast radius changes color to a random neon hue for 24 hours.

17

Ghosts fill the area, floating through everyone present. Creatures in the blast radius take @Damage[8d8[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save).

18

Dozens of adorable, harmless Tiny animals appear in the blast radius, covering the ground. This horde makes the blast radius difficult terrain for 5 rounds.

19

The blast radius becomes the area of a 6th-rank corrosive haze spell for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

20

Roll twice more on this table and choose one effect to happen.
Reality-Splicing Grenade (Advanced).name: Reality-Splicing Grenade (Advanced)
