Rebel's Effigy.description:
This stone has a winged, four legged beast carved into it, adorned with regalia and radiating rays of light.

Activate—Join the Cause 1 (concentrate, manipulate) You grasp the effigy tightly, causing it to discorporate with a gentle glow. For 1 minute, you and your Strikes gain the holy trait. Additionally, your Strikes against fiends deal an additional @Damage[1[spirit]] damage per damage dice.
Rebel's Effigy.name: Rebel's Effigy

Rebound Actuator (Commercial).description:
These kinetic actuators convert the raw force and rush of superheated air created by an explosion into motion.

Activate—Backdraft r (air, move, traversal)

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You attempt a Reflex save against a damaging effect and don't critically fail

Effect After resolving the triggering effect, you [[/act leap]]. If you critically succeeded on the triggering save, you can Stride instead.
Rebound Actuator (Commercial).name: Rebound Actuator (Commercial)

Rebound Actuator (Tactical).description:
These kinetic actuators convert the raw force and rush of superheated air created by an explosion into motion.

Activate—Backdraft r (air, move, traversal)

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You attempt a Reflex save against a damaging effect and don't critically fail

Effect After resolving the triggering effect, you [[/act leap]]. If you critically succeeded on the triggering save, you can Stride instead. When activated, a willing adjacent creature is carried with you to a free space adjacent to your destination.
Rebound Actuator (Tactical).name: Rebound Actuator (Tactical)

Regenerative Rune Splice.description:
Your genes are enchanted with microscopic runes that you can activate to recover from traumatic injury.

Activate—Regenerate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.s6J1Q0e28Gb42epQ]{Genetic Regeneration} spell.
Regenerative Rune Splice.name: Regenerative Rune Splice

Remote Lock App (Advanced).description: Remote lock apps allow you to control locks using your comm unit. Attempting a Thievery check to Pick a smart lock without first first successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hacking} (three [[/act hack dc=30]] checks) it automatically alerts the owner of the lock (and often, the local authorities) of a break-in progress.
Remote Lock App (Advanced).name: Remote Lock App (Advanced)

Remote Lock App (Commercial).description: Remote lock apps allow you to control locks using your comm unit. Attempting a Thievery check to Pick a smart lock without first successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hacking} (one [[/act hack dc=20]] check) it automatically alerts the owner of the lock (and often, the local authorities) of a break-in progress.
Remote Lock App (Commercial).name: Remote Lock App (Commercial)

Remote Lock App (Elite).description: Remote lock apps allow you to control locks using your comm unit. Attempting a Thievery check to Pick a smart lock without first successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hacking} (four [[/act hack dc=30]] checks) it automatically alerts the owner of the lock (and often, the local authorities) of a break-in progress.
Remote Lock App (Elite).name: Remote Lock App (Elite)

Remote Lock App (Tactical).description: Remote lock apps allow you to control locks using your comm unit. Attempting a Thievery check to Pick a smart lock without first successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hacking} (two [[/act hack dc=25]] checks) it automatically alerts the owner of the lock (and often, the local authorities) of a break-in progress.
Remote Lock App (Tactical).name: Remote Lock App (Tactical)

Repair Toolkit (Commercial).description: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
Repair Toolkit (Commercial).name: Repair Toolkit (Commercial)

Repair Toolkit (Tactical).description: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. A tactical repair toolkit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
Repair Toolkit (Tactical).name: Repair Toolkit (Tactical)

Replay Datamine (Advanced).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +23 and master skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Advanced).name: Replay Datamine (Advanced)

Replay Datamine (Commercial).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +2 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +9 and trained skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Commercial).name: Replay Datamine (Commercial)

Replay Datamine (Superior).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +4 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +37 and master skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Superior).name: Replay Datamine (Superior)

Replay Datamine (Tactical).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +16 and expert skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Tactical).name: Replay Datamine (Tactical)

Replica Zo! Microphone.description:
Upgrades 1

This ornate replica of the undead superstar's iconic microphone is an officially licensed Zo! Media product. Zo!'s microphone is rumored to be a bone scepter upgraded with the latest technologies to amplify Zo!'s voice for blasting enemies or unruly fans. The replica version possesses similar capabilities and can be used as a professional microphone or a weapon.
Replica Zo! Microphone.name: Replica Zo! Microphone

Rescue Suit.description:
Upgrades: 0

Every stellar voyage carries a risk of accident or open combat. Few travelers, however, want to be armored at all times, so many commercial star lines provide these rescue suits, quick to deploy and put on from convenient containers placed throughout the ship.
Rescue Suit.name: Rescue Suit

Residual Energy Conductor (Advanced).description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

Activate—Conduct Ammunition f (manipulate)

Trigger Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

Effect The installed weapon's battery regains 3 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional @Damage[3[untyped]] damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.
Residual Energy Conductor (Advanced).name: Residual Energy Conductor (Advanced)

Residual Energy Conductor (Commercial).description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

Activate—Conduct Ammunition f (manipulate)

Trigger Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

Effect The installed weapon's battery regains 1 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional @Damage[1[untyped]] damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.
Residual Energy Conductor (Commercial).name: Residual Energy Conductor (Commercial)

Residual Energy Conductor (Elite).description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

Activate—Conduct Ammunition f (manipulate)

Trigger Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

Effect The installed weapon's battery regains 5 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional @Damage[5[untyped]] damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.
Residual Energy Conductor (Elite).name: Residual Energy Conductor (Elite)

Residual Energy Conductor (Superior).description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

Activate—Conduct Ammunition f (manipulate)

Trigger Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

Effect The installed weapon's battery regains 4 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional @Damage[4[untyped]] damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.
Residual Energy Conductor (Superior).name: Residual Energy Conductor (Superior)

Residual Energy Conductor (Tactical).description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

Activate—Conduct Ammunition f (manipulate)

Trigger Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

Effect The installed weapon's battery regains 2 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional @Damage[2[untyped]] damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.
Residual Energy Conductor (Tactical).name: Residual Energy Conductor (Tactical)

Resist Energy Spell Amp (Advanced).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} spell
Resist Energy Spell Amp (Advanced).name: Resist Energy Spell Amp (Advanced)

Resist Energy Spell Amp (Commercial).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} spell
Resist Energy Spell Amp (Commercial).name: Resist Energy Spell Amp (Commercial)

Resist Energy Spell Amp (Tactical).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} spell
Resist Energy Spell Amp (Tactical).name: Resist Energy Spell Amp (Tactical)

Retinal Reflectors.description: These sheets of reflective material, implanted in your visual organs, enhance your vision without changing your appearance. You gain low-light vision and a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} if they involve sight.
Retinal Reflectors.name: Retinal Reflectors

Retrieval Boosters.description: When you make a thrown Strike with this weapon, a complex combination of stabilizers and boosters propels it back into your free hand (or other appendage) after the Strike is complete. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.
Retrieval Boosters.name: Retrieval Boosters

Retrieval Harness.description:
Upgrades: 1

First developed by Starfinder scientists, this armor is outfitted with prolific aramid pouches, straps, and intricate rail systems that keep a full complement of equipment and consumables at the ready. Retrieval harnesses always have a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.hH1vCb2EJyqMo8ac]{commercial easypatcher} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
Retrieval Harness.name: Retrieval Harness

Retrocognitive Lens.description:
The outer rim of this high-tech magnifying glass is etched with occult symbols that grant it the ability to peer into the past with the right calibrations. Retrocognitive lenses can be made to augment other senses, most commonly smell, for use by blind creatures. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} while using the lens.

Activation—Psychic Clues (concentrate, manipulate, occult) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Effect By holding the lens up to one eye and adjusting its focus, you can see psychic impressions of events that occurred in your current vicinity over the course of the previous day. You can examine these echoes for 1 minute, gaining vague clues about what occurred during that time period. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] for 24 hours when questioning creatures who were present or know what happened during that time. These clues come in the form of emotional remnants and cryptic symbolism rather than clear visions. At the GM's discretion, if you learn about a particularly traumatic event, you must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:34] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} on a critical failure).
Retrocognitive Lens.name: Retrocognitive Lens

Reusable Grenade Shell.description:
This ordinance was originally shaped like a brutaris ball and intended to add both visual effects and additional risk to the already dangerous game. You can throw the shell to explode the installed grenade, using the grenade's range, damage, and other effects. The shell remains and repairs the grenade over the course of 24 hours, during which time you can't install another grenade. The shell is too large for a grenade launcher.

Activate—Install Grenade 1 (manipulate)

Effect You install a commercial, tactical, or advanced grenade in the shell. You can store one grenade in the shell at a time, and you can Interact to retrieve the grenade normally.
Reusable Grenade Shell.name: Reusable Grenade Shell

Revealing Flashlight.description: This pale green torch has been modified to shine an ethereal wavelength of light. When activated, it emits only 30 feet of dim light and no bright light. When the light passes through a container, it reveals a silhouette of any items within. This gives the wielder a +2 item bonus to [[/act seek]] hidden treasures within the dim light. The presence of bright light counteracts this effect.
Revealing Flashlight.name: Revealing Flashlight

Reverb Knife.description:
Upgrades: 1

This knife vibrates at incredible speeds, allowing it greater penetrating power and the ability to disrupt victim's hearing.
Reverb Knife.name: Reverb Knife

Riot Shield.description: Riot shields are constructed from sheets of transparent aluminum reinforced with nanocarbon panels layered over polymers or resins. These sleek but sturdy shields are designed to protect most of the wielder's body when raised while allowing them to march in tight tactical formations. Sometimes they're transparent to allow inexperienced wielders to see the other side while the shield is raised, but most experienced warriors have no problem seeing around these shields, and the transparent material quickly becomes too scuffed to see through after a few hits.
Riot Shield.name: Riot Shield

Rocket Fist (Advanced).description:
Sometimes you just want to punch somebody from across the room. The rocket fist is the perfect augmentation for those situations: a detachable fist that flies toward your enemies, tethered with a thin steel cable.

Activate—Rocket Punch 1 (manipulate)

Effect You make a ranged fist Strike. Your fist gains the thrown 60 feet and tethered traits for this attack. Whether or not the Strike hits, your fist falls to the ground. You can't make fist attacks or hold items with that hand until you retrieve it with a free action to retract the cable.
Rocket Fist (Advanced).name: Rocket Fist (Advanced)

Rocket Fist (Commercial).description:
Sometimes you just want to punch somebody from across the room. The rocket fist is the perfect augmentation for those situations: a detachable fist that flies toward your enemies, tethered with a thin steel cable.

Activate—Rocket Punch 1 (manipulate)

Effect You make a ranged fist Strike. Your fist gains the thrown 30 feet and tethered traits for this attack. Whether or not the Strike hits, your fist falls to the ground. You can't make fist attacks or hold items with that hand until you retrieve it with a single Interact action to retract the cable.
Rocket Fist (Commercial).name: Rocket Fist (Commercial)

Rocket Fist (Tactical).description:
Sometimes you just want to punch somebody from across the room. The rocket fist is the perfect augmentation for those situations: a detachable fist that flies toward your enemies, tethered with a thin steel cable.

Activate—Rocket Punch 1 (manipulate)

Effect You make a ranged fist Strike. Your fist gains the thrown 30 feet and tethered traits for this attack. Whether or not the Strike hits, your fist falls to the ground. You can't make fist attacks or hold items with that hand until you retrieve it with a free action to retract the cable.
Rocket Fist (Tactical).name: Rocket Fist (Tactical)

Rocketeer Armor.description:
Upgrades: 0

This armor has a built-in jetpack and auxiliary thrusters mounted in the boots and thighs. It offers unparalleled aerial mobility, all while sporting a stylish leather jacket. Rocketeer armor always have a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.CIZ3Walj6DmiaJGq]{jetpack} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
Rocketeer Armor.name: Rocketeer Armor

Rope Guts (Commercial).description: Your entrails can be pulled from your insides and used as a rope without damaging your body. You can pull out up to 10 feet of your entrails as a single Interact action. You can do this multiple times, up to 50 feet worth of entrails, but one end must remain attached to you. As a single Interact action, you can have your entrails release anything currently attached to them and retract back into your body. If your entrails are destroyed while acting as a rope, you take @Damage[2d6[slashing]] damage and can't pull more out for 24 hours.
Rope Guts (Commercial).name: Rope Guts (Commercial)

Rope Guts (Tactical).description:
Your entrails can be pulled from your insides and used as a rope without damaging your body. You can pull out up to 10 feet of your entrails as a single Interact action. You can do this multiple times, up to 50 feet worth of entrails, but one end must remain attached to you. As a single Interact action, you can have your entrails release anything currently attached to them and retract back into your body. If your entrails are destroyed while acting as a rope, you take @Damage[2d6[slashing]] damage and can't pull more out for 24 hours.

You can [[/act grab-an-edge]] from up to 10 feet away, pulling out 10 feet of your entrails and wrapping them around the edge.
Rope Guts (Tactical).name: Rope Guts (Tactical)

Rotating Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

A time-tested design favored by traditional gunslingers, the multiple barrels on this pistol mechanically rotate while firing, making it less likely to malfunction.
Rotating Pistol.name: Rotating Pistol

Rotolaser.description:
Upgrades: 1

A rotolaser fires multiple beams of plasma at once. This massive assault rifle has a set of rotating barrels that prevent overheating when spewing auto-fire.
Rotolaser.name: Rotolaser

Runic Pick.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pick shimmers with delicate runes on its surface when its wielder casts spells.
Runic Pick.name: Runic Pick

Safekeep Flashlight.description:
This blocky flashlight sheds a soothing orange glow that seems to reassure the user of their safety in an almost childlike way.

Activate—Go Away A (light, manipulate) You concentrate the light on something scary to ward it off. You cast a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} spell (@Check[will|dc:23|traits:concentrate,emotion,fear,light,manipulate,mental|options:spell] save) on a creature with the aberration or undead traits. A creature that succeeds on their save against the spell becomes immune to Go Away for 24 hours.
Safekeep Flashlight.name: Safekeep Flashlight

Scattergun.description:
Upgrades: 1

A scattergun is a long-barreled firearm that fires numerous spherical projectiles to hit multiple targets.
Scattergun.name: Scattergun

Screamer.description:
Upgrades: 1

Resembling a large directional speaker held in two hands, a screamer produces a deafening boom. At lower volumes, a screamer functions as a portable loudspeaker.
Screamer.name: Screamer

Scrimshaw Shard.description:
This bone, collected from the horn of a bloodspawned hound, has strange sigils inscribed on it with a dark crimson hue.

Activate—Planar Pursuit r (concentrate, teleportation)

Trigger A creature within 60 feet that you can see takes physical or bleed damage

Effect Fresh blood wells from the finely carved glyphs in the scrimshaw shard. You teleport adjacent to the triggering creature and the scrimshaw shard disintegrates.
Scrimshaw Shard.name: Scrimshaw Shard

Second Skin.description:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
Second Skin.name: Second Skin

Seeker Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This single-shot sniper rifle is one of the most popular weapons in the Vast thanks to its stability and reliability with minimal upkeep.
Seeker Rifle.name: Seeker Rifle

Semi-Auto Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
Semi-Auto Pistol.name: Semi-Auto Pistol

Sensory Amplification Suit.description:
Upgrades: 1

While most armor dampens the senses in favor of superior protection, some tasks require exceptional awareness while still being safe from harm. This armored harness is equipped with a full sensory suite and is especially popular among spies and scouts. Sensory amplification suits always have a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.55elqx7N7Upze3lR]{commercial full-spectrum sensor suite} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.
Sensory Amplification Suit.name: Sensory Amplification Suit

Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 1 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.UB0yKVxoS0EBXyCO]{Effect: Sharpshooter Serum}
Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial).name: Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial)

Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 2 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.UB0yKVxoS0EBXyCO]{Effect: Sharpshooter Serum}
Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical).name: Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical)

Shelter Wall.description: This large shield is made from metallic alloys used in Akitonian bomb shelters. Its lack of advanced tech allows it to endure nuclear hazards.
Shelter Wall.name: Shelter Wall

Shielding Skin (Advanced).description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws.
Shielding Skin (Advanced).name: Shielding Skin (Advanced)

Shielding Skin (Commercial).description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws.
Shielding Skin (Commercial).name: Shielding Skin (Commercial)

Shielding Skin (Tactical).description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws.
Shielding Skin (Tactical).name: Shielding Skin (Tactical)

Shimmerstone Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A blue tincture distilled from shimmerstone. You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects and a +2 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} for 10 minutes.
Shimmerstone Serum.name: Shimmerstone Serum

Shirren-eye Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sniper rifle comes with a compound technological scope that allows snipers to adjust focus and magnification with natural eye movements instead of using moving parts that might disrupt their aim.
Shirren-eye Rifle.name: Shirren-eye Rifle

Shobhad Longrifle.description:
Upgrades: 0

This martial sniper rifle is the traditional weapon of the shobhad-neh. It comes with a built-in @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.nPmeqjZ8b0mjqSfs]{commercial silencer} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.10lYyQDoJXUojKm2]{commercial sniper's scope} that must be upgraded separately from the weapon but are integrated into the shobhad longrifle and do not occupy upgrade slots.
Shobhad Longrifle.name: Shobhad Longrifle

Shock Module (Commercial).description: This circuit safely courses electricity through your weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.
Shock Module (Commercial).name: Shock Module (Commercial)

Shock Module (Tactical).description:
This circuit safely courses electricity through your weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, this increases to 2d10 electricity damage, and electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.

Electricity damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's electricity resistance (and the other creatures' on a critical hit).
Shock Module (Tactical).name: Shock Module (Tactical)

Shock Pad.description:
Upgrades: 1

This flexible nanocarbon circuit can be installed as an upgrade into gloves, kneepads, or similar appendage protectors to emit a powerful electric shock when forcefully applied to a target.
Shock Pad.name: Shock Pad

Shock Truncheon.description:
Upgrades: 1

Popular among security forces, this retractable baton discharges electricity with each Strike. A whirring device inside the grip generates voltage, creating a sound like a swarm of buzzing insects when it's fully charged.
Shock Truncheon.name: Shock Truncheon

Shooting Starknife.description:
Upgrades: 1

This traditional star-shaped blade design of lost Golarion is often forged from reinforced carbon steel and treated with chemicals that create an iridescent sheen. When properly balanced and honed, a shooting starknife sings as it slices through the air.
Shooting Starknife.name: Shooting Starknife

Shotalashu Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.
Shotalashu Armor.name: Shotalashu Armor

Shredskin (Advanced).description:
This slate-gray garment ripples with necromantic energy. When worn properly, this magical bodysuit transforms the appearance of a living creature into that of an undead creature and grants a +3 item bonus to Stealth checks.

Activate—Necrotize 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Duration 1 hour (see text)

Effect The shredskin transforms your appearance into an undead version of yourself. Your disguise affects your visual appearance, sound, scent, and all other forms of detection, including lifesense. After the normal duration of this ability ends, you can extend it by 1 more hour by piercing yourself with hooks on the robe, causing you to lose @Damage[50[healing]] Hit Points. The duration can't be extended a second time, and if these Hit Points are healed, the effect ends immediately.
Shredskin (Advanced).name: Shredskin (Advanced)

Shredskin (Commercial).description:
This slate-gray garment ripples with necromantic energy. When worn properly, this magical bodysuit transforms the appearance of a living creature into that of an undead creature and grants a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks.

Activate—Necrotize 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute (see text)

Effect The shredskin transforms your appearance into an undead version of yourself. Your disguise affects your visual appearance, sound, scent, and all other forms of detection, including lifesense. After the normal duration of this ability ends, you can extend it by 1 more minute by piercing yourself with hooks on the robe, causing you to lose @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points. The duration can't be extended a second time, and if these Hit Points are healed, the effect ends immediately.
Shredskin (Commercial).name: Shredskin (Commercial)

Shredskin (Tactical).description:
This slate-gray garment ripples with necromantic energy. When worn properly, this magical bodysuit transforms the appearance of a living creature into that of an undead creature and grants a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks.

Activate—Necrotize 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Duration 10 minutes (see text)

Effect The shredskin transforms your appearance into an undead version of yourself. Your disguise affects your visual appearance, sound, scent, and all other forms of detection, including lifesense. After the normal duration of this ability ends, you can extend it by 10 more minutes by piercing yourself with hooks on the robe, causing you to lose @Damage[25[healing]] Hit Points. The duration can't be extended a second time, and if these Hit Points are healed, the effect ends immediately.
Shredskin (Tactical).name: Shredskin (Tactical)

Shrieking Modulator.description:
Your throat is implanted with a necrotic modulator that can unleash a powerful screech. The tissue is typically taken from a banshee, though some come from tech zombies and other more common undead.

Activate—Shriek 2 (sonic)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes @Damage[8d10[sonic]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic] save. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).
Shrieking Modulator.name: Shrieking Modulator

Shrieking Modulator (Advanced).description:
Your throat is implanted with a necrotic modulator that can unleash a powerful screech. The tissue is typically taken from a banshee, though some come from tech zombies and other more common undead.

Activate—Shriek 2 (sonic)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes @Damage[5d10[sonic]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic] save. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).
Shrieking Modulator (Advanced).name: Shrieking Modulator (Advanced)

Shrieking Modulator (Commercial).description:
Your throat is implanted with a necrotic modulator that can unleash a powerful screech. The tissue is typically taken from a banshee, though some come from tech zombies and other more common undead.

Activate—Shriek 2 (sonic)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes @Damage[1d10[sonic]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).
Shrieking Modulator (Commercial).name: Shrieking Modulator (Commercial)

Shrieking Modulator (Tactical).description:
Your throat is implanted with a necrotic modulator that can unleash a powerful screech. The tissue is typically taken from a banshee, though some come from tech zombies and other more common undead.

Activate—Shriek 2 (sonic)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes @Damage[3d10[sonic]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).
Shrieking Modulator (Tactical).name: Shrieking Modulator (Tactical)

Shrink Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{Shrink} spell
Shrink Spell Amp.name: Shrink Spell Amp

Shrouding Sphere.description:
This glass sphere is filled with a swirling purple gas and exudes a faint floral fragrance.

Activate—Shake it Out 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You shake the sphere, causing the gas inside to seep through the glass and coil around you, obscuring your motions. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against ranged attacks for 3 rounds. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to [[/act hide]] for the duration. This gas can be dispersed by strong wind, ending the effects early.

Activate—Yeet it Out 1 (manipulate)

Effect You throw the sphere, granting one creature within 60 feet the benefits of Shake it Out for 1 minute. This causes the orb to shatter, gaining the consumable trait.
Shrouding Sphere.name: Shrouding Sphere

Shuriken Drone.description:
Upgrades: 1

This star-shaped weapon surrounds a tiny single rotor drone designed to return to its thrower if it doesn't hit its target.
Shuriken Drone.name: Shuriken Drone

Silencer (Commercial).description: A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.
Silencer (Commercial).name: Silencer (Commercial)

Silencer (Tactical).description:
A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.

A tactical silencer is a hybrid item with the magical and tech traits. Shots fired from a tactical silencer magically dampen sounds around them. On a critically successful Strike, the target becomes unable to make sound. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This also prevents the target from casting spells due to the incantations or sounds involved in casting, with the exception of subtle spells. The target can resist the effects of the silencer with a successful @Check[will|dc:27] save.
Silencer (Tactical).name: Silencer (Tactical)

Silvertongue Implant.description: Resonating membranes create subtle harmonics that can make creatures more receptive to what you have to say. You gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] while you're audibly speaking with someone in person, as the subtle resonant vibrations don't work via electronic communication.
Silvertongue Implant.name: Silvertongue Implant

Singing Coil.description:
Upgrades: 1

Resembling a resonant transformer circuit, this weaponized stringed instrument produces sound by using high-frequency alternating currents to cause air molecules to vibrate.
Singing Coil.name: Singing Coil

Singing Spear.description:
Upgrades: 1

Classically shaped like an oversized musical note, this spear intones melodious pitches when it strikes, creating a new song with each battle.
Singing Spear.name: Singing Spear

Skip-Bounce.description:
Elovai collected this small metallic ball and paired glove from a long-destroyed reality, where it was created as a mode of transport.

Activate—Toss and Catch 2 (teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Effect You throw the ball to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet. You are teleported to the ball's location, arriving with the ball in your gloved hand. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you are carrying it in an extradimensional container—the teleportation effect fails.
Skip-Bounce.name: Skip-Bounce

Skitterstaff.description:
Upgrades: 1

These long crooks have a triangular, hooked end and are balanced to reposition creatures out of harm's way.

Activate—Helping Repositioning 1

Effect You [[/act reposition]] one willing ally within reach. If you use a third hand to manipulate the skitterstaff when you use this action, you can Reposition one willing ally within 15 feet by hooking your weapon around their weapon. The target can't move you on a critical failure. This action doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Reposition attempt.
Skitterstaff.name: Skitterstaff

Skull of Yore.description: This yellowing skull gazes back at you with an unreadable rictus smile. When held or worn as an accessory, this magical talisman grants a +1 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks to identify undead.
Skull of Yore.name: Skull of Yore

Skyfire Armor.description:
Upgrades: 0

These decorative suits of medium armor feature exaggerated shoulder guards, stylized dragon wings, and draconic emblems across the breastplate's back and chest. Skyfire armor is often plated with gold or other attractive metals, sacrificing upgrade space for style.
Skyfire Armor.name: Skyfire Armor

Skyfire Sword.description:
Upgrades: 1

Famously wielded by warriors of the Skyfire Legion, this flaming blade is powered by burning gas held in place by magnetic fields.
Skyfire Sword.name: Skyfire Sword

Skyfire Volt Caster.description: Originally deployed by Skyfire Legionnaires as an enhancement to their dragonglaives, these devices were designed to channel electrical energy into ranged attacks. The design proved so effective that other versions adapted for any large weapon have spread throughout the Pact Worlds, channeling electricity from a battery instead.
Skyfire Volt Caster.name: Skyfire Volt Caster

Slime Gland (Advanced).description:
A slime gland is implanted into an accessible orifice, such as your mouth or nose, where it can easily expel a sticky and often chunky slime.

Activate—Excrete Slime 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Effect You expel slime into an empty adjacent square, a @Template[type:line|distance:15], or a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute or until washed off by a water effect.
Slime Gland (Advanced).name: Slime Gland (Advanced)

Slime Gland (Commercial).description:
A slime gland is implanted into an accessible orifice, such as your mouth or nose, where it can easily expel a sticky and often chunky slime.

Activate—Excrete Slime 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Effect You expel slime into an empty adjacent square. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute or until washed off by a water effect.
Slime Gland (Commercial).name: Slime Gland (Commercial)

Slime Gland (Tactical).description:
A slime gland is implanted into an accessible orifice, such as your mouth or nose, where it can easily expel a sticky and often chunky slime.

Activate—Excrete Slime 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Effect You expel slime into an empty adjacent square or a @Template[type:line|distance:15]. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute or until washed off by a water effect.
Slime Gland (Tactical).name: Slime Gland (Tactical)

Slough-Do (Commercial).description:
This wad of green slime looks like a mass of jelly, but when worn on the head, you can Interact to style it into hair-do-like fashions. While worn, rivulets of green liquid slowly dribble into your ears and down your forehead and neck, making it uncomfortable to use long-term.

Slough-do grants you a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks, and allows you to cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou]{Adhere} cantrip as an occult innate spell.
Slough-Do (Commercial).name: Slough-Do (Commercial)

Slough-Do (Tactical).description:
This wad of green slime looks like a mass of jelly, but when worn on the head, you can Interact to style it into hair-do-like fashions. While worn, rivulets of green liquid slowly dribble into your ears and down your forehead and neck, making it uncomfortable to use long-term.

Slough-do grants you a +2 item bonus to Occultism checks, and allows you to cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou]{Adhere} cantrip as an occult innate spell.

Additionally, you can activate the tactical slough-do.

Activate—Slough-Do Swirl Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect The slough-do swirls rapidly, causing occult energy to pour from it. You cast a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jyrxfWeeCsrkhNit]{Eldritch Wrath} spell.
Slough-Do (Tactical).name: Slough-Do (Tactical)

Smoke Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:15]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Advanced).name: Smoke Grenade (Advanced)

Smoke Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:5]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Commercial).name: Smoke Grenade (Commercial)

Smoke Grenade (Elite).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:40]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Elite).name: Smoke Grenade (Elite)

Smoke Grenade (Paragon).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:100]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.

Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell).description:
Usage installed in computer or comm unit;

These chips can be installed in comm units and other computers to allow the device to cast spells. Each device can have only one spell chip. Casting a spell from a spell chip requires holding the computer or comm unit in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. If the spell has a locus, you must still have that locus to cast the spell from a spell chip. Spell chips can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

In addition to the charge expended to Cast the Spell, the delicate components that make up the core lattice of a spell chip can be destroyed if used in quick succession. Attempting to use a spell chip more than once per day requires overclocking it. Cast the Spell again, then roll a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, the spell chip is broken. On a failure, the spell chip is destroyed. If anyone tries to overclock a spell chip that's already been overclocked that day, the spell chip is automatically destroyed (even if it's been repaired) and no spell is cast.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overclock

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.
Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell).name: Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell)

Spell Gem (10th-Rank Spell).description:
These latticed gemstones are suspended in a silicon casing and encoded with the magical script necessary to cast a single, specific spell. Casting a spell from a spell gem requires holding the gem in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. The spell in a spell gem can be cast only once, and the spell gem is destroyed as part of the casting. Spell gems can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Spell Refactoring Matrix.description:
This runic pillar is integrated into your armor in a convenient location. The spell refactoring matrix within captures wasted magical particles, keeping them charged for another volley.

Activate—Refactor Magicule r

Frequency once per day

Trigger You Cast a heightened spell from a spell slot, and you failed or critically failed all spell attack rolls or all affected creatures critically succeeded at their saving throws against the spell

Effect The matrix captures a portion of the wasted spell. You can cast the same spell again at two ranks lower than the rank you originally cast it, without using a spell slot. If the spell can't be cast at that rank or you don't cast the spell before the end of your next turn, the captured spell is wasted.
Spell Refactoring Matrix.name: Spell Refactoring Matrix

Spell Server of the Robot Master (Advanc.description:

This collapsible pole has screens and cameras connected to it at all angles, with an oversized hardlight emoji at the top. It includes camera equipment that allows you to Livestream to the local infosphere across multiple platforms, making you appear extra likable in the process. You gain a +3 item bonus to skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Yn4jLPVWVE1vtAaF]{Access Infosphere} by using the spell server to stream and asking viewers directly, and you can roll [[/act access-infosphere skill=perfomance]] instead of Computers to do so.

  • 1st emoji spray, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.5ZZca1GGJs44OxC8]{motivating ringtone,} optics feed

Spellcarver.description:
Upgrades: 1

This polearm typically ends with a long, curved crystal blade that takes on the magical properties of a spell gem or aeon stone.

Activate—Safeguard Spell 1 (force, spellshape) Cost 10 battery charges

Effect Make a Strike. If your Strike is successful, and your next action is to Cast a Spell, then your polearm's force field protects you, and Casting the Spell doesn't trigger reactions from the target of your Strike.
Spellcarver.name: Spellcarver

Spinal Struts (Commercial).description: These implants reinforce your spinal column with nanocarbon rods, improving your leverage while lifting and carrying. You can carry up to 1 additional Bulk without becoming encumbered, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude DC against checks to [[/act reposition]] or [[/act shove]] you.
Spinal Struts (Commercial).name: Spinal Struts (Commercial)

Spinal Struts (Tactical).description: These implants reinforce your spinal column with nanocarbon rods, improving your leverage while lifting and carrying. You can carry up to 3 additional Bulk without becoming encumbered, and you gain a +2 item bonus to your Fortitude DC against checks to [[/act reposition]] or [[/act shove]] you.
Spinal Struts (Tactical).name: Spinal Struts (Tactical)

Spinneret (Commercial).description:
You can produce a small amount of sturdy silk every day by extruding it from a specially implanted spinneret. The silk is nonsticky but extremely durable, functioning like a commercial cable line, but it degrades after 24 hours. The spinneret is unobtrusive when not in use and can only be found with a detailed medical scan. You can extrude up to 25 feet of silk per day.

Activate—Spin 1 (manipulate) You extrude 5 feet of silk.
Spinneret (Commercial).name: Spinneret (Commercial)

Spinneret (Tactical).description:
You can produce a small amount of sturdy silk every day by extruding it from a specially implanted spinneret. The silk is nonsticky but extremely durable, functioning like a commercial cable line, but it degrades after 24 hours. The spinneret is unobtrusive when not in use and can only be found with a detailed medical scan. You can extrude up to 100 feet of silk per day.

Activate—Spin 1 (manipulate) You extrude 5 feet of silk.
Spinneret (Tactical).name: Spinneret (Tactical)

Spliced Geneshield.description: When wielded as a pair, these shields use corrosive agents emitted by a force field to disrupt enemies.
Spliced Geneshield.name: Spliced Geneshield

Sprayflesh.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A canister sprays neutral biomass into a wound or area of concern (such as a clearly diseased or poisoned section of the body). For 1 hour, or until the creature fully recovers to their maximum Hit Points, you can attempt Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the target creature even if they're temporarily immune to Treat Wounds.
Sprayflesh.name: Sprayflesh

Starday Night Special.description:
Upgrades: 1

This tactical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.K0xFwEC6Zv7ghVFa]{Auto-Pistol} is favored for its relatively cheap price given the benefits it provides. Detectives commonly upgrade their first Starday night special out of sentimentality.

Activate—Lucky Bullet f (concentrate, misfortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger Your Strike with the weapon was a critical failure

Effect Even though your bullet completely missed your target, it managed to hit something in such a way that it still foils their plans. The target of your Strike must roll twice and take the worse result on the next check it attempts during its next turn.
Starday Night Special.name: Starday Night Special

Starfall Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

While originally a kit-bashed plasma caster, the commercial models fire streams of superheated plasma. Akitonian revelers enjoy discharging these pistols into the air during outdoor celebrations.
Starfall Pistol.name: Starfall Pistol

Stellar Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 1

The rounds of this portable cannon are loaded with carefully positioned mini-missiles packed with flechettes that shred anyone too close to the blast.
Stellar Cannon.name: Stellar Cannon

Stickybomb Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade releases rapidly expanding foam that sticks to creatures, preventing movement. Creatures in the @Template[burst|distance:15] that fail a @Check[reflex|against:class] save are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 minute, at which point the foam dries out, or until they successfully Escape against the original Reflex save DC.
Stickybomb Grenade (Advanced).name: Stickybomb Grenade (Advanced)

This grenade releases rapidly expanding foam that sticks to creatures, preventing movement. Stickybomb Grenade (Ultimate).name: Stickybomb Grenade (Ultimate)

Stormbreaker Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This dark-blue armor features a series of conductive rods along the spine that draw and discharge high-voltage electricity without harming the wearer. Originally developed to protect Veskarium troopers from Vesk-5's deadly vortex storms, stormbreaker armor is now worn most often by stormrunners and other smugglers who skim what profits they can from the dangerous gas giant. Stombreaker armor always has @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.BSATLOr4qZU6XllN]{commercial energized spikes} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{commercial energy shielding (electricity)} installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slots.
Stormbreaker Armor.name: Stormbreaker Armor

Streetsweeper.description:
Upgrades: 1

This enormous portable cannon uses speakers to broadcast dense ultrasonic waves powerful enough to sweep a street clean of anything in its path.
Streetsweeper.name: Streetsweeper

Striking Crystal (Advanced).description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to four instead of one.
Striking Crystal (Advanced).name: Striking Crystal (Advanced)

Striking Crystal (Commercial).description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.
Striking Crystal (Commercial).name: Striking Crystal (Commercial)

Striking Crystal (Tactical).description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to three instead of one.
Striking Crystal (Tactical).name: Striking Crystal (Tactical)

Stun Stick (Advanced).description:
Upgrades: 2

Eyeswide detectives use this advanced @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.D4KuxPi9gqFkvZ3h]{Baton} to subdue unruly perpetrators nonlethally. The handle gives the wielder a very mild electrical shock each time it's picked up or unsheathed, so agents tend to wear insulated gloves when they think a stun stick might be needed on a case.

Activate—Short, Sharp Shock A

Frequency once per hour

Effect The length of the baton becomes wreathed in electrical energy that can temporarily wreak havoc on a creature's motor skills. Make a melee Strike with the stun stick. On a hit, you deal electricity damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|options:inflicts:stunned|traits:incapacitation] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round; this is an incapacitation effect.
Stun Stick (Advanced).name: Stun Stick (Advanced)

Subliminator.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sublimation-based long-range weapon uses gas to create large spikes of ice mid-flight. If you're trained with the weapon, it deals modular damage and gains the modular (C, area [burst 10 feet], delayed, and unwieldy or P) trait and expends 8 charges to Area Fire.
Subliminator.name: Subliminator

Sunburst Garland.description:
This colorful and cinnamon-smelling corsage features orange and gold flowers blazing out from the center of this circular floral arrangement; it is given as a welcoming gift during Lajok's Rekindling festival.

Activate—Let the Sun Shine 2 (concentrate, healing, light)

Frequency once per day

Effect You utilize the solar energy stored in the sunburst garland to rekindle the hope and spirit of those around you. You emanate bright light in a 20-foot emanation for 1 minute (and dim light to a further 20 feet). When you Let the Sun Shine, and at the end of each of your turns for the next minute, you and any allies within 20 feet regain @Damage[1[healing]] Hit Point.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.9e4U9NUgOytOimaj]{Effect: Let the Sun Shine}
Sunburst Garland.name: Sunburst Garland

Sunshades (Tactical).description: Sunshades make everyone look cooler. You gain a +1 item bonus to saves against effects that cause the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} condition while wearing tactical sunshades.
Sunshades (Tactical).name: Sunshades (Tactical)

Supercharged Dynafan.description:
Upgrades: 1

These warfans are sold and wielded in pairs (the price given is for one), although one can still be wielded even if the other is not being held. The twin weapons share upgrade slots, so upgrading one fan automatically upgrades the other for no additional cost. If you're trained with this weapon, it gains one charge each time you Strike (maximum 3) that lasts for 1 minute. A supercharged dynafan with 3 charges can be used to Area Fire as a ranged weapon with the area (cone) trait and a range of 20 feet.
Supercharged Dynafan.name: Supercharged Dynafan

Suppression Matrix (Commercial).description: This unit creates holographic figments emulating further attacks. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the beginning of your next turn.
Suppression Matrix (Commercial).name: Suppression Matrix (Commercial)

Suppression Matrix (Tactical).description: This unit creates holographic figments emulating further attacks. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the beginning of your next turn. The target can’t take reactions while suppressed in this way.
Suppression Matrix (Tactical).name: Suppression Matrix (Tactical)

Survival Subroutine.description:
This autonomous subroutine subordinates all mobility systems in an emergency, providing a last-chance, best-effort attempt to escape immediate danger.

Activate—Retreat r (move, traversal)

Trigger You would gain the dying condition

Requirements You aren't already dying or wounded

Effect You Stride, avoiding danger as much as possible. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. You then gain the triggering dying condition as normal.
Survival Subroutine.name: Survival Subroutine

Suspended Fire Modulator.description: This smartfire modulator causes a barrage of projectiles to travel at hyper-reduced speeds, dramatically delaying their impact. This weapon gains the delayed trait. You can use a single Interact action to ignore or resume using the delayed trait, switching the weapon's functionality. You can use this upgrade to ignore the delayed trait on weapons that normally have it.
Suspended Fire Modulator.name: Suspended Fire Modulator

Swarm Acid Splice (Advanced).description:
This gland allows you to belch up the acid weaponized by many Swarm species but doesn't protect you from emesis.

Activate—Acid Spew A (manipulate)

Requirements You're not sickened

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] takes @Damage[3d8[acid]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save. You take @Damage[3[acid]] damage and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
Swarm Acid Splice (Advanced).name: Swarm Acid Splice (Advanced)

This gland allows you to belch up the acid weaponized by many Swarm species but doesn't protect you from emesis.

Activate—Acid Spew A (manipulate)

Requirements You're not sickened

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] takes @Damage[1d8[acid]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:15|basic|options:area-effect] save. You take @Damage[1[acid]] damage and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
Swarm Acid Splice (Commercial).name: Swarm Acid Splice (Commercial)

Swarm sensory organs increase your perception.

Swarmsuit.description:
Upgrades: 1

Specialized nanites form a mesh suit that shifts to fit wearers with unique or transformable physiologies.
Swarmsuit.name: Swarmsuit

Syringe Skewer.description:
Upgrades: 1

A syringe-tipped spear commonly used when farming or hunting to facilitate the injection of anesthetic toxins.
Syringe Skewer.name: Syringe Skewer

Szynegation Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Whether crafted from genuine szynegator components or synthetic imitations, these grenades mimic some of the effects of the Swarm creature while dealing damage like its acidic blood. Szynegation grenades deal the listed amount of persistent acid damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] Save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, a creature that critically fails its saving throw against a szynegation grenade cannot use electronic or telepathic communication and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. These effects last as long as an affected creature is taking persistent acid damage from the grenade.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and the persistent acid damage is 2d8.

Tactical Bioscanner.description:
This upgrade gathers the target's biological data and displays it on an autorecognition lens or other heads-up display on the wielder's armor or weapon.

Activate—Scan Complete f

Trigger You hit or critically hit on a Strike with the weapon

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the Strike's target, with a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check to do so. If you critically hit on the triggering Strike, you get a +2 circumstance bonus instead. The target is then temporarily immune to Scan Complete for 1 day.
Tactical Bioscanner.name: Tactical Bioscanner

Tailblade.description:
Upgrades: 1

Adjustable bands secure this lightweight blade to a tail, tentacle, or similar appendage.
Tailblade.name: Tailblade

Talon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This stylized knife tapers into a curved and serrated blade. When powered, it spews a highly corrosive acid inspired by the armor-melting talons evolved by several species of the Swarm.
Talon.name: Talon

Tangle Vine Germinator.description:
The interiors of your wrists are replaced with miniature cloches that germinate magically enhanced tangle vine seeds under the perfect conditions, ready to grow in an instant in response to magical stimulus.

Activate—Vinesnare 2 You release one of the seeds stored in your wrists, growing a whiplike vine in an instant. Attempt an unarmed Strike with the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine} cantrip. You can also target a surface instead of a creature; if you do, the vine roots itself into the surface, acting as a 30-foot rope securely attached to that surface until you cut the vine. You can't use Vinesnare again for 1 minute after using it to target a surface.
Tangle Vine Germinator.name: Tangle Vine Germinator

Telebond Band.description:
This subtle silvery band allows for long distance telepathic communication and was popular on worlds before the widespread adoption of mobile telecommunication technology. The wearer of a telebond band can telepathically communicate with any other creatures wearing a paired telebond band within a planetary range, even if the creatures do not share a language. This doesn't let two characters understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). Pairing or unpairing two or more telebond bands requires looping the two telebond bands together for 1 minute. Up to six telebond bands can be in a paired group with one another; attempting to pair a seventh telebond band fails.

Activate—Fact Check r (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You received information from a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check

Effect With a thought, you instantly share the knowledge you learned with the required Recall Knowledge check (even if you learned false information) with any other creature wearing a telebond band that's paired with yours, as long as they're within planetary range. Each creature who has not used Fact Check today can use a reaction to Recall Knowledge and Fact Check.
Telebond Band.name: Telebond Band

Telepathy Node.description: A rune-carved device of treated alloys and crystal the size of a pebble is implanted into your brain's communication center. You gain limited telepathy to a range of 30 feet.
Telepathy Node.name: Telepathy Node

Telesthetic Beacon (Commercial).description:
This tiny metal disc is etched with intricate magicircuitry and tuned for remote viewing. You must sync your mind to the psychic frequencies of the telesthetic beacon to be able to receive information from it; this process takes 10 minutes and requires the beacon to be in your possession the entire time. You can be attuned to only one beacon at a time, but once you've done so, you remain attuned to that beacon until you attune to another beacon, another creature attunes themselves to that beacon, or the beacon is destroyed. You gain a +2 item bonus to your Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} a telesthetic beacon on your person or in a location. You can also plant a telesthetic beacon on an unwilling creature using a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check; this works like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Stealing} an object from that creature, except that, on a success, the target doesn't notice that the beacon has been placed on their person.

Activate—Remote Viewing (concentrate, scrying) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within 1 mile of the telesthetic beacon you're attuned to

Effect For 10 minutes, you can hear through the telesthetic beacon as if using your normal auditory senses. If the beacon was planted in a target's pocket or the folds of their clothes, that fabric doesn't impede any information you receive.
Telesthetic Beacon (Commercial).name: Telesthetic Beacon (Commercial)

Telesthetic Beacon (Tactical).description:
This tiny metal disc is etched with intricate magicircuitry and tuned for remote viewing. You must sync your mind to the psychic frequencies of the telesthetic beacon to be able to receive information from it; this process takes 10 minutes and requires the beacon to be in your possession the entire time. You can be attuned to only one beacon at a time, but once you've done so, you remain attuned to that beacon until you attune to another beacon, another creature attunes themselves to that beacon, or the beacon is destroyed. You gain a +2 item bonus to your Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} a telesthetic beacon on your person or in a location. You can also plant a telesthetic beacon on an unwilling creature using a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check; this works like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Stealing} an object from that creature, except that, on a success, the target doesn't notice that the beacon has been placed on their person.

Activate—Remote Viewing (concentrate, scrying) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within 1 mile of the telesthetic beacon you're attuned to

Effect For 10 minutes, you can perceive in all directions through the telesthetic beacon as if using your normal senses. If the beacon was planted in a target's pocket or the folds of their clothes, that fabric doesn't impede any information you receive.
Telesthetic Beacon (Tactical).name: Telesthetic Beacon (Tactical)

Tempweave.description:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.
Tempweave.name: Tempweave

Thermal Capacitor (Advanced).description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from extreme cold and mild heat.
Thermal Capacitor (Advanced).name: Thermal Capacitor (Advanced)

Thermal Capacitor (Commercial).description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from mild cold and mild heat.
Thermal Capacitor (Commercial).name: Thermal Capacitor (Commercial)

Thermal Capacitor (Superior).description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from incredible cold and mild heat.
Thermal Capacitor (Superior).name: Thermal Capacitor (Superior)

Thermal Capacitor (Tactical).description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from severe cold and mild heat.
Thermal Capacitor (Tactical).name: Thermal Capacitor (Tactical)

Thermal Dynafan.description:
Upgrades: 1

This warfan is a modified handheld environmental comfort device that changes the pressure in the air to create a frigid chill or a brilliant plume of fire.
Thermal Dynafan.name: Thermal Dynafan

Thinplate.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sleek but rigid plate armor is often constructed from translucent materials to show off a wearer's dermal circuitry and worn under baggy clothing.
Thinplate.name: Thinplate

Torchbox Truck.description:
This detailed die-cast metal truck fits in the palm of the hand, appearing to be nothing more than a high-end toy or collectible model. With a single command word, however, it can instantly expand into a full-sized, fully functional vehicle. Torchbox trucks are available in a wide variety of designs, though they all have the same statistics.

Activate—Expand 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Requirements The truck is in its miniature form, and there's enough space to fit its vehicle form

Effect The torchbox truck instantly expands to full size next to you. In its vehicle form, the torchbox truck has the statistics of an all-terrain dune buggy.

Activate—Contract 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Requirements The truck is in its vehicle form

Effect The torchbox truck instantly contracts into its miniature form, appearing in your hand. Any passengers appear in spaces adjacent to you.
Torchbox Truck.name: Torchbox Truck

Tracer Matrix Projector (Advanced).description:
This scope-like projector apparatus mounts on top of a weapon. When activated, the projector sends out a pulse of full-spectrum energy, outlining even targets that are invisible to the naked eye when viewed through the device.

Activate—Trace Targets 1 Until the start of your next turn, treat invisible creatures in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead, and other concealed creatures in the cone aren't concealed to you.
Tracer Matrix Projector (Advanced).name: Tracer Matrix Projector (Advanced)

Tracer Matrix Projector (Commercial).description:
This scope-like projector apparatus mounts on top of a weapon. When activated, the projector sends out a pulse of full-spectrum energy, outlining even targets that are invisible to the naked eye when viewed through the device.

Activate—Trace Targets 1 Until the start of your next turn, treat invisible creatures in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead, and other concealed creatures in the cone aren't concealed to you.
Tracer Matrix Projector (Commercial).name: Tracer Matrix Projector (Commercial)

Tracer Matrix Projector (Tactical).description:
This scope-like projector apparatus mounts on top of a weapon. When activated, the projector sends out a pulse of full-spectrum energy, outlining even targets that are invisible to the naked eye when viewed through the device.

Tracer Matrix Projector (Tactical).name: Tracer Matrix Projector (Tactical)

Tracking Module.description: The tracking module embeds a specific magical signature on wounds inflicted by the weapon. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} a target damaged by your weapon, substituting an Arcana ([[/act track skill=arcana]]), Nature ([[/act track skill=nature]]), Occultism ([[/act track skill=occultism]]), or Religion ([[/act track skill=religion]]) check for the Survival check. Much like Tracking with Survival, this must take place somewhere the target has been and follow the trail; it doesn't allow anyone to find the target from a distance. The magical signature wears off after 1 week.
Tracking Module.name: Tracking Module

Tremor Soles (Commercial).description: These highly sensitive gyrometers are placed in the soles of your feet, amplifying minute vibrations in surfaces you stand on. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Tremor Soles (Commercial).name: Tremor Soles (Commercial)

Tremor Soles (Tactical).description: These highly sensitive gyrometers are placed in the soles of your feet, amplifying minute vibrations in surfaces you stand on. You gain tremorsense as a precise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Tremor Soles (Tactical).name: Tremor Soles (Tactical)

Trinary Egg.description:
This iridescent egg is disorienting to look at, constantly out of focus and overlaid by two afterimages. The trinary egg contains energy that doesn't exist in this reality, but forms a trinary with life and death. Pulled from an alternate reality where this trinary is the natural order of things, the trinary egg is magically resonant, enabling a spellcaster to leverage the trinary egg's power to balance the forces of life and death.

Activate—Trinary Resonance 1

Frequency once per day

Effect If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the vitality or void trait that deals damage or restores Hit Points, the trinary egg resonates with that spell, balancing the scales between life and death. If the spell deals damage, the trinary egg restores a number of Hit Points to you equal to twice the spell's rank. If the spell restores Hit Points, select a single target within 30 feet. The trinary egg deals persistent force damage to the target equal to the spell's rank. Cracks appear in the trinary egg's surface.
Trinary Egg.name: Trinary Egg

Truesight Sight (Commercial).description:
Lenses are made of crystals specially infused with spells as they're cut, then installed into autofocusing sights. You gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} when looking through the scope.

Activate—See the Truth 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect For the next 10 minutes, while looking through the scope, you can see @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures as though they weren't invisible. Additionally, you can see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, hiding within 10 feet of an object's surface.
Truesight Sight (Commercial).name: Truesight Sight (Commercial)

Truesight Sight (Tactical).description:
Lenses are made of crystals specially infused with spells as they're cut, then installed into autofocusing sights. You gain a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} when looking through the scope.

Activate—See the Truth 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect For the next 10 minutes, while looking through the scope, you can see @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures as though they weren't invisible. Additionally, you can see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, hiding within 10 feet of an object's surface.

When you activate See the Truth, you see the truth of the world. The GM rolls a secret counteract check with a [[/r 1d20+20 #Counteract]]{+20} counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 7 against any illusion, morph, or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it, not to end the spell or effect.
Truesight Sight (Tactical).name: Truesight Sight (Tactical)

Ultralight Wings (Advanced).description: Foldable wings are attached to your shoulder blades or a similar location on your body that allows them to lift your weight and assist your flying movements. You can deploy the wings with an Interact action, but you can't deploy or use them while you're wearing more than light armor. While the wings are deployed and you're not encumbered, you gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.
Ultralight Wings (Advanced).name: Ultralight Wings (Advanced)

Ultralight Wings (Superior).name: Ultralight Wings (Superior)

Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Advanced).description:
This bracket-mounted grenade launcher is most often advertised for use with fragmentation grenades, but can efficiently deploy utility ordinances, such as smoke grenades and flashbangs. Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 40 feet and the tracking +2 trait.

Activate—Launch 1 (attack)

Effect You launch the loaded grenade.
Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Advanced).name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Advanced)

This grenade launcher has a range of 20 feet.

Activate—Launch 1 (attack)

Effect You launch the loaded grenade.
