Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 50 feet and the tracking +3 trait.

Activate—Launch 1 (attack)

Effect You launch the loaded grenade.
Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Superior).name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Superior)

Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Tactical).description:
This bracket-mounted grenade launcher is most often advertised for use with fragmentation grenades, but can efficiently deploy utility ordinances, such as smoke grenades and flashbangs. Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 30 feet and the tracking +1 trait.

Activate—Launch 1 (attack)

Effect You launch the loaded grenade.
Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Tactical).name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Tactical)

Uniclamp.description: This is the ultimate all-purpose accessory item for holding everything from a fire extinguisher or flashlight to a musical instrument or comm unit. You can securely attach a single piece of tech gear of up to 1 Bulk to a uniclamp when you install the upgrade. You can activate the attached item using the same number of hands you use to wield your weapon while still wielding your weapon. The uniclamp can be properly configured to handle only non-magical tech gear and doesn't function with weapons or shields. The GM might determine that some items don't fit on certain weapons.
Uniclamp.name: Uniclamp

Universal Translation App (Advanced).description:
Developed by vulkarisu linguists on Absalom Station, the Universal Translation App (or UTA) automatically scans any written text to display a phonetic translation in Common on the comm unit or any head-up display, such as an armor's visor. This provides a +2 item bonus to Society checks to Decipher Writing.

Using advanced linguistics and artificial intelligence, the advanced UTA can translate to and from any spoken and written language, but it can't be used when you attempt to use a skill action with the linguistics trait without the Digital Ambassador skill feat. GMs can determine that a Rare language with completely alien phonetics is beyond the capabilities of the advanced UTA.
Universal Translation App (Advanced).name: Universal Translation App (Advanced)

Universal Translation App (Commercial).description: Developed by vulkarisu linguists on Absalom Station, the Universal Translation App (or UTA) automatically scans any written text to display a phonetic translation in Common on the comm unit or any head-up display, such as an armor's visor. This provides a +2 item bonus to Society checks to Decipher Writing.
Universal Translation App (Commercial).name: Universal Translation App (Commercial)

Universal Translation App (Tactical).description:
Developed by vulkarisu linguists on Absalom Station, the Universal Translation App (or UTA) automatically scans any written text to display a phonetic translation in Common on the comm unit or any head-up display, such as an armor's visor. This provides a +2 item bonus to Society checks to Decipher Writing.

The tactical UTA can translate verbal speech into Common with proper phonetic spelling, but it can't be used when you attempt to use a skill action with the linguistics trait without the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Bi0wdUuHsLxvSqrJ]{Digital Ambassador} skill feat.
Universal Translation App (Tactical).name: Universal Translation App (Tactical)

Unseen Saw.description:
Upgrades: 2

This wrist guard has a spinning blade that can be concealed under a hidden zipper. If you're trained in this weapon and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ddlozAEqoOI8ZsUU]{Booster Rip} skill feat as though this weapon was already charged with the boost trait.
Unseen Saw.name: Unseen Saw

Urog Shell.description: Your shell counts as light armor in the ceramic armor group that grants a +2 item bonus to AC, a Dex Cap of +2, a check penalty of –1, and has the archaic, comfort, and flexible traits. The resistance granted by Armor Specialization is electricity. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can't install armor upgrades. You gain the trained proficiency rank in this armor.
Urog Shell.name: Urog Shell

Vaccikite.description: A vaccikite is a Vercite kite shield that integrates microfiber filters to catch toxins before bodily exposure.
Vaccikite.name: Vaccikite

Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Commercial).description: Your lungs contain extra valves that protect you against decompression and special glands that inject chemical antifreeze into your bloodstream. You can hold your breath for 10 minutes and are immune to the normal environmental effects of being in a vacuum for as long as you hold your breath. You're also acclimated to either thin or thick atmospheres, chosen when you install this augmentation.
Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Commercial).name: Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Commercial)

Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Tactical).description: Your lungs contain extra valves that protect you against decompression and special glands that inject chemical antifreeze into your bloodstream. You can hold your breath for 1 hour and are immune to the normal environmental effects of being in a vacuum for as long as you hold your breath. You're also acclimated to both thin and thick atmospheres.
Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Tactical).name: Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Tactical)

Valediction Log (Advanced).description:
This device transcribes final thoughts. When a creature begins dying, it formulates a summary of its thoughts. These thoughts are converted into an audio log in the creature's voice, which can be retrieved from an accompanying storage device usually worn around the hip.

The log amplifies its wearer's mental capacities so it can process more information in its dying moments. The wearer can calmly record its dying thoughts without a word limit.

Activate—Distress Call R

Trigger You are reduced to a quarter of your maximum Hit Points or lower

Effect Your valediction log sends out an emergency signal to all comm units within 1 mile, alerting them to your coordinates and need for assistance.
Valediction Log (Advanced).name: Valediction Log (Advanced)

Valediction Log (Commercial).description:
This device transcribes final thoughts. When a creature begins dying, it formulates a summary of its thoughts, condensed into no more than 100 words. These thoughts are converted into an audio log in the creature's voice, which can be retrieved from an accompanying storage device usually worn around the hip.

Activate—Distress Call R

Trigger You are reduced to a quarter of your maximum Hit Points or lower

Effect Your valediction log sends out an emergency signal to all comm units within 150 feet, alerting them to your coordinates and need for assistance.
Valediction Log (Commercial).name: Valediction Log (Commercial)

Valediction Log (Tactical).description:
This device transcribes final thoughts. When a creature begins dying, it formulates a summary of its thoughts. These thoughts are converted into an audio log in the creature's voice, which can be retrieved from an accompanying storage device usually worn around the hip.

The log amplifies its wearer's mental capacities so it can process more information in its dying moments. The wearer can calmly record its dying thoughts without a word limit.

Activate—Distress Call R

Trigger You are reduced to a quarter of your maximum Hit Points or lower

Effect Your valediction log sends out an emergency signal to all comm units within 500 feet, alerting them to your coordinates and need for assistance.
Valediction Log (Tactical).name: Valediction Log (Tactical)

Vampiric Teeth (Commercial).description:
Your teeth are replaced with the large, hollow incisors of a vampire, designed to tear into flesh. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. If you hit a creature that's taking persistent bleed damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, rounded up, that last for 1 minute.

Activate—Ripping Teeth 1

Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike with your jaws unarmed attack

Effect You rip through your prey's flesh. The target of the required Strike takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.
Vampiric Teeth (Commercial).name: Vampiric Teeth (Commercial)

Vampiric Teeth (Tactical).description:
Your teeth are replaced with the large, hollow incisors of a vampire, designed to tear into flesh. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. If you hit a creature that's taking persistent bleed damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, rounded up, that last for 1 minute.

Whenever you get a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

Activate—Ripping Teeth 1

Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike with your jaws unarmed attack

Effect You rip through your prey's flesh. The target of the required Strike takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.
Vampiric Teeth (Tactical).name: Vampiric Teeth (Tactical)

Venom Spur.description: A retractable spur attached to one of your appendages delivers a poisonous sting. You gain a venom spur unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing plus 1d4 persistent poison damage. Your venom spur is in the brawling group and has the finesse, poison, and unarmed traits.
Venom Spur.name: Venom Spur

Venture Pumps (Advanced).description:
This bold but simple footwear stores kinetic energy.

Activate—Speed Boost f

Frequency once per hour

Effect You gain a +15-foot item bonus to your Speed and a –2 item penalty to Acrobatics checks and Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.
Venture Pumps (Advanced).name: Venture Pumps (Advanced)

Venture Pumps (Commercial).description:
This bold but simple footwear stores kinetic energy.

Activate—Speed Boost f

Frequency once per hour

Effect You gain a +5-foot item bonus to your Speed and a –2 item penalty to Acrobatics checks and Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.
Venture Pumps (Commercial).name: Venture Pumps (Commercial)

Venture Pumps (Tactical).description:
This bold but simple footwear stores kinetic energy.

Activate—Speed Boost f

Frequency once per hour

Effect You gain a +10-foot item bonus to your Speed and a –2 item penalty to Acrobatics checks and Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.
Venture Pumps (Tactical).name: Venture Pumps (Tactical)

Vertebralis Thorn.description:
Upgrades 1

The vertebralis thorn is a weapon forged in the Corpse Fleet armory, repurposed from the spinal columns of slain enemies and fitted with specialized fiber-optic cables. Corpse Fleet officers favor this weapon, primarily because a ceremonial version is presented to them after their first major conquest, generally created from the spine of a creature they personally killed.
Vertebralis Thorn.name: Vertebralis Thorn

Vesk Scales.description: Your ancestors were the hardiest specimens of vesk, having traveled far and wide while enduring hostile environments. Your scales count as medium armor in the plate armor group. They grant a +3 item bonus to AC, have a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +4 at 5th level. You can wear a flight suit, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your scales, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Vesk Scales.name: Vesk Scales

Veskarium Brigandine.description:
Upgrades: 0

Thanks to its inertial dampeners and broad range of motion, this lightweight armor is a gold standard across the Pact Worlds for military personnel and adventurers alike. The breastplate consists of interlocking polymer hexagons that mimic fabric but harden like steel against impact.
Veskarium Brigandine.name: Veskarium Brigandine

Veskarium Imperial Plate.description:
Upgrades: 1

This heavy armor is made of interlocking metal plates contoured to the wearer's body with a scaled pattern. Tailguards and clawed gloves are standard for this armor.
Veskarium Imperial Plate.name: Veskarium Imperial Plate

Vestibular Enhancement (Commercial).description: Your vestibular system is enhanced with delicate structures from a species accustomed to zero gravity. At the end of each round in which you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success, you ignore the clumsy and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.
Vestibular Enhancement (Commercial).name: Vestibular Enhancement (Commercial)

Vestibular Enhancement (Tactical).description: Your vestibular system is enhanced with delicate structures from a species accustomed to zero gravity. At the end of each round in which you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]. On a success, you ignore the clumsy and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.
Vestibular Enhancement (Tactical).name: Vestibular Enhancement (Tactical)

Vidwipe Datamine (Advanced).description:
This small gray disc can wipe up to 1 hour of recorded video and can be affixed to any recording or video storage device. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks to Hack a computer to delete existing video data for 1 minute.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a +20 modifier and expert skill proficiency.
Vidwipe Datamine (Advanced).name: Vidwipe Datamine (Advanced)

Vidwipe Datamine (Commercial).description:
This small gray disc can wipe up to 1 hour of recorded video and can be affixed to any recording or video storage device. It provides a +2 status bonus to Computers checks to Hack a computer to delete existing video data for 1 minute.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a +7 modifier and trained skill proficiency.
Vidwipe Datamine (Commercial).name: Vidwipe Datamine (Commercial)

Vidwipe Datamine (Superior).description:
This small gray disc can wipe up to 1 hour of recorded video and can be affixed to any recording or video storage device. It provides a +4 status bonus to Computers checks to Hack a computer to delete existing video data for 1 minute.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a +24 modifier and master skill proficiency.
Vidwipe Datamine (Superior).name: Vidwipe Datamine (Superior)

Vidwipe Datamine (Tactical).description:
This small gray disc can wipe up to 1 hour of recorded video and can be affixed to any recording or video storage device. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks to Hack a computer to delete existing video data for 1 minute.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a +13 modifier and expert skill proficiency.
Vidwipe Datamine (Tactical).name: Vidwipe Datamine (Tactical)

Visor of the First Ones Scholar.description:
This sleek silver and purple visor was created by devoted scholars of First Ones tech to aid a select few adventurers going on expeditions to learn more about the First Ones in hopes of keeping them alive so they might return with new artifacts and discoveries. You gain a +2 item bonus in First Ones Lore and can speak and understand Primacy and Trinary.

Activate—Predictive Defense 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The visor rapidly assesses a creature within 100 feet that you can see, predicting their behavior through computational probability and magical divination and then displaying the most likely behavioral outcomes on the visor's screen. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the target's attacks, spells, and other effects for 1 minute.
Visor of the First Ones Scholar.name: Visor of the First Ones Scholar

Vocal Modulator.description: A series of miniature actuators and dynamic hyper-resonant chambers reshape your voice box. A vocal modulator allows you to change the pitch, timbre, and tone of your voice so you can imitate accents or pronounce alien languages. When using Deception to Impersonate, you gain a +1 item bonus if the change in your voice also helps your disguise (at the GM's discretion).
Vocal Modulator.name: Vocal Modulator

Voice Amplifier.description: A voice amplifier greatly increases the volume of your voice. You can switch a voice amplifier on or off by spending an action, which has the concentrate trait. While active, a voice amplifier grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks and lowers the DCs of Perception checks to hear you speaking by 5.
Voice Amplifier.name: Voice Amplifier

Void Cutlass.description:
Upgrades: 1

While some void cutlasses are crafted out of void energy condensed to a slow vibration, rumors suggest some evolve after absorbing 999 souls and no longer need a physical blade, or battery, to contain the void energy. This weapon deals vitality damage instead of void damage to creatures that are immune to void damage.
Void Cutlass.name: Void Cutlass

Void Mesh.description: This synthetic biomesh is installed beneath your armor, replacing its fabric substrate with a form-fitting material reminiscent of necrotic tissue. The mesh was designed for joint missions between the Eoxian military and their Pact World allies. If you have the void healing ability, allied creatures can choose to treat you as living or undead when using vitality effects, and you can be healed by healing vitality effects. You're still damaged by vitality damage.
Void Mesh.name: Void Mesh

Voltaic Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

Early iterations of this supercharged weapon were too dangerous to wield until insulated plating was added. Soldiers on the field found that the shape of the rifle and added bulk make it effective for parrying melee attacks.
Voltaic Rifle.name: Voltaic Rifle

Waspslicer.description:
Upgrades: 1

Favored by Vindicators of Calistra, this pistol's glass darts leave behind glass shards usually coated with poisons.
Waspslicer.name: Waspslicer

Watchful Timepiece.description: This wristwatch can be deployed into a clockwork shield and is popular among munitions executives.
Watchful Timepiece.name: Watchful Timepiece

Wheelchair.description: Wheelchairs come in a variety of sizes and styles to suit countless alien body types, including hoverchairs. Automated mechanisms allow wheelchairs to traverse stairs, ladders, and uneven ground without any additional difficulty (difficult terrain still affects your Speed while using a wheelchair).
Wheelchair.name: Wheelchair

Wildwise Graft.description: This soft purple fungus attaches to your vocal cords and extends fine filaments into portions of your brain. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals, plants, and fungi. This communication is rudimentary and elicits basic responses, such as "hungry," "over there," or "frightened."
Wildwise Graft.name: Wildwise Graft

Xenodruid's Survival Kit.description:
This condensed kit contains miniature models of a fishing rod, fine mesh net, shovel, pick, wire cage, glass cage, and sample vials. When any item is removed from the kit, it expands into a full-sized version.

Note: The item's Bulk, price and usage are listed according to SFS Rulings and Clarifications.
Xenodruid's Survival Kit.name: Xenodruid's Survival Kit

Zero Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This triple-barreled cannon's generator churns rapidly, circulating coolant into a blast of endothermic energy. While powered, frost rimes the barrel and stock of this weapon, causing experienced wielders to wear thermal gloves.
Zero Cannon.name: Zero Cannon

Zero Knife.description:
Upgrades: 1

Unfolding like a switchblade, a supercooled chamber within this weapon instantly forms a blade of ice.
Zero Knife.name: Zero Knife

Zero Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

Zero pistols use transparent canisters of supercooled liquid as ammunition.
Zero Pistol.name: Zero Pistol

Zeroedge Blade Sharpener.description:
Chefs all over Near Space swear by Forgeworks Innovations' patented ZeroEdge technology to sharpen their knives without having to slow down the kitchen.

Activate—Sharpen 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon that deals slashing damage and does not have the deadly trait

Effect The required weapon gains the deadly d6 trait until the start of your next turn. The weapon becomes immune to the zero edge blade sharpener for 24 hours.
Zeroedge Blade Sharpener.name: Zeroedge Blade Sharpener
